Title: International Analytics Manager
Description:
Overview:

As International Analytics Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our client’s global presence. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, analyze market dynamics, and interact with marketing and business stakeholders to drive growth and engagement across international markets. If you’re passionate about sports, have a knack for strategic thinking, and thrive in a dynamic environment, this role is tailor-made for you

**Primary Location:** Across Canada

**Work Model:** Fully Remote

**Employment Type:** Contractor

**Vacancy Status:** New

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Hands-on Analytics**
* + Query and analyze data using SQL
  + Identify a problem or question and develop an analysis plan that adequately answers the question
  + Summarize data insights in a business-friendly way that is easy for stakeholders and executives to understand
  + Summarize large data outputs into key takeaways
  + Assist with user acceptance testing of database changes and updates
  + Enable data teams in the root cause analysis of issues and bugs
* **Activation and Enablement**
* + Evaluate one-to-one marketing campaign data needs and own data enablement for seamless campaign execution, including defined test and control groups and success criteria
  + Evaluate one-to-one audience needs and identify segmentation opportunities to drive and deepen fan engagement
* **Performance Tracking and Optimization**
* + Monitor the effectiveness of go-to-market strategies using relevant KPIs and attribution frameworks
  + Periodically assess performance against fanbase growth goals
  + Provide regular reports to senior leadership on international market performance
  + Regularly attend and provide input during strategy discussions with stakeholders
  + Work closely with stakeholders at the VP level

* + Work closely with marketing, international, legal, and other stakeholders to align strategies and execution
  + Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and innovation
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams on business requirements
  + Interact with third parties regarding data needs and definitions
* **Market Growth and Strategy Support**
* + Collaborate with regional teams to create data analytics and segmentation plans that support growth strategies for specific markets
  + Define clear objectives, KPIs, and success metrics for each market
  + Develop audience segments and marketing initiatives tailored to local nuances

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, or a related field
* At least 3 years of experience using SQL, Python, or other relevant coding languages
* At least 5 years of stakeholder management experience
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive decision-making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to develop structured analytical approaches to business questions
* Ability to translate complex data outputs into clear, business-friendly insights
* Experience collaborating with senior stakeholders, including those at the VP level
* Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, data engineering, legal, regional, and business teams

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience in fan, consumer, or marketing analytics
* Knowledge of consent management and/or identity resolution
* Passion for sports and an understanding of global fan cultures
* Experience with audience segmentation and one-to-one marketing campaigns
* Experience working with attribution frameworks, test and control groups, and campaign success criteria

Title: Business Support Lead
Description:
**Job Purpose**

* Lead and support all aspects of the business function, including project controls, planning, contracts, procurement and subcontracts across the Concept Study, FEED and execution phases. Monitor and analyse project and contractor performance, providing strategic business advice to ensure project objectives are achieved and the needs of stakeholders and shareholders are effectively supported.
* The prime objective of the Business Support Lead is to support the Business Manager in driving effective project and contractor performance across the Concept Study, FEED and execution phases by anticipating issues, identifying and mitigating risks, and supporting timely corrective actions to minimise adverse cost, schedule and project delivery impacts.
* The role requires a strong understanding of project drivers, business requirements and key interfaces, together with the ability to establish effective communication and reporting protocols. The incumbent will develop and implement project controls, KPIs, performance analysis and project plans that support informed decision-making and achievement of project objectives.

**Reporting Structure & Key Relationships**

* Reports to the Business Division Manager.
* Internal Stakeholder Engagement

+ Frequent contact with all major project departments and relevant company functions to coordinate project requirements, interfaces and business support activities.
+ Frequent contact with engineering, project controls, contracts, procurement, finance, SHES, operations and other business teams to coordinate interfaces and support the project through concept, FEED and execution phases.

* External Stakeholder Engagement

+ Frequent contact with engineering consultants, FEED/EPC contractors, contracting companies and service providers, with regular interaction with relevant stakeholders as required to support project delivery.

**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Business Reporting & Project Control: Provide support to the business manager with ongoing project reporting, schedule control, cost monitoring and change management to ensure timely and accurate business team deliverables across the concept study, FEED and execution phases.
* Contractor Performance Management: Evaluate and analyse project and EPC contractor project controls performance in planning, progress measurement and reporting to identify areas for improvement and ensure project objectives are achieved.
* Management Information & KPI Reporting: Identify, assess and fulfil project team requirements, including dashboards, monthly and weekly reports, risk assessments, action tracking and KPI reports to support effective management and decision-making.
* Stakeholder Reporting & Communications: Develop, coordinate and compile inputs from PMT members to meet management, shareholder and stakeholder requirements, including presentations, reports and decision-support materials, ensuring clear and effective communication.
* Commercial Evaluation Support: Participate in the evaluation of contractor proposals, change requests and scope variations, assessing schedule, cost and business impacts to support the business manager and PMT in informed decision-making.
* Schedule Development & Recovery Planning: Support the development and maintenance of project schedules, corrective actions and recovery plans, considering project risks, interfaces and dependencies to maintain project timelines and objectives.
* Governance & Assurance Coordination: Coordinate business governance and assurance requirements, including the collection and review of project deliverables required for management reviews, audits and assurance activities to ensure compliance and project readiness.
* Contracts, Procurement & Subcontracting Support: Coordinate business planning, contracts, procurement and subcontracting activities required to support the Concept Study, FEED and execution phases, ensuring alignment with project scope, schedule, commercial requirements and priorities.
* Phase Transition Management: Support the transition of the project through concept, FEED and execution, ensuring key decisions, assumptions, risks, actions, cost and schedule information and business requirements are effectively captured and transferred between project phases.
* Closeout & Handover Management: Lead the development of project phase closeout and handover reports, ensuring information on project performance, key decisions, risks, lessons learned and outstanding actions is retained for subsequent phases and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Must-Have Requirements:**

* Qualifications

+ Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, commercial, marketing, sciences, engineering, project management, supply chain management, law, communication, technologies, mathematics, and statistics.

* Knowledge & Experience

+ 8 years' experience in a business-related function or discipline, including 4 years in the oil & gas industry, and including 1 year's experience in a supervisory or acting role or oversight of contractor/subcontractor/service/vendor personnel.
+ Experience with oil & gas companies, EPC contractors, subcontractors, vendors or service companies involved in the oil and gas industry.

* Technical & Business Skills

+ Knowledge in project business-related functions/disciplines such as planning, scheduling, cost control, estimating, claim management, risk management, change management, procurement, pre- and post-award contract management, actionable and informative reporting, support services, lessons learned, etc.
+ Knowledge in international standards, best practices and methodologies as it relates to business disciplines.
+ SME-level competence in the candidate's specific business discipline.
+ Knowledge of relevant business processes/procedures.
+ Experience with the risk assessment approach in decision-making.
+ Strong knowledge of relevant software and computer skills, e.g., dashboards, data analytics, SAP, etc.
+ Experience supporting large-scale integrated operating and executing organisations, such as Operations, Projects, Subsurface, etc.

**Position Summary**
The Business Support Lead plays a critical role in supporting business performance across concept study, FEED and execution phases by integrating project controls, planning, commercial, procurement and governance requirements. The role serves as a key interface between project teams, contractors, stakeholders and management, ensuring informed decision-making, effective performance monitoring, risk mitigation and successful project delivery.

Title: Manager, Client Engagement (1 year contract)
Description:
**Our Company**

BrandActive specializes in the financial analysis, strategy, and logistics of rebrand implementation. Since 1998, we’ve helped many of the world’s most valuable brands plan, budget, and implement brand change—optimizing spend, improving efficiency, and reducing complexity along the way.

  

Our work combines industry-leading analytics with a proven methodology to help clients make smarter decisions, save time and money, and get more value from their brand investments—whether they’re navigating a major rebrand or managing their brand day to day. You can explore examples of our work in our case studies.

  

At BrandActive, we’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive workplace where people can do their best work and grow together. We strive to set the global standard for excellence in our industry while fostering a culture rooted in trust, agility, and growth —guided by our North Star: great people, doing great work, and having a great time doing it.

  

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to a Director, the Manager serves as the project lead and is accountable for strategic planning, project formulation/scoping, scenario planning, cost estimating and relationship management that supports the conversion of the client’s branded assets to a new identity/logo. The Manager then oversees the project as it moves into subsequent implementation and roll-out phases while ensuring that the client’s needs are met.

  

To fulfill these responsibilities, the Manager typically works directly with clients at senior levels of the organization including the C-suite. When conditions safely permit, travel between North America and internationally may be a requirement.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy/Analytics**

* Consult with clients about all elements for project scope and delivery, providing a high-level of expertise and instilling confidence in the client.
* Work with the client and BrandActive’s team to define the scope of brand transition across all branded asset categories (e.g. signage, ID badges, website, etc.)
* Develop several high-level scenarios to achieve brand launch and completion objectives using cost, time, quality and impact as the key variables.
* Provide senior leadership and their Board the information they need to make fiscally responsible brand decisions.
* Establish high-level transition strategies by branded asset category with priority given to those categories which are required for brand launch and have longer lead times.
* Formulate and comprehend overall implementation financials and to evaluate the implications of alternative strategy approaches on these financials at a macro and micro level.
* Develop cost estimates based on developed transition strategies.
* Define the high-level processes required to support an efficient implementation process.
* Create a high-level project communications plan to ensure engagement of all project constituents.
* Define the project organization required to execute the brand transition in a way that ensures achievement of client goals and desired outcomes.

  

**Project Management**

* Lead the project team, allocating and utilizing resources in an efficient manner and maintaining a co-operative, motivated and successful team.
* Communicate project status regularly (e.g. using dashboard reports) and escalate issues to stakeholders, sponsor(s), and senior leadership as required.
* Manage project deliverables in line with approved project plans.
* Manage or coordinate partners and work groups engaged in project delivery.
* Lead internal projects and client-facing (or conference call) meetings.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans (following PMI methodologies).
* Record, track and manage project issues and risks, escalating concerns when necessary.
* Manage project scope and change control.
* Monitor project progress and performance.
* Monitor the project budget.
* Create and present deliverables, and facilitate approval of recommendations.
* Review and provide guidance with new statements of work with current projects.
* Manage the creation of change orders with direction from the Director.

  

**Professional Development**

* Own your growth by setting and updating development goals, actively seeking feedback, and aligning your aspirations with business goals.
* Contribute to internal initiatives that impact the client and/or team member experience such as our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Advisory Committee, Community Impact Committee, or our Social Committee.
* Bring forward smarter, faster, better solutions to processes and identify opportunities to be more agile in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate inclusive and supportive behavior, contributing to BrandActive’s core values of trust, agility, and growth, commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion, (EDI), humanity, and wellbeing.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

You might not tick every box, but if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we’d love to hear from you. We value potential, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

  

**Education and Experience**

* Demonstrated commitment to life-long learning; post-secondary degree, diploma or certificate preferred.
* Three to four years of project management experience with at least two years as the Project Lead (managing projects from start to finish).
* Strong consultative skills gained through experience working as an internal consultant or in a professional services environment.

  

**Competencies**

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Superior organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity including the ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure across more complex/multi-faceted projects.
* Presence including the ability and confidence to manage client calls.
* Proven credibility gained by consistently delivering on commitments.
* Demonstrated ability move across a range of projects and clients over time.
* Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships both internally and externally.
* Excellent client contact, negotiation and problem-resolution skills.
* Detail-oriented, including the ability to identify important details, ensuring things are not overlooked and delivering a consistently high quality of work, keeping the overall goals of the project in mind.
* Demonstrated initiative including finding innovative solutions for the company and the clients.
* Skill in managing the relationship with the client and looking for additional opportunities to bring value and provide additional services.
* Taking action to make the most of the opportunities for the good of the company; takes a long-term view with the client.
* Leadership skills to lead a team of diverse individuals, providing oversight of their work, coaching and supporting them from a developmental perspective.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Excellent computer skills including MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project or other scheduling software such as Smartsheet or Teamwork Projects.
* At least basic knowledge and experience with MS Visio.
* Additional languages an asset.

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

BrandActive offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including:

* **Competitive compensation:** $100,000.00 -$150,000.00 CAD. Total compensation depends on experience, education, and skills and includes non-cash rewards. This range is plus commission.
* **Values led culture** focused on humanity, trust, agility, and growth. Check out our **Culture Statement.**
* **Comprehensive health and dental coverage** with no waiting period – your benefits start on day one.
* **Generous paid time off:** 3 weeks of vacation, additional office closures, Flex Fridays, and extended long weekends throughout the summer.
* **Holistic wellbeing benefits,** including a wellbeing allowance, flexible additional time off to care for a loved one, support mental health, or observe meaningful religious or cultural holidays.
* **Parental leave benefits** to support you and your family.
* **Home office and communications reimbursement** to help you work comfortably.
* **Charitable donation matching** to support the causes that matter to you.
* **Flexible work options** – Hybrid - with adaptable schedules.
* **Two annual town halls** in Toronto, featuring engaging sessions and fun team activities.
* **Supportive leadership and career development**, with ongoing coaching and feedback to help you grow and succeed, quarterly formal feedback, annual performance reviews and separate annual development meetings.
* **Work-from-anywhere flexibility,** with the option to work abroad for up to four weeks (in eligible countries and after a minimum tenure depending on the role and circumstance).
* And more!

  

**Start Date**

Immediately.

  

**Location**

Manage the day-to-day integration and operational validation of Cargo Terminal 2 (CT2) delivery outputs on behalf of QAS Cargo, within the governance and priorities established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2, ensuring the facility, Material Handling System (MHS), technology, processes, people and operational arrangements are aligned with approved end-user requirements and collectively prepared for safe and effective operations.

Coordinate QAS Cargo’s end-user assurance, Concept of Operations (ConOps) and operational-readiness activities across the dedicated CT2 project team, translating approved priorities into integrated actions covering operational validation, systems testing, trials, handover and transition into service. Lead the Senior Project Officer and Cargo Process Improvement Specialist in converting project outputs into an integrated, executable and operationally ready air cargo operation.

*Contract Duration: 3 years*

**Responsibilities**

Strategic

* Develop and implement the QAS Cargo Terminal 2 (CT2) delivery-integration and operational-validation framework, within the governance and priorities established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2, to provide a consistent approach across facility, Material Handling System (MHS), technology, process, people and operational-readiness workstreams.
* Translate the Senior Manager Projects' strategic priorities into integrated workstream plans, review cycles, readiness activities, decision requirements and team actions to maintain alignment across the dedicated QAS Cargo CT2 team.
* Identify cross-workstream dependencies and integration risks that could affect safety, operational functionality, capacity, maintainability, business continuity or readiness and coordinate timely resolution or escalation.

Operational

Delivery Integration and Coordination

* Lead the day-to-day integration of QAS Cargo activities across facility and construction interfaces, MHS, technology, operational processes, project controls and Operational Readiness and Airport Transfer (ORAT) to ensure parallel workstreams collectively support the approved CT2 operational outcome.
* Develop and maintain an integrated QAS Cargo delivery and readiness plan covering end-user assurance activities, operational decisions, dependencies, execution-stage deliverables, testing, commissioning, trials, training, handover and transition requirements.
* Maintain an integration and operational-interface register identifying dependencies, operational impacts, accountable workstream owners, required decisions, target resolution dates and escalation status.
* Lead working-level integration meetings and workshops to align facility, MHS, IT, processes, people and readiness activities and resolve matters that cross individual workstream boundaries.
* Escalate unresolved integration matters, conflicting requirements and material operational impacts to the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with supporting evidence, options and recommended actions.

End-User Assurance and Operational Validation

* Manage QAS Cargo’s day-to-day end-user assurance and operational-validation activities throughout construction, installation, testing, commissioning, handover and transition, within the governance, priorities and delegated authority established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2.
* Develop and maintain the end-user assurance plan, identifying required operational reviews, inspections, demonstrations, testing activities, responsible subject-matter experts, decision dates and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo subject-matter experts in assessing execution-stage deliverables requiring operational input, including contractor proposals, equipment configurations, system functionality, testing documentation, commissioning outputs, operational procedures and proposed changes affecting the approved operating solution.
* Verify through site inspections, walkthroughs, demonstrations, simulations and testing that installed facilities, MHS, technology, equipment and operational interfaces are consistent with approved QAS Cargo requirements and capable of supporting the intended cargo operation.
* Coordinate the operational validation of end-to-end cargo processes, including normal operations, peak conditions, exceptions, degraded modes, system recovery, manual fallback and business-continuity arrangements.
* Provide the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with evidence-based operational assessments, acceptance conditions and recommended actions relating to operational suitability, testing, handover and readiness.

Construction and Asset Interfaces

* Coordinate QAS Cargo input into construction sequencing, access arrangements, temporary works, project logistics and delivery interfaces where these could affect existing cargo operations, future operational requirements or CT2 readiness activities.
* Direct the Senior Project Officer’s coordination of site observations, operational walkthroughs, installation verification, progressive inspections, testing support, operational snagging and handover preparation.
* Identify the operational consequences of layout, access, installation, construction-interface or asset-readiness issues and refer technical non-conformances and workmanship matters to the appropriate MPD, PMCM, designer or contractor representative.
* Ensure the QAS Cargo team does not issue site instructions, direct contractor activities or assume responsibility for construction methodology, supervision, quality control, technical acceptance or contractual administration.

Process, Concept of Operations (ConOps) and Operational Integration

* Lead the Cargo Process Improvement Specialist in the development, validation and maintenance of the CT2 ConOps, future-state processes, operational requirements, standard operating procedures and operational scenarios.
* Ensure facility layouts, MHS functionality, technology solutions, staffing assumptions and operating procedures remain aligned with approved cargo processes, service standards, capacity requirements and performance outcomes.
* Coordinate end-to-end process mapping and operational validation across acceptance, build-up, breakdown, transfer, storage, screening, special products, truck-dock, airside and landside interfaces, as applicable to the approved CT2 operating scope.
* Maintain alignment between ConOps, operational procedures, training content, test scenarios and transition arrangements so that the intended operating model can be implemented effectively at go-live.

Operational Readiness and Airport Transfer (ORAT)

* Integrate ORAT requirements and activities across QAS Cargo’s facility, MHS, technology, process, people and delivery workstreams within the governance and priorities established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2.
* Act as the day-to-day QAS Cargo coordination point for ORAT interfaces affecting delivery integration, ConOps, operational processes, end-user requirements, testing, handover and transition activities.
* Coordinate with the appointed ORAT consultants to ensure QAS Cargo operational requirements, workstream dependencies, stakeholder inputs and readiness constraints are accurately reflected in ORAT plans and activities.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo operational stakeholders and subject-matter experts in support of readiness assessments, familiarization, simulations, testing and operational trials, ensuring the required participation, information and operational resources are available.
* Lead the Senior Project Officer and Cargo Process Improvement Specialist in providing the construction-interface, process, ConOps and operational inputs required to support ORAT planning and execution.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo participation in integrated systems testing, familiarization, simulations, the Non-Operational Trial Period, the Revenue Operational Trial Period and other applicable operational trials.
* Support knowledge transfer from the ORAT consultants to QAS Cargo and ensure relevant readiness documentation, tools and lessons are retained within the operation.

Additional Accountabilities

Handover and Transition

* Develop and manage the QAS Cargo operational-handover framework, ensuring facility, systems, equipment, process, people and documentation requirements are coordinated before transition into service.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo review of operations and maintenance manuals, as-built information, asset data, training materials, operational procedures, warranties, support arrangements and other documents required for safe and effective operation.
* Maintain an operational-handover matrix defining required documentation, training, access, equipment, systems, approvals, support arrangements, outstanding works, accountable owners and target completion dates.
* Coordinate development of migration, cutover, fallback, contingency, stabilization and ramp-up plans across existing and future QAS Cargo operations.
* Ensure transition plans clearly address interfaces between CT2, Cargo Terminal 1, supporting airport systems, operational stakeholders and relevant third parties
* Maintain the CT2 operational lessons-learned and knowledge-transfer process to retain project, process and systems knowledge within QAS Cargo.

Reporting and Governance

* Provide the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with integrated, evidence-based reporting covering workstream status, QAS Cargo actions, operational dependencies, readiness, interface risks, unresolved requirements and decisions required.
* Coordinate with the Senior Manager Project Controls to ensure QAS Cargo milestones, decisions, constraints, dependencies, testing and readiness activities are represented in integrated programme reporting.
* Prepare integration assessments, decision papers, operational-impact reviews and readiness recommendations for the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 and relevant governance forums.
* Perform other department duties related to the position as directed by the Head of the Department

You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.

**About you**

Essential

* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent
* Minimum 8 years of job-related experience
* Substantial experience in air cargo terminal operations or cargo ground handling within a complex, regulated and operationally critical environment.
* Direct operational experience of end-to-end air cargo handling processes, including acceptance, build-up, breakdown, transfer, storage, screening, special products and airside and landside interfaces.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary workstreams involving operational facilities, Material Handling Systems, technology, equipment, processes, people and operational stakeholders.
* Experience supporting a major cargo terminal development, facility expansion, automation implementation, operational transformation or comparable business-change programme.
* Experience translating approved operational requirements and project outputs into Concept of Operations, future-state processes, operating procedures, testing scenarios, training requirements and readiness activities.
* Experience participating in execution-stage end-user assurance, site inspections, operational walkthroughs, installation verification, simulations, testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational trials and handover activities.
* Experience contributing to Operational Readiness and Airport Transfer or an equivalent operational-readiness, activation, transition or cutover programme.
* Experience leading professional employees or multidisciplinary operational teams and coordinating the delivery of assigned workstreams.

Preferred

* Experience supporting the development, expansion or activation of a major international air cargo terminal.
* Experience working with automated air cargo or logistics Material Handling System (MHS) and their integration with buildings, cargo applications, supporting technology and operational processes.
* Previous major-project experience in Qatar or the Gulf Cooperation Council region.
* Professional certification in project management, ORAT, operational readiness, Lean Six Sigma, process improvement, change management or a related discipline.

Title: Online Account Manager
Location: Dubai International City, DU, United Arab Emirates
Description:
Department:

Sales & E-CommercePosition: Online Account Manager

Industry: Baby Care, Maternity, Mother & Baby Products

Reports To: Sales Manager / General Manager

1. Position Objective

The Online Account Manager is responsible for managing, developing, and growing the company's online sales channels for baby, maternity, breastfeeding, and mother-care products.

The role focuses on managing key e-commerce accounts, driving online revenue, maintaining product listings, coordinating promotions, monitoring inventory, improving brand visibility, and ensuring strong commercial relationships with online retail partners and marketplaces.

2. Key Duties and ResponsibilitiesA. Online Account Management

* Manage all online retail accounts, including Babyshop, Mumzworld, Amazon, Noon, FirstCry, and other relevant platforms.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with online buyers, category managers, and e-commerce teams.
* Coordinate new product listings, account registrations, product onboarding, and SKU activation.
* Negotiate online commercial terms, promotional participation, visibility packages, and marketing investments.
* Follow up on purchase orders, sales forecasts, replenishment, and account performance.
* Ensure all commercial agreements and brand guidelines are followed.

B. Product Listing and Content Management

* Ensure all products are correctly listed across online platforms.
* Maintain accurate product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, videos, and pricing.
* Upload product manuals, certifications, warranty information, and relevant documentation.
* Ensure correct product categorization and keyword optimization.
* Maintain updated product information for breast pumps, bottle washers, sterilizers, baby monitors, maternity bras, nursing accessories, and other mother-and-baby products.
* Monitor listing quality, product ratings, customer reviews, and content gaps.

C. Sales and Revenue Growth

* Develop strategies to achieve monthly and annual online sales targets.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance.
* Identify best-selling products, slow-moving SKUs, and new sales opportunities.
* Develop account-specific sales plans and promotional calendars.
* Improve product conversion rates and average order value.
* Recommend bundles, cross-selling, upselling, and seasonal campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to expand into new online platforms and GCC markets.

D. Promotions and Marketing Coordination

* Plan and execute online campaigns, including:
* White Friday
* Yellow Friday
* Black Friday
* Ramadan promotions
* Mother's Day
* Baby Expo campaigns
* Back-to-school and seasonal promotions
* Coordinate promotional pricing with management and obtain approval before implementation.
* Monitor competitors' pricing and promotional activities.
* Coordinate sponsored advertisements, banners, homepage placements, search visibility, and platform campaigns.
* Work with the marketing team on influencer campaigns, social media promotions, and product launches.
* Ensure promotional campaigns deliver measurable returns on investment.

E. Inventory and Supply Chain Coordination

* Monitor stock availability across all online accounts.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams for timely order fulfillment.
* Maintain stock forecasts based on historical sales and upcoming campaigns.
* Monitor out-of-stock situations and prevent lost sales.
* Follow up on pending purchase orders and replenishment.
* Track slow-moving and aging inventory.
* Coordinate returns, replacements, damaged products, and customer complaints with the relevant departments.

F. Pricing and Commercial Control

* Monitor retail selling prices across all online platforms.
* Ensure compliance with approved MRP and minimum advertised pricing policies, where applicable.
* Prevent unauthorized discounts and promotional activities.
* Monitor competitor pricing and market positioning.
* Track commissions, marketplace fees, rebates, marketing contributions, and account profitability.
* Prepare commercial performance reports for management.

G. Customer Experience and After-Sales Support

* Monitor online customer feedback, reviews, ratings, and complaints.
* Coordinate warranty claims and product replacement requests.
* Ensure customer inquiries are addressed promptly.
* Work with the after-sales team to resolve technical issues.
* Monitor recurring complaints and recommend improvements.
* Protect the brand's online reputation.

* Coordinate with warehouse and account teams.

Weekly responsibilities

* Follow up on buyers and pending purchase orders.

* Check product content and listing performance.

Monthly responsibilities

* Review sales targets and account profitability.

5. Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or E-Commerce preferred.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in online account management or e-commerce.
* Experience in baby care, maternity, FMCG, or consumer electronics is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon, Noon, Babyshop, Mumzworld, and other online marketplaces.

Title: Manager, Contract and Billing
Description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Today, billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. No one owns the whole timeline. We are creating a dedicated Contract and Billing Resolution team to close that gap for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

As the Manager, Contract and Billing, you will lead this new team of 3 to 4 Contract and Billing Resolution Specialists. You will inherit work that CSMs and their managers have handled as best they can, and turn it into a function that is repeatable, measurable, and scalable: the playbook, the intake and routing, the system of record, the root-cause reporting, and the hiring and coaching of the people who do the work.

This role sits between the sales process and the finance process. A bill can look wrong because of something that happened upstream in a quote, an order form, a contract, or a segment change in Salesforce, or downstream in billing and invoicing. You and your team will figure out where it broke, regardless of which team caused it, and work across both sides to fix it. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal, and report the repeat failures to the teams that own the underlying systems and processes.

**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.**

  

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every billing case your team resolves keeps the organizations that move goods, transport students, and restore power focused on their operations rather than on a billing dispute.
* **You want to build something from the ground up:** This team and function are new. You will hire the team, write the playbook, and set up the systems and metrics that define how Samsara resolves billing and contract cases.
* **You thrive when solving problems:** You figure things out, even without a clean playbook or precedent. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you find the fix that works for the customer and for Samsara, and you teach your team to do the same.
* **You are an investigator:** You enjoy rebuilding a timeline from incomplete or conflicting records across sales and finance systems, and you stay curious until the numbers tie out.
* **You are a people leader:** You enjoy hiring, coaching, and developing a team, and you set a high bar for quality, ownership, and follow-through.
* **You are a natural relationship builder:** Whether with our customers or cross-functional teams at Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team, and you can maintain clear boundaries while staying warm.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals.

**In this role, you will:**

* Build and lead a new team of 3 to 4 Contract and Billing Resolution Specialists: hire, onboard, coach, and develop them, and set clear expectations for case quality, ownership, and customer communication.
* Stand up the function from scratch: take the billing, concession, and cancellation work that CSMs handle today, define what the team owns and what it does not, and turn it into a documented playbook that is repeatable and scalable.
* Design and launch the system of record for billing and contract cases, working with CS Ops and Systems partners to set up intake, routing, case tracking, and customer communication in tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, or Jira.
* Own the front door: make sure every billing, concession, and cancellation request is logged in one place, including those that arrive through Slack, email, or Gainsight, and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.
* Act as the escalation point for the most complex, sensitive, or high-dollar cases, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension, and step in directly with customers and internal leaders when needed.
* Define the handoffs, ownership, and service levels with Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal so cases stop bouncing between teams.
* Set the standards for how the team separates a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and how concession and cancellation exceptions are sized, documented, and routed through the approval matrix.
* Build the metrics and reporting for the function, including volume, days to resolution, repeat errors, concession dollars, and renewal risk tied to billing issues, and use them to manage the team and show impact.
* Fix repeat causes: own the root-cause tagging on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved, such as segment-move bugs, term rounding, and AE handoff gaps.
* Partner with Support, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product on billing improvement work, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.
* Use AI to improve how the team works, from structuring case timelines to drafting summaries, while keeping approvals, amounts, and root-cause conclusions with people.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* 7+ years of experience in sales operations, deal desk, contracts, billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, or a similar finance and operations role.
* 2+ years of experience managing people, ideally in a sales operations or finance capacity.
* Experience building a team or function from scratch, or leading a major reorganization of an existing team, including writing the playbook and processes that made the work repeatable.
* Deep working knowledge of either the quote-to-contract side (quotes, order forms, amendments, terms, and the sales systems that pass contract data downstream) or the billing side (invoicing, credits, rebills, and collections), and the curiosity to learn the other.
* Experience setting up or significantly improving a case management, ticketing, or request-routing system, such as Zendesk, Jira, or Salesforce cases, that worked for both customers and internal teams.
* Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, and teach others to do the same.
* Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.
* A record of driving results across teams without authority over them, including Sales, Finance, and Operations partners with competing priorities.
* Customer-facing communication that stays honest and composed in hard conversations, and written summaries a leader can read once and decide on.
* This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management, high emotional intelligence, and comfort with ambiguity and incomplete precedent.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Has worked on both sides: the sales process and contracting, and the finance and billing process.
* Has managed a team that handled escalated or high-dollar billing or contract disputes.
* Has experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, and CPQ tools. Familiarity with Zendesk, Gainsight, and Sweethawk.
* Has a Customer Success, Support, or account management background with customer-facing financial or contract work.
* Has built dashboards, service levels, or root-cause reporting that changed how other teams fixed their processes.
* Has exposure to subscription or hardware-plus-subscription billing.
* **AI First:** Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes for themselves and their team.
* Has a strong bias for action and insistence on high standards.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Title: Project Manager - AI GPS Mapping
Description:
Join a fast-paced vehicle testing team supporting innovative automotive and mapping technology operations across major markets in the Middle East.

**The Project Coordinator**
– Vehicle Testing Operations will serve as the primary operational point of contact between the client, Drivers, and internal project management team. This role is responsible for coordinating daily testing activities, conducting driver orientations and operational training, managing route assignments, monitoring driving progress, and ensuring that all testing activities are executed according to client requirements and established operational procedures.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and confident in managing client relationships and field operations. This position requires strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and monitoring skills, with the ability to manage multiple Drivers and ensure smooth execution of daily vehicle testing activities.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

1. Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client coordination and operational concerns.

2. Attend client meetings, project briefings, and operational updates.

3. Communicate project requirements, operational updates, and performance expectations to Drivers.

4. Address client inquiries, escalate operational concerns, and ensure timely resolution of issues.

5. Maintain strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.

**Driver Management & Training**

1. Conduct Driver onboarding, orientation, and operational training before deployment.

2. Ensure Drivers understand assigned routes, driving schedules, testing procedures, safety protocols, and reporting requirements.

3. Provide regular coaching and guidance to ensure compliance with client expectations.

4. Monitor Driver attendance, punctuality, performance, and adherence to assigned schedules.

5. Coordinate Driver deployment, shift schedules, replacements, and daily manpower requirements.

**Route Assignment & Monitoring**

1. Prepare and distribute daily route assignments and driving schedules to Drivers.

2. Monitor Driver progress and route completion throughout assigned shifts.

3. Ensure Drivers strictly follow designated routes and testing instructions, with no unauthorized detours or deviations.

4. Track daily driving distance, driving hours, route coverage, and task completion.

5. Coordinate route adjustments and reassignment when operationally necessary and authorized.

6. Identify route execution issues, delays, and deviations, and implement appropriate corrective actions.

7. Ensure accurate recording and reporting of completed routes and assigned driving activities.

**Project & Operational Coordination**

1. Oversee daily vehicle testing operations to ensure activities run smoothly and according to project timelines.

2. Coordinate with Drivers, clients, and relevant operational teams to address day-to-day requirements.

3. Monitor vehicle availability, deployment schedules, and operational readiness.

4. Ensure completion and submission of daily operational reports, route logs, attendance records, and other required documentation.

5. Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.

6. Escalate incidents, safety concerns, vehicle issues, and other critical operational matters promptly.

7. Support project planning, resource allocation, and operational performance tracking.

**Compliance, Safety & Reporting**

1. Ensure Drivers comply with traffic regulations, company policies, client requirements, and established safety procedures.

2. Monitor compliance with assigned driving hours, rest periods, and operational schedules.

3. Ensure all Drivers complete required safety briefings and operational training.

4. Review daily reports and ensure accurate documentation of route completion, incidents, and irregularities.

5. Prepare and present regular operational updates and performance reports to the client and management.

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised PMO Manager to lead and oversee Project Management Office (PMO) functions within a large-scale, complex operational environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and maintaining effective project governance frameworks, overseeing project planning and performance monitoring, coordinating multiple workstreams, and ensuring that projects are delivered in line with approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and strategic objectives. This role requires a strong understanding of PMO methodologies, project controls, risk management, resource planning, reporting, and stakeholder engagement. The PMO Manager will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and project teams to provide visibility on project performance, identify potential challenges, and drive effective decision-making.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* PMO Governance & Framework Management
* Establish, implement, and maintain PMO policies, procedures, governance frameworks, and project management standards.
* Ensure consistency in project management methodologies, processes, documentation, and reporting across all workstreams.
* Develop and maintain project governance structures, approval workflows, escalation procedures, and decision-making frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with established project management standards and organisational requirements.
* Continuously review and improve PMO processes to enhance efficiency, accountability, and project delivery.
* Project Planning & Performance Monitoring
* Oversee the development, consolidation, and monitoring of integrated project plans and master schedules.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, critical paths, and key deadlines.
* Monitor progress against approved project plans and identify deviations, delays, and potential delivery risks.
* Coordinate with project managers and workstream leads to ensure timely execution of activities.
* Ensure project objectives, deliverables, and timelines remain aligned with overall strategic priorities.
* Monitor project performance through KPIs and other relevant performance indicators.
* Reporting & Management Information
* Lead the preparation and consolidation of regular project status reports, executive dashboards, and management presentations.
* Provide senior management with accurate and timely visibility of project progress, performance, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Develop reporting templates, tracking tools, and performance measurement systems.
* Analyse project data and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of information reported across different departments and workstreams.
* Prepare progress summaries and highlight critical matters requiring management intervention.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management
* Establish and maintain project risk and issue registers.
* Identify potential project risks, operational challenges, and delivery bottlenecks.
* Coordinate the development and monitoring of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Ensure risks and issues are escalated through the appropriate governance channels.
* Monitor project changes, assess their potential impact on scope, timelines, resources, and budgets, and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained.
* Track corrective actions and ensure accountability for their timely resolution.
* Resource & Budget Oversight
* Monitor resource allocation and utilisation across projects and workstreams.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to identify resource gaps and potential capacity constraints.
* Support project budget tracking, expenditure monitoring, and financial performance reporting.
* Identify potential budget variances and highlight areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure resources are aligned with project priorities, operational requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Act as a central coordination point between senior management, project managers, department heads, and key stakeholders.
* Facilitate project review meetings, governance meetings, and progress discussions.
* Ensure clear communication of project priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and action items.
* Follow up with workstream leads to ensure agreed actions and deliverables are completed within established deadlines.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and support the resolution of cross-functional challenges.
* Ensure alignment between different departments and project teams.
* Documentation & Project Controls
* Oversee the maintenance of comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, reports, risk registers, action logs, and decision records.
* Ensure appropriate document control, version management, and reporting processes are followed.
* Maintain centralised project trackers and ensure information is regularly updated.
* Monitor project deliverables against agreed scope, quality requirements, and timelines.
* Ensure proper records are maintained to support project reviews, audits, and management decisions.

**Required Skills**

* PMO Governance: Strong understanding of PMO structures, project governance frameworks, methodologies, and standard operating procedures.
* Project Planning & Scheduling: Ability to develop, review, consolidate, and monitor integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and dependencies.
* Project Controls: Knowledge of project performance tracking, progress measurement, schedule management, and variance analysis.
* Risk & Issue Management: Ability to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate project risks and operational issues.
* Reporting & Data Analysis: Strong ability to consolidate complex information into clear management reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.
* Budget & Resource Monitoring: Understanding of project budget tracking, resource allocation, utilisation, and cost control.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate across multiple departments, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Change Management: Understanding of scope management, change requests, impact assessments, and approval processes.
* Documentation & Controls: Strong knowledge of project documentation, reporting standards, action tracking, and document control.

Software & Tools
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Microsoft Project or equivalent project scheduling tools.
* Power BI or similar reporting and dashboard platforms.
* Primavera P6 would be an advantage.
* Microsoft SharePoint, Teams, and other project collaboration tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.

**Experience Requirement**

* Minimum 8-10 years of relevant professional experience in project management, PMO, project controls, or programme management.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or leading PMO functions within large-scale, complex, or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record in establishing PMO governance frameworks, reporting structures, project controls, and performance monitoring processes.
* Strong experience coordinating multiple projects, departments, or workstreams simultaneously.
* Experience working with senior management and providing executive-level reporting and project performance insights.
* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, risk management, change control, and resource management.
* Experience in large-scale events, major programmes, infrastructure, government, or complex operational environments would be an advantage.

Title: Pool Manager I
Description:
**Why Join Team SB**
--------------------

**Are you ready to lead a team, promote water safety, and make a lasting impact in your community?**

**The City of San Bernardino is looking for enthusiastic and dedicated individuals to join our Aquatics Division as a** ***Pool Manager I***!

  
  

**About the City:**  
As a future member of our team, you'll be joining a city with deep roots, cultural diversity, and exciting momentum. Located in the heart of Southern California's Inland Empire, San Bernardino is the county seat and largest city in the region, home to more than 222,000 residents. Its rich history — shaped by Native American, Mexican, and Spanish influences — continues to inspire the city's evolving identity.
  
San Bernardino offers access to major transit corridors, natural beauty, and a wide range of housing and lifestyle options. It's a place where public service careers are supported by a strong sense of community and purpose — and where motivated professionals can grow, contribute, and be part of something meaningful.

**About the Position:**  
The City of San Bernardino is seeking Pool Managers within the Aquatics Division of the Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Department. The Pool Manager plans and supervises the operation of a public swimming pool; accomplishes specialized work in protecting life, preventing accidents, enforcing safety regulations and providing instructions; and, performs related work as required. Provides friendly and efficient customer service to the public and City staff. Assists with pool scheduling and programming, enforces safety rules, supervises swim activities, and teaches swim classes. Responds to emergencies with rescues, first aid, and CPR. Oversees facility cleanliness, conducts water tests, maintains records, and adds pool chemicals. Supervises staff, ensures safe operations, and promotes positive public relations. Supports City and department goals and performs related duties as needed.

  
  
**In-Water Skills Testing Schedule:**  
**Location:**
  
831 East Highland Avenue, Jerry Lewis Family Swim Center, San Bernardino, California 92404
  
**Time:**
  
9:00 AM - 11:00 AM
  
**Date:**
  
December 5, 2026

**What You'll Be Doing Here**
-----------------------------

**The Ideal Candidate:**  
The ideal candidate is a confident, observant, and service-oriented leader who remains calm in emergencies and acts quickly to protect swimmers. They have strong swimming and lifesaving skills, can teach swimming and water safety, and are able to supervise staff, enforce pool rules, maintain records, and provide courteous service to the public.
  
  
**A Day in the Life:**  
As Pool Manager I, you’ll supervise lifeguards and oversee swimming activities to help ensure pool rules are followed and hazards are addressed. You’ll teach swimming lessons, respond to emergencies, provide first aid when needed, and monitor pool conditions and water quality. You’ll also help maintain the facility and equipment, keep records of water tests and incidents, and provide friendly service to pool users.

**What You Need to Qualify**
----------------------------

**Education, Training and Experience:**
  
Age 18 or older and graduation from high school or GED equivalent and a minimum of one (1) year full-time paid experience in instructing or supervising water recreational activities. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis to a maximum of two (2) years.

**Licenses, Certificates, Special Requirements:**
  
Possession of a valid Red Cross Lifeguard Training, YMCA Lifeguard or Ellis and Associates Lifeguard Certificate

**and**

Red Cross Water Safety Instructor's (WSI) Certificate or YMCA SKIPPERS/Progressive Instructor Certificate

**and**

A Red Cross Standard First Aid Certificate or American Red Cross Community First Aid and Safety Certificate or National Safety Council Standard First Aid Certificate or Medic First Aid Certificate

**and**

American Heart Association CPR Level "C" BLS (Basic Life Support) Certificate or American Red Cross Community CPR Certificate or American Red Cross CPR for the Professional Rescuer Certificate are required.

  
  
**Desirable Certification:**
  
American Red Cross Lifeguard Training Instructor  
  
  
  

*All certificates must be valid for the duration of employment and attached to the application.*

  
  

***Recruitment Timeline***

This recruitment will remain open until filled, or until a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received.

***\*\*All dates are subject to change at the discretion of Human Resources\*\****

**How to Apply and What to Expect Next**
----------------------------------------

All applicants are required to submit an online application through the City’s official website at www.sbcity.org. **This recruitment will remain open until filled, or until a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received.**

Applications must be fully completed and clearly demonstrate that the minimum qualifications for the position are met. All information provided is subject to review, investigation, and verification. While resumes may be uploaded as supplemental documentation, they will not be accepted in place of a fully completed City application.

Following the initial screening, the most qualified candidates whose backgrounds best match the needs of the City will be invited to continue in the selection process. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not guarantee advancement. Candidates will remain under consideration until a final selection is made and an offer is accepted. The City of San Bernardino reserves the right to close the recruitment at any time and may determine that none of the applicants, including those who meet the minimum qualifications, are suitable for the position.

**Pre-Employment Process** **may include, but is not limited to:**  

* Application Review
* Oral Examination
* In-water Swimming and Lifesaving Skills Assessment
* Pre-employment Medical Exam including drug and TB test
* LiveScan Fingerprinting which reviews criminal history with the California Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)
  

  

**E-Verify Participation:**

The City of San Bernardino participates in the E-Verify program. In compliance with federal law, all employers are required to verify the identity and employment eligibility of individuals hired to work in the United States. Accordingly, the City will provide information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration to confirm authorization to work in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services website at www.uscis.gov.

  

**Disclaimers:**

The City of San Bernardino is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The City follows a nepotism policy, which may impact hiring decisions if an applicant has relatives currently employed by the City.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the City provides reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. Each request is evaluated on a case-by-case basis. To request an accommodation, please contact the Human Resources Department directly at (909) 998-2060.

This bulletin is intended for informational purposes only and does not constitute a contract, expressed or implied. Its contents may be modified or withdrawn without prior notice.

For questions regarding this recruitment, contact Stephanie Rivera at Rivera\_es@sbcity.org. Additional information is available at www.sbcity.org.

  

Part-time, Temporary, and seasonal employment are restricted to 1,000 hours within a 12-month period (July 1 to June 30) and do not qualify to receive City benefits, except those required by law. Further restrictions apply to CalPERS retired annuitants.

Description:

**At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.**

**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Second Service Manager

**Department:** Grocery

**FLSA** : Non-Exempt

**General Function**

Provides prompt, efficient and friendly customer service. Monitors and maintains the sales floor operations and the technology necessary to do so. Successfully handles customer/employee relations .

**Core Competencies**

* Partnerships
* Growth mindset
* Results oriented
* Customer focused
* Professionalism

**Reporting Relations**

Accountable and Reports to: District Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of; Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home

Positions that Report to you: All positions except those listed above and department heads.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Maintains a positive attitude; creates an atmosphere of friendliness and fun through flexibility and teamwork.
* Generates a friendly atmosphere by encouraging employees to greet and speak to customers; providing prompt, courteous, and efficient service to customers and sets a good example.
* Monitors and maintains the sales floor operations and the technology necessary for the successful handling of customers.
* Provides prompt, efficient and friendly customer service by exhibiting caring, concern and patience in all customer interactions and treating customers as the most important people in the store.
* Smiles and greets customers in a friendly manner, whether the encounter takes place in the employee’s designated department or elsewhere in the store.
* Makes an effort to learn customers’ names and to address them by name whenever possible.
* Assists customers by: (examples include)
  + Escorting them to the products they are looking for.
  + Securing products that are out of reach.
  + Loading or unloading heavy items.
  + Making note of and passing along customer suggestions or requests.
  + Performing other tasks in every way possible to enhance the shopping experience.
* Answers the telephone promptly and provides friendly, helpful service to customers who call.
* Trains employees in store policies, department procedures, and job duties.
* Ensures proper customer service throughout the store and addresses specific customer issues.
* Exercises and ensures cleanliness, sanitation, maintenance of equipment, and appearance of the entire store and property.
* Learns to formulate pricing philosophies or merchandising following guidelines established by the Store Manager.
* Orders merchandise (new product, promotional, seasonal, or to replenish merchandise on hand), verifies delivery of merchandise, ensures quality, compares record with merchandise ordered, and reports discrepancies.
* Recruits and interviews job applicants to recommend or determine employment.
* Ensures compliance of employees with established policy/law, security, sales, and record keeping procedures and practices.
* Approves checks written for cash or payment of merchandise purchased.
* Coordinates backroom facilities and equipment; recommends changes in allocation of space.
* Distributes money to cash registers as needed; responsible for cash accountability of cash registers and safe.
* Inspects merchandise to ensure it is correctly priced and displayed; corrects mispriced items in the computer.
* Maintains strict adherence to department and company guidelines related to personal hygiene and dress.
* Adheres to company policies and individual store guidelines.
* Reports to work when scheduled and on time.

**Secondary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Determines the motivational needs of employees and provides the appropriate environment.
* Suggests improvements in work methods and procedures by observing and listening to employees/customers.
* Prepares sketches or floor plans of proposed displays.
* Develops layout, selects theme, colors, and props, and requisitions materials.
* Oversees and participates in construction of displays.
* Participates in continuing education through reviewing articles in trade publications.
* Recommends cost reduction programs.
* Makes corrections, additions or deletions to employee’s schedules.
* Sells merchandise to company employees, customers or issues merchandise upon requisition by authorized personnel (inter-store transfers).
* Handles cash registers.
* Resets new and current items in aisles.
* Performs other job related duties and special projects as required.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Instructing, assigning work, reviewing work, planning the work of others, maintaining standards, allocating personnel, and coordinating the activities of others.
* Selects new employees and acts on employee problems.
* Has the authority to recommend and approve employee transfers, promotions, discipline, discharge, and salary adjustments.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Worker Characteristics**

* Must have the ability to solve practical problems; variety of variables with limited standardization; interpret instructions.
* Ability to do arithmetic calculations involving fractions, decimals, and percentages.
* Possess the ability to interview to obtain basic information; guide people to provide basic direction; follow technical manuals and have increased contact with people.

**Education and Experience**

High school or 1 year of similar or related work experience.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to physically perform medium work: exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and 20 pounds of force frequently, and 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
* Visual requirements include vision from less than 20 inches to more than 20 feet with or without correction, depth perception, color vision, and field of vision.
* Must be able to perform the following physical activities: Climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, standing, walking, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions.

**Working Conditions**

This position is exposed to dust, noise, and temperature extremes. There are possible equipment movement hazards; electrical shock, and exposure to chemicals and solvents. This is a fast paced work environment.

**Equipment Used to Perform Job**

Pallet jack, box cutter, cash registers, knives, trash compactor, cardboard baler, fork lift, computer, calculator, telephone, copy and fax machine, two wheeler, register computer, delivery vehicle.

**Contacts**

Has daily contact with customers, fellow employees, suppliers/vendors, and the general public. Occasional contact with federal or state regulatory agencies regarding inspections.

**Confidentiality**

Has access to confidential information which may include pricing, sales reports, and profit and loss reports.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.
