Title: Manager, Guest Experience
Description:
**JOB TITLE:** Manager, Guest Experience

**REPORTING TO:** Director, Guest Experience

**DEPARTMENT:** Stadium Operations

**LOCATION:** New York, NY (Through Q1 2027), Queens, NY (Q2 2027 and beyond)

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Manager, Guest Experience, will help support the development, implementation, and day-to-day operations of the stadium's Guest Experience program. This position will play a key role in ensuring consistent execution of Etihad Park’s service standards across all events and creating a welcoming, inclusive environment for every guest.

In conjunction with the Director, the Manager will be involved in training, scheduling, communicating, event preparation, gathering guest feedback, and administrative processes for event-day Guest Experience workforce, including ticket takers, ushers, and other guest-facing personnel. As part of the opening team for Etihad Park, this role will also have a unique opportunity to help build the Guest Experience program from the ground up, including developing procedures, training programs, service standards, and team culture.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, outgoing, comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment, and motivated by creating exceptional experiences for both guests and employees.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Strategic & Functional Responsibilities**

* Support the Director, Guest Experience in implementing the stadium's overall Guest Experience strategy, service philosophy, and operating standards.
* Develop and main policies, procedures, SOP’s, checklists, and event-day documentation.
* Coordinate Guest Experience requirements for all major events and stadium programming.
* Support event planning by developing staffing plans, deployment documents, briefing materials, event-day assignments, and other operational resources.
* Track event-day staffing levels, call times, assignments, attendance, and other workforce information to ensure appropriate coverage and adjustments as needed
* Lead onboarding, orientation, and training programs for Guest Experience staff.
* Help administer recognition programs designed to create a strong culture.
* Support services, including but not limited to, accessibility services, family services, sensory services, lost and found, wayfinding, and guest issue resolution.
* Manage Guest Experience supplies, uniforms, equipment, and other operational resources.
* Support tracking of guest feedback, surveys, complaints, compliments, and operational observations.
* Track Guest Experience KPIs and prepare event recaps, dashboards, reports, and recommendations.
* Manage overall supplies and uniform orders and checkout.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, guest touchpoints, and event-day execution.

**Leadership & Collaboration Responsibilities**

* Serve as a key day-to-day support to the Director, Guest Experience and assist with executing departmental priorities.
* Build positive working relationships with Guest Experience staff to help establish a strong sense of team and service culture.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for the stadium's Guest Experience team on scheduling, training, event information, and administrative needs.
* Partner closely with other Stadium departments to support a seamless guest journey.
* Participate in event planning meetings and communicate relevant information, changes, and expectations to the Guest Experience team.
* Support pre-event briefings and ensure supervisors and frontline personnel have the information necessary to successfully perform their roles.
* Manage part-time event day staff.
* + Reinforce stadium service standards, policies, expectations, and behaviors with both full and part-time staff.

**Decision-Making & Accountability**

* Take ownership of assigned Guest Experience programs, projects, and event-day responsibilities and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* Monitor event-day Guest Experience operations and identify issues requiring immediate attention or escalation.
* Assist with guest complaints and service recovery situations in line with stadium service standards.
* Ensure accurate tracking and documentation of staffing, guest incidents, service recovery matters, and departmental activities.
* Follow up on after action and ensure identified Guest Experience improvements are incorporated into future events.
* Exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive guest, employee, and business information.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree, ideally in Hospitality Management, Sports Management, Event Management, or a related field preferred or equivalent experience
* Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in guest services, hospitality, event operations, sports, entertainment, attractions, or a comparable customer-facing environment.
* Previous experience in a stadium, arena, entertainment venue, convention center, theme park, hotel or other high-volume guest environment preferred.
* Experience supporting large event day or hourly workforces.
* Demonstrated passion for service industry and delivering exceptional guest experiences.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple events, projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with frontline staff, vendors, colleagues, and leadership.
* Ability to build strong relationships and work collaboratively across multiple departments.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm, professional, and solutions-oriented in a fast-paced event environment.
* Working knowledge of accessibility and inclusive guest experience practices preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on the stadium's event calendar.
* Ability to comply with MLS Safety and Well-Being policies and all applicable safeguarding requirements.
* Travel requirements (if applicable).
* Physical requirements (if applicable).

**COMPENSATION**

This exempt position has an estimated $75,000 annual base salary range and is not overtime eligible. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance options.
* Competitive benefits, including parental leave.
* Commuter benefits, pet insurance, gym membership, and Citi Bike discounts.
* Wellness programs supporting physical and mental well-being.
* Four complimentary tickets to every NYCFC home match.
* Team outings and annual staff gatherings.
* A dynamic and ambitious work environment.

At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build New York City into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club is the first and only Major League Soccer team located within the five boroughs and is building Etihad Park, New York City’s first soccer-specific stadium, set to open in 2027.

New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Montevideo City Torque, Girona FC, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, Yokohama F. Marinos, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs. To learn more about New York City FC and Etihad Park, visit www.newyorkcityfc.com.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status
    
  + Completed/closed restoration
  
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
  
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
  
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  

  
  

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

  

  
* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
  
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
  
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
  
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.
  

  
  

Financial Management

  

  
* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.
  
* Identify potential cost overruns, unauthorized work, and additional restoration costs.
  
* Review vendor restoration claims and supporting documentation as required.
  
* Escalate material cost variances and financial risks to Construction leadership.
  
* Support the recovery of costs from vendors where restoration deficiencies or rework are attributable to vendor performance.
  

  
  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  

Accountable for improving and maintaining performance against key restoration metrics, including:

  

  
* Percentage of restoration completed within required timelines
  
* Aging of outstanding restoration items
  
* Number of overdue restoration items
  
* Municipal restoration deficiencies
  
* Restoration rework rate
  
* Vendor restoration performance
  
* Time from construction completion to final restoration
  
* Time from deficiency identification to correction
  
* Number of open municipal complaints related to restoration
  
* Restoration cost per home/premise
  
* Percentage of builds achieving municipal closeout/acceptance
  

  
  

**What You Bring:**

  

  
* **Accountability:**
   Takes ownership of restoration outcomes and drives issues to closure.
  
* **Vendor Management:**
   Holds vendors accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.
  
* **Execution:**
   Focuses on completing work and closing outstanding items rather than simply tracking them.
  
* **Organization:**
   Maintains accurate records, priorities, schedules, and follow-ups across a large program.
  
* **Problem Solving:**
   Quickly identifies root causes and develops practical solutions to restoration challenges.
  
* **Communication:**
   Clearly communicates expectations, deadlines, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* **Attention to Detail:**
   Ensures restoration meets municipal and telMAX standards.
  
* **Leadership:**
   Influences vendors and internal stakeholders to achieve results without necessarily having direct authority over them.
  
* **Continuous Improvement:**
   Identifies opportunities to improve restoration processes, vendor performance, and overall construction closeout.
  

  
  

**Experience:**

  

  
* 5+ years of experience in construction, restoration, civil construction, telecommunications, utilities, or a related field.
  
* Experience managing construction or restoration vendors.
  
* Experience working with municipalities, inspectors, or right-of-way requirements is strongly preferred.
  
* Experience in FTTH, telecommunications, utility construction, or civil construction is an asset.
  
* Strong understanding of construction restoration practices, including asphalt, concrete, landscaping, sod, topsoil, curbs, sidewalks, and related municipal infrastructure.
  
* Strong project and vendor management skills.
  
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  
* Ability to manage multiple projects, vendors, and geographic areas simultaneously.
  
* Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction/project management systems.
  
* Valid driver's licence and ability to travel regularly to construction sites.
  

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by the Restoration Manager's ability to take ownership of the restoration backlog, establish clear accountability with vendors, reduce aging and outstanding deficiencies, and consistently drive restoration through to final completion and municipal acceptance.

  
  

**ImPACT Values**

  

  
* Performance & Commitment
  

  

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.

We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.

  

  
* Customer Centricity
  

  

In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word-of-mouth and drive company growth.

  

  
* Trust & Integrity
  

  

We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.

  
  

**Why You Should Join telMAX:**

Title: People & Culture Assistant Manager (Saudi Only)
Description:

**People & Culture Assistant Manager**

**Department:** People & Culture  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** People & Culture Manager

**Job Summary**

Basiqat by Mantis is seeking an experienced, proactive, and people-focused People & Culture Assistant Manager to join our pre-opening leadership team.

This position is designed for an accomplished hospitality Human Resources professional with strong operational knowledge, leadership capabilities, and the ability to independently manage key People & Culture functions.

Reporting directly to the People & Culture Manager, the successful candidate will serve as the department's second-in-command, overseeing daily HR operations, supporting strategic People & Culture initiatives, and ensuring full compliance with Saudi Labor Law, Accor policies, and Mantis brand standards.

As part of the resort's pre-opening team, the People & Culture Assistant Manager will play a critical role in establishing HR operations, implementing systems and procedures, coordinating workforce mobilization, and developing a strong Heartist culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People & Culture Leadership & Operations**

* Provide professional HR guidance and operational support to department heads and management.
* Supervise assigned People & Culture team members, ensuring accountability and effective task execution.
* Represent the People & Culture department in operational meetings when delegated.
* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of HR policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend effective solutions to enhance HR service delivery.
* Ensure a professional, confidential, and service-oriented approach across all People & Culture activities.

**Pre-Opening People & Culture Management**

* Support the execution of the resort's People & Culture pre-opening critical path and manpower mobilization plan.
* Coordinate the establishment of HR operational systems, processes, documentation, and reporting structures.
* Oversee pre-opening recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, and joining formalities.
* Work closely with department heads to ensure staffing requirements are fulfilled in accordance with approved manpower plans.
* Support the implementation of Accor and Mantis People & Culture standards and brand requirements.
* Coordinate the preparation of employee facilities, orientation programs, and HR operational readiness.
* Monitor pre-opening milestones, identify potential delays, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support the development of departmental SOPs, HR forms, employee handbooks, and internal policies.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Oversee recruitment activities, including vacancy advertisements, candidate screening, interviews, reference checks, and employment offers.
* Coordinate recruitment activities through SmartRecruiters and other approved platforms.
* Monitor recruitment progress, hiring timelines, and manpower requirements.
* Partner with department heads to identify recruitment priorities and workforce needs.
* Review employment offers, contracts, and joining documentation for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain recruitment reports and provide regular hiring updates to the People & Culture Manager.
* Support workforce planning, internal mobility, and talent development initiatives.

**Employee Relations & Labor Law Compliance**

* Provide guidance on employee relations matters, workplace policies, and Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Support grievance handling, disciplinary procedures, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure employee relations processes are conducted fairly, consistently, and in accordance with applicable regulations.
* Advise department heads on appropriate HR procedures and employee management practices.
* Monitor employment contract compliance, probation periods, resignations, and termination procedures.
* Coordinate with Government Relations on employment-related regulatory requirements.
* Support Saudization monitoring and compliance with applicable workforce localization requirements.
* Maintain accurate documentation of employee relations matters and compliance activities.

**Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Oversee the preparation and verification of monthly payroll inputs in coordination with Finance.
* Review attendance records, overtime, leave balances, allowances, deductions, and payroll adjustments.
* Ensure accuracy of employee data within HR and payroll systems.
* Coordinate employee benefits administration, medical insurance, and employment-related entitlements.
* Review end-of-service benefit calculations, final settlements, and separation documentation.
* Ensure payroll administration and employee entitlements comply with applicable Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Identify payroll discrepancies and coordinate timely corrective actions.

**Performance Management & Heartist Development**

* Support the implementation of performance management processes, probation reviews, and annual appraisals.
* Guide department heads on performance documentation and employee development procedures.
* Coordinate with the Training Supervisor on onboarding, mandatory training, and development initiatives.
* Support talent identification, succession planning, and career development programs.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional development.

**Heartist Engagement & Workplace Culture**

* Promote Accor's Heartist philosophy and foster a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace environment.
* Support employee engagement, recognition, welfare, and well-being initiatives.
* Coordinate internal communication activities and employee events.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for Heartists seeking HR guidance and support.
* Monitor employee feedback and recommend initiatives to improve engagement and retention.
* Support a workplace culture that reflects the resort's luxury hospitality values.

* Excellent command of English and Arabic, both written and spoken.

* Ability to advise department heads and handle sensitive HR matters professionally.
* Strong analytical thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

**Join us and be part of the Basiqat by Mantis journey!**

**Job Purpose Summary**

* The incumbent will be responsible Identifying the current state of processes; eliciting their useful and harmful attributes; documenting models of the processes; and facilitating stakeholder groups to consensus regarding new business process designs.

* Establish measurement plans for key performance indicators (KPIs) and execute control plans to monitor, track and update KPIs related to dedicated reengineering and end-to-end process enhancement initiatives on a periodic basis.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimize cost, avoid waste, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Customer (Internal & External):
* Identify, quantify and define enhancement areas in close partnership with the concerned stakeholder and contribute to the implementation of customer-centered processes.
* Work closely with stakeholders of Group operation to improve on relevant KPIs.

**Leads Cross-functional Design Teams To**

* understand and investigate the current business process design.
* identify problems, complexities, non-value-added steps, inefficient workflows, and other design factors.
* develop performance measurement systems and analyze performance data.
* create improvement recommendation and improve process design.
* implement solutions to achieve results in output volumes, quality, timelines and costs.
* Optimize the use of appropriate lean and 6 sigma tools; pursue technology developments that result in process enhancement.

* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests.

* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.

* Identify defects and impact of defects on current processes.
* Propose defect fixes or system enhancements, and work with the various stakeholders to propose and develop process and/or technology modifications.

* Identify benefits, quantify targeted results, establish measurement criteria and assist in the prioritization of process enhancement initiatives.
* Apply and implement industry best practices and standards within the execution of process enhancement assignments.

* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.

* At least 4 years of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank / organization and process reengineering, business consulting and project management or equivalent business/ operations experience within the financial services arena (however: no specialization in one area but rather multi-skill and transversal across functions).
* Operational and project management experience including the participation in large company wide program deployments with partial subproject responsibility.
* Certified Six Sigma Green Belt experience and technical mastery.

Title: Executive Assistant Manager - Food & Beverage
Description:
**Company Description**

**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

**Fairmont Hotels & Resorts**

Join a dynamic team and be part of a network of 90 spectacular properties, and 34 more in the pipeline, in 30 countries around the globe. Our properties are located from the beaches of Hawaii, to the unspoiled national parks of Canada, to the heart of London, to the deserts of the United Arab Emirates.

**About Raffles & Fairmont Doha**

Discover two distinguished luxury brands united within the iconic Katara Towers at Raffles Doha and Fairmont Doha — where extraordinary hospitality, timeless elegance, and world-class experiences come together.

Raffles Doha offers an atmosphere of intimate luxury and bespoke service, where every detail is thoughtfully curated to create meaningful and memorable moments. Rooted in a legacy of elegance and artistry, Raffles is renowned for delivering gracious hospitality with authenticity, sophistication, and emotional connection.

Fairmont Doha embodies the spirit of grand hospitality, blending contemporary style with the warmth and energy for which the Fairmont brand is celebrated worldwide. With a focus on exceptional service, vibrant guest experiences, and a deep sense of place, Fairmont creates unforgettable stays for today’s global traveler.

Together, Raffles & Fairmont Doha provide a dynamic and inspiring environment for hospitality professionals who are passionate about excellence. Joining our team means becoming part of a culture that values individuality, nurtures talent, and empowers colleagues to create remarkable experiences every day.

**About the Application Process**

At Raffles & Fairmont Doha, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

 **Job Description**

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles & Fairmont Doha as our new Executive Assistant Manager - Food & Beverage.

As the Executive Assistant Manager - Food & Beverage, you will provide strategic and operational leadership across the Food & Beverage division at Raffles & Fairmont Doha, supporting the overall F&B vision, commercial strategy, and luxury positioning of both brands. You will drive revenue growth, profitability, operational excellence, and exceptional guest experiences across all F&B outlets and services.

You will lead and develop high-performing teams, strengthen leadership capabilities, and use performance insights to optimise revenue, costs, productivity, and service standards. Working closely with the executive leadership, you will translate strategic priorities into effective execution while identifying opportunities to elevate the F&B offering and strengthen the property’s market position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Support the strategic direction of the Food & Beverage division, translating business objectives into focused commercial and operational priorities
* Partner with the hotel's leadership team to drive revenue growth, profitability, market positioning, and long-term F&B performance
* Oversee the operational performance of restaurants, bars, banqueting, in-room dining, and other F&B touchpoints, ensuring consistent execution of strategic plans
* Analyse revenue, profitability, labour productivity, food and beverage costs, guest feedback, and market trends to identify opportunities and guide decision-making
* Contribute to annual budgets, business plans, forecasting, capital planning, and commercial initiatives that support sustainable growth
* Identify and develop new concepts, revenue streams, partnerships, and guest experiences that enhance the luxury positioning of Raffles & Fairmont Doha
* Drive service excellence and operational consistency, ensuring F&B experiences reflect the distinctive standards and personality of both luxury brands
* Lead and develop F&B leadership teams, strengthening accountability, succession planning, talent development, and a culture of high performance
* Work cross-functionally with Culinary, Finance, Sales & Marketing, Rooms, and other stakeholders to align F&B strategy with wider business objectives
* Maintain strong operational visibility through regular performance reviews, outlet engagement, and structured follow-up on key business priorities
* Champion innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement across the F&B operation while balancing guest expectations with commercial realities
* Ensure adherence to brand standards, food safety, regulatory requirements, and operational controls across the division
* Act as a key strategic partner, providing insight, leadership, and execution support across divisional and property-wide priorities

 **Qualifications**

**What will you bring to this role?**

* Significant senior-level Food & Beverage leadership experience within luxury hotels and/or resorts
* Proven experience managing complex, multi-outlet F&B operations with a strong understanding of commercial strategy and operational performance
* Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into measurable revenue, profitability, service, and operational outcomes
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, cost management, and performance optimisation
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and empower diverse leadership teams within a high-performance environment
* Strong understanding of luxury guest expectations, service excellence, F&B trends, and market positioning
* Experience in developing concepts, driving innovation, and identifying new revenue opportunities
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across executive and operational teams
* Strong analytical, decision-making, communication, and strategic planning capabilities
* Relevant hospitality, business, or Food & Beverage qualification, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and demonstrated professional experience
* Embrace the Raffles & Fairmont brand promise and luxury in your role and in all your interactions
* Foster an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued and respected
* Create an environment where colleagues are empowered, supported and recognized

  
**Additional Information**

**Employee Benefits**  
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

**Our Values**

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.

Empowerment: We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.

Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

Title: Assistant Cultural Programme Manager
Description:
**ABOUT US**  
  
The Arts Club Dubai is perfectly located in the heart of the DIFC, set over four floors and totaling 65,000 square feet, in the brand-new ICD Brookfield Place development designed by Foster + Partners.  
  
It is the first international outpost of the celebrated and historical private members’ club, established in 1863 in Mayfair, London. The Club’s membership is a growing community of like-minded, diverse and dynamic people, all hailing from different cultures and sectors, from the region and further afield.  
  
A lifestyle for our members.  
  
The Club provides its members with a home away from home: a sanctuary for those seeking comfort, hospitality and elegance, with a level of quality, service and attention to detail that will leave them wanting for nothing.  
  
The Arts Club Dubai unveils an amazing opportunity for a talented artisan to join our passionate and creative team.  
The Assistant Cultural Programme Manager will support the planning, development, and execution of a highly engaging and diverse programme of events for Members, both within and outside the Club. The role encompasses creative, logistical, and administrative responsibilities, ensuring that programming initiatives align with brand values, foster member engagement, and enhance the overall membership experience.

**WHAT WILL YOU DO**  
  
Your main duties and responsibilities are:

  

* Support the Head of Cultural Programming in devising, planning, and delivering a dynamic programme of talks, debates, performances, workshops, and events covering art, science, politics, business, fashion, music, technology, and current affairs.
* Assist in curating events that appeal to varied demographics while maintaining cultural integrity and brand alignment.
* Contribute creative and original ideas for programming themes, speaker selection, member experiences, and new formats, ensuring the calendar remains relevant, inspiring, and distinctive.
* Demonstrate leadership and initiative during event planning and onsite execution, guiding junior staff and working collaboratively with internal teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and timelines, ensuring preparation, communication, and delivery are completed with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail.
* Coordinate event logistics, including scheduling, equipment, vendor liaison, and set-up requirements, ensuring smooth execution on-site and off-site.
* Liaise with internal teams (Marketing, Private Events, Membership, F&B, Operations) to ensure seamless coordination and effective promotion of events.
* Compile and share programming content with the Marketing team for newsletters, website, social media, and printed event booklets.
* Actively build and maintain strong professional networks with speakers, artists, thought-leaders, cultural institutions, partners, sponsors, and members to enhance programming opportunities.
* Engage with members during events, fostering a welcoming environment and collecting informal feedback to inform future programming decisions.
* Attend and support all cultural programme events, representing the Club and ensuring smooth delivery.
* Maintain programming databases, organize and record team meetings, and track event planning timelines.
* Monitor RSVPs, attendance, and participation; prepare progress and event performance reports, including analysis of demographic engagement.
* Assist with budget preparation, cost control, invoice processing, and revenue/costing reports for events.
* Contribute to the development of podcasts, digital extensions, or similar initiatives to increase engagement and member value.
* Suggest ongoing improvements to enhance the cultural programme and overall member experience.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**  
  
The successful candidate will have the following experience and skills:

* Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in cultural programming.
* Strong understanding of local culture, traditions, and heritage.
* Experience in cultural events, workshops, and activities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to engage guests and create meaningful cultural experiences.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities.

* Collaboration skills to work with local artists, instructors, and partners.
* Ability to handle scheduling and logistics smoothly.
* Problem-solving skills and flexibility during live events.
* Strong presentation and storytelling abilities.
* Ability to train or brief team members on cultural activities.

* Comfort with administrative tasks and documentation.
* Ability to work evenings, weekends, or event-based hours.
* Positive attitude and passion for culture and guest interaction.
* Professional appearance and behaviour.

The Arts Club Dubai is offering a competitive and attractive remuneration and benefits package.

Title: Assistant Manager - Inflight
Description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

Why Inflight Services?

Our customers choose United because of our dedication to safety and passion for service. United's Inflight Services team is made up of diverse, driven individuals working together to Connect People and Unite the World. From operational leadership and crew planning to safety and service procedures, our Inflight Services team provides the innovative approaches, tools, training and guidance needed for our flight attendants to deliver the best possible customer experience, and aid in our mission to become the best airline in the history of aviation.

Reports to the Operations Manager and supports the Base Leader as required for all organizational goals within the Inflight division. Coordinates the implementation of safety policies and procedures, securing relationships and support from other organizations / divisions as necessary to support objectives.

Specific emphasis is on providing local management with information and practices that enable a reduction of operational disruptions and increase in Net Promotor scores. Ensures consistent implementation of standard safety and Inflight objectives. Work with station(s) to determine root cause of operational disruptions, aircraft damage incidents and share lessons learned. Work with Inflight Management to ensure adherence to regulatory practices and PSA briefing items. Work with other divisions (Flight operations, Airport operations, Safety) to resolve cross-departmental issues. Coordinate the implementation of consistent Inflight Operation functions across all bases

**Job overview and responsibilities**

* Provides support to the Operations Managers in supervising all areas of the operation within an area of United’s airport operation (multiple gates), communicating with internal stakeholders, and supporting United’s core4 values through critical decision-making
* Identify and address flight-level issues/exceptions related to Inflight, PSA, baggage processes, customer boarding, net promotor scores, catering, and general FA concerns
* Identify irregularities such as IFDM alerts, ATC/WX issues, medical emergencies, major/minor flight alerts, and staffing issues and work with the SOC and scheduling to resolve
* Coordinate, communicate, and partner with team members across United’s operation via phone, radio, and messaging services to escalate and resolve critical issues
* Work with all stakeholders to ensure Inflight priorities and initiatives are maintained

Title: Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager, you will help deliver the core infrastructure behind Microsoft's online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Azure. Our infrastructure spans over 200 datacenters and 1 million servers, supporting more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. With a focus on environmental sustainability, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands, maintaining Microsoft's position as a world-class cloud provider.

Data Center Operations Construction (DCOC) delivers complex construction and retrofit programs inside live, operational datacenters. The work spans capacity additions, mechanical and electrical equipment replacement, end-of-life remediation, network and deployment enablement, and first-of-kind retrofits, all executed without interrupting the customer availability the sites exist to provide.

The Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager owns the Operations Construction portfolio across a group of assigned metros. Where metro program managers deliver the projects in front of them, this role decides what that portfolio contains: which work advances, which is deferred, which is stopped, and in what order, across metros competing for the same capital, outage windows, vendor capacity, and site operations bandwidth. Accountability sits with the health of the multi-metro portfolio as a whole rather than with any single project inside it.

The role leads the program managers and contract construction and safety managers working across those metros, and is measured on their capability and consistency as much as on delivered projects. It carries the most complex work in its portfolio, including first-of-kind retrofits in live space where no established execution method exists, and converts that work into standards and practice the wider program adopts. Reporting to the Director of Operations Construction, this position represents DCOC to site leadership, engineering, commissioning, and enterprise customer programs.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead portfolio strategy and prioritization across assigned metros, translating capacity, availability, sustainability, and business objectives into executable construction plans while balancing capital, resources, outage windows, vendor capacity, and operational constraints.
* Own portfolio delivery and governance across safety, scope, schedule, budget, commercial performance, and risk, including forecasting, change management, project controls, commissioning readiness, operational turnover, and closeout.
* Exercise independent judgment on complex, high-impact programs, assessing project viability, investment trade-offs, emerging risks, and delivery confidence, and personally leading the most complex, first-of-kind, or highest-risk initiatives when warranted.

* Model and champion a safety-first, accountable culture while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values, holding internal teams and external partners to high standards for safety, security, availability, operational excellence, and responsible delivery.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 15+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 17+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.

* 12+ years of experience in construction management, datacenter operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or program management
* 6+ years of experience managing complex project or program portfolios across multiple sites, metros, or regions
* Experience delivering construction in live, mission-critical environments while maintaining operational availability
* Experience leading first-of-kind, accelerated, or high-risk projects with accountability for safety, cost, schedule, and risk
* Experience leading and developing teams, including employees, contractors, and cross-functional resources

FOR MORE THAN 80 YEARS, Natus has been committed to serving the varying needs of clinicians, delivering the highest-quality solutions to raise the standard of care for patients everywhere.
  
  
Our comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic sensory solutions are designed to simplify workflows for sensory specialists, ensuring care teams have the right instrumentation to give patients the right support — and greater peace of mind.
  
  
We are seeking a customer-focused, results-oriented leader to lead our Global Customer Service organization and continuously improve how we support our customers. This individual will be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience while driving process improvements, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness with team members spread out across different geographies including North America, Europe, India and Australia.
  
The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who puts the customer first, challenges the status quo, and looks for better and more efficient ways of working. This role will partner closely with Sales and Supply Chain to improve the end-to-end customer experience and explore opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and AI to modernize customer service operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Customer Experience & Advocacy
  

* Champion a customer-first culture, ensuring customer needs and feedback are represented in business decisions.
* Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, service levels, responsiveness, and issue resolution.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and partner across the organization to deliver meaningful, lasting solutions.

Process Improvement & Efficiency
  

* Continuously evaluate and improve customer service processes to simplify workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.
* Leverage data and performance metrics to identify opportunities and drive measurable improvements.
* Explore automation and technology solutions to reduce manual work and create a more efficient, scalable operation.

Cross-Functional Partnership
  

* Build strong partnerships with Sales and Supply Chain to align priorities and deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Collaborate to resolve customer challenges, improve service performance, and address opportunities across the order-to-delivery process.
* Bring the voice of the customer into cross-functional discussions and drive shared accountability for customer outcomes.

Innovation & Team Leadership
  

* Lead, develop, and engage a Customer Service team of approximately 20 associates globally focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate curiosity and interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve processes, enhance customer interactions, and transform how customer service operates.
* Encourage new ideas and support the adoption of better ways of working.

Qualifications & Experience
  

* 8+ years of experience in Customer Service, Customer Experience, or Operations, with demonstrated leadership experience in customer direct and distributor channel environments.
* Global leadership experience managing directly and indirectly organizations.
* Proven ability to improve processes, drive operational efficiency, and deliver a strong customer experience.
* Experience partnering across functions, particularly Sales and Supply Chain.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and people leadership skills.
* Interest or experience in leveraging technology, automation, and AI to improve business processes.
* A collaborative, forward-thinking leader who is comfortable driving change and challenging existing ways of working.

At Natus, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range.

Title: Customer Service Lead Representitive - Cigna Healthcare
Description:
About Cigna Healthcare
  
  
Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company dedicated to transforming healthcare. With roots in the U.S. and operations in over 30 countries, we serve more than 180 million customers and patients worldwide. Ranked 14th on the Fortune 500 in 2026, Cigna is recognised as one of the most trusted and influential names in the industry.
  
Our mission is to improve the health, well-being, and peace of mind of those we serve.
  
Youll join a globally recognised organisation where trust, clear communication, and a positive culture shape how we work. Our leaders are consistent, approachable, and supportive, helping you maintain balance while doing meaningful work.
  
We look for people who thrive in collaborative environments, care about meaningful change, and want to grow in a company that puts people first. At Cigna Healthcare, your work contributes to better care experiences and supports customers through important moments in their lives.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Customer Service Lead Representative plays a critical role in supporting the delivery of exceptional customer service across member, provider, client, and broker interactions while providing day-to-day operational support within the contact centre.
  
This role serves as a senior technical and operational resource, managing complex enquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery activities while helping ensure service continuity, workload visibility, and adherence to service standards.
  
Working closely with the Customer Service Manager, the Customer Service Lead Representative provides floor support, operational guidance, and knowledge sharing to Customer Service Representatives, helping to drive service quality and operational effectiveness.
  
This is not a formal people management role and does not include employee performance management, disciplinary authority, or approval responsibilities.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  

* Investigate and resolve complex customer enquiries, complaints, appeals, and escalated service issues across calls, emails, and written correspondence.
* Act as the primary operational and technical escalation point for cases requiring advanced research, coordination, policy interpretation, or procedural guidance.
* Interpret policy provisions, benefits, procedures, and operational requirements to determine appropriate solutions and escalation pathways.
* Maintain end-to-end ownership of escalated cases, ensuring timely resolution, accurate documentation, proactive follow-up, and clear customer communication.
* Support service recovery activities by managing customer expectations, coordinating corrective actions, and ensuring customer concerns are effectively addressed.
* Collaborate with Health Plans, Claims, Approvals, Service Centres, Providers, IT, and other stakeholders to facilitate prompt resolution of customer issues.
* Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders while supporting a seamless customer experience.
* Monitor service queues, pending inventories, backlogs, ageing cases, and service-level risks, escalating concerns appropriately to the Customer Service Supervisor.
* Support workload coordination and operational prioritisation based on customer impact, service commitments, and business requirements.
* Ensure effective shift handovers through accurate communication of priority cases, unresolved issues, and operational updates.
* Assist with the preparation of operational updates, service-level reports, escalation summaries, workload status reports, and risk visibility reporting.
* Identify recurring service issues, root causes, process gaps, and customer experience challenges, providing recommendations for improvement.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives, onboarding activities, refresher training sessions, process enhancements, and quality improvement programmes.
* Support quality assurance reviews, compliance activities, audits, and operational governance requirements.
* Maintain accurate customer records and ensure all activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, confidentiality obligations, information security standards, and data privacy requirements.
* Continue supporting core customer service activities during periods of high contact volumes, operational peaks, and business-critical events.
* Provide designated operational support coverage during the absence of the Customer Service Manager while remaining within the roles defined authority limits.

What Youll Bring
  
  

* Diploma or Bachelors degree, preferably in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Customer Service Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in customer service, member services, client services, call centre/contact centre operations, or a related customer support environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex customer enquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery situations.
* Experience within the healthcare insurance industry is strongly preferred; experience within insurance, managed care, banking, financial services, or third-party administration environments will also be considered.
* Strong understanding of contact centre operations, service levels, escalation management, workload prioritisation, case ownership, and queue management principles.
* Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain service quality under pressure.
* Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts in line with business requirements.

Skills
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with customers and stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with sound judgement and professionalism in sensitive or challenging situations.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with the ability to make decisions within established guidelines.
* Excellent organisational, prioritisation, and time-management skills.
* Ability to guide, coach, and influence colleagues through expertise and collaboration rather than formal authority.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* High levels of accountability, ownership, and attention to detail.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities, operational demands, and business needs.

Technical / Functional Skills
  
  

* Strong knowledge of customer service operations, escalation management, complaint resolution, and service recovery principles.
* Ability to accurately interpret insurance policies, customer benefits, procedures, and operational requirements.
* Understanding of contact centre performance metrics, including service levels, turnaround times, quality scores, response times, customer satisfaction, and productivity measures.
* Experience monitoring queues, workloads, pending inventories, backlogs, and operational performance risks.
* Ability to identify trends, root causes, operational gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience using CRM systems, customer service platforms, and case management tools.
* Strong multitasking capability within a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment.
* Ability to maintain accurate case records, escalation logs, operational updates, and customer interaction documentation.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge of healthcare insurance operations, medical terminology, and healthcare service delivery models.
* Experience supporting onboarding, floor support, knowledge-sharing, quality calibration, or process improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing service-level reports, operational dashboards, workload updates, or escalation reporting.
* Familiarity with complaint management frameworks, quality improvement methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.

Why Join Us
  
  

* Competitive salary aligned with market benchmarks.
* Multicultural and collaborative working environment.
* Private Medical Insurance.
* Employee Wellbeing Benefits.
* Educational Development Program supporting continuous learning and professional growth.

About The Cigna Group
  
  
Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Through our divisions Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Title: Manager, Customer Service & Operations
Description:
Exciting leadership opportunity for an experienced customer service and operations professional to lead teams, strengthen operational performance, and drive service excellence in a 24/7 environment!

**The Opportunity**

The Talent Company is conducting a
**confidential search**
on behalf of an established organization seeking an experienced Manager, Customer Service & Operations.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on leader who is passionate about developing people, improving customer experiences, and driving operational excellence.

The successful candidate will oversee customer service and centralized operations functions, balancing day-to-day service delivery with employee development, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**The Impact You Will Have**

As the Manager, Customer Service & Operations, you will provide leadership to teams responsible for customer inquiries, service requests, operational monitoring, incident management, and escalations.

You will oversee approximately 10 to 20 employees within a unionized environment, supporting consistent service delivery and operational readiness across a 24/7 operation.

Your impact will extend beyond daily operations. You will strengthen employee engagement, build accountability, improve processes, and support the implementation of new technologies and systems.

This opportunity is ideal for a collaborative, people-focused leader who can build trust with experienced employees while confidently navigating change, performance management, and complex operational challenges.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead customer service and centralized operations functions, ensuring efficient service delivery and operational performance.
* Oversee customer inquiries, complaints, service requests, payment-related issues, and escalations across multiple communication channels.
* Manage operational monitoring, incident response, dispatch coordination, and work order processes.
* Ensure operational readiness through effective workforce planning, scheduling, staffing, and performance monitoring.
* Provide hands-on leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management to employees in a unionized environment.
* Address employee relations matters, including attendance, discipline, and performance concerns, in collaboration with Human Resources.
* Interpret and apply collective agreements, organizational policies, and relevant employment legislation.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external service providers to resolve operational issues and service disruptions.
* Provide leadership during emergencies, system outages, and other time-sensitive operational situations.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators, including customer satisfaction, service levels, response times, and operational performance.
* Analyze operational data to identify trends, service gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, quality assurance processes, training resources, and operational documentation.
* Support the implementation of new technologies, customer service platforms, and process improvements.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Foster a positive, inclusive, and accountable team culture while maintaining compliance with applicable health and safety requirements.

**What You Will Bring**

* Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Operations Management, Customer Service, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 5 years of leadership experience, including at least 3 years in a high-volume call center, contact center, customer service, or comparable service environment.
* A minimum of 3 years of supervisory or management experience in a unionized environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading customer service teams, managing operational escalations, and maintaining service standards.
* Strong knowledge of workforce management, scheduling, quality assurance, customer service metrics, and performance reporting.
* Proven ability to coach, mentor, engage, and develop employees while addressing performance concerns and difficult conversations.
* Working knowledge of collective agreements, labor relations, employment legislation, and workplace health and safety requirements.
* Experience using CRM systems, telephony platforms, workforce management tools, and operational reporting systems.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands.
* A hands-on, approachable leadership style with the ability to build trust and credibility among experienced employees.
* Adaptability and patience when introducing new technologies, processes, and organizational changes.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make timely decisions in complex or high-pressure situations.

**The following would be considered assets:**

* Experience in large-scale customer service or operational environments.
* Exposure to dispatch operations, incident management, facility monitoring, or operational control centers.
* Experience supporting technology modernization, process improvements, or customer service transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with CRM, ERP, or similar business management systems.

**Work Environment**

* Full-time, permanent opportunity based in GTA, Ontario.
* Five days onsite.
* Regular work schedule of Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with some flexibility in start and end times.
* The position supports a 24/7 operation and may require occasional after-hours or weekend availability for emergencies and escalations.
* Opportunity to lead an established team in a collaborative, customer-focused environment.

If you are a hands-on customer service leader who enjoys developing people, solving operational challenges, and improving service delivery, we invite you to apply.

Title: Head of Corporate Finance & Credit Control
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182711

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

**Overview of the role**
  
Lead the corporate finance, new business and credit control agenda for Automotive across UAE and overseas operations. You will safeguard liquidity, optimize working capital and evaluate strategic investments while maintaining robust credit governance. This role balances commercial growth with funding capacity, collectability and risk-adjusted returns.

  

**What you will do**
  

* Lead liquidity planning, cash-flow forecasting and working-capital improvements across inventory, receivables and payables.
* Partner with Treasury, Tax, FP&A and business teams on cash conversion, funding requirements and currency exposures.
* Evaluate investments and capital expenditure through financial modelling, valuation, scenario analysis and post-investment reviews.
* Develop business cases for new businesses, market entries, partnerships, joint ventures and acquisitions, supporting due diligence, transaction structuring and approvals.
* Own credit-risk governance, including customer assessment, credit limits, payment terms, securities and exception management.
* Improve receivables and collections performance through portfolio reviews, dispute resolution and recovery escalation.
* Maintain effective policies, controls, approval standards and management reporting.
* Lead and develop the team, driving digitalization, analytics and continuous improvement.

  

**Required skills to be successful**
  

* Strong expertise in corporate finance, cash-flow forecasting, working-capital management and investment appraisal.
* Advanced financial modelling, valuation and business-case development capabilities.
* Sound knowledge of credit assessment, security structures, receivables analytics and collections governance.
* Commercial judgement and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear executive recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation-support skills.
* Collaborative leadership, constructive challenge, integrity and delivery discipline.

  

**About the team**
  
Reporting to the General Manager – Divisional Finance, you will lead a team with five direct reports within Automotive Finance, supporting UAE and overseas operations. You will work closely with the Automotive CFO, business leaders, FP&A, Group Finance, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Internal Audit and shared services, alongside external advisers, lenders and partners where relevant.

  

**What equips you for the role**
  

* Chartered Accountant, CPA, CFA, ACCA, MBA in Finance, or an equivalent professional qualification.
* 10 to 15 years of relevant finance experience, including leadership responsibility in corporate finance, treasury-facing roles, investments, new business, credit risk or collections governance.
* Demonstrated experience in financial modelling, business-case development, liquidity management, senior approvals and cross-functional collaboration.
* Treasury exposure covering cash forecasting, currency exposures and funding requests to a group treasury function.
* Experience owning or governing a customer credit framework, including risk appetite, limits, securities, delegated authority and portfolio reporting.
* Working knowledge of IFRS, funding concepts, transaction evaluation and enterprise finance systems; advanced Excel and SAP experience preferred.
* Experience in automotive, distribution, retail, financial services or another asset- and working-capital-intensive sector is advantageous.

  

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

Title: Director of Finance and Operations
Company: Canadian Aboriginal and Minority Supplier Council
Description:
The Canadian Aboriginal and Minority Supplier Council (CAMSC) is a not-for-profit organization headquartered in Toronto. CAMSC is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Finance & Operations to lead financial management and strengthen organizational operations. The ideal candidate will have senior management experience in a dynamic setting. The role requires outstanding organizational, communication, and leadership skills and an ability to develop innovative solutions that push boundaries.

**Position Summary**

financial management, ensure compliance for grant-funded programs, and oversee daily operations. This senior role combines strategic financial leadership with operational oversight, managing two direct reports, vendor relationships, and execution of annual goals. The ideal candidate will possess the ability to proactively develop multi-year plans to improve efficiency, increase revenue, and reduce costs as needed in accordance with the goals in our Strategic Plan.

**Scope and Responsibilities**

Key responsibilities

* Oversee accounting functions: accounts payable/receivable, payroll oversight, general ledger maintenance, and month-end close.
* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly financial statements to the Executive team.
* Lead annual budget development, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Manage grant financial reporting, restricted fund tracking, compliance, and audit preparation.
* Support fundraising with proposal budgets and sponsorship reporting.
* Implement and maintain internal controls, policies, and financial procedures.
* Supervise two direct reports; hire, train, and manage performance.
* Manage vendor relationships, contracts, procurement, and service-level expectations.
* Oversee day-to-day operations (administrative, IT, vendor services) and drive process improvements.
* Develop and track annual operational goals and lead cross-team projects.
* Responsible for the day-to-day operational activities, including staff financial management, strategic analysis, business planning, funding agreements, and budgeting.
* Overseeing current and future capital planning and projects, including coordination with consultants and internal staff to manage projects, equipment purchases, service contracts, etc.
* Collaborating with senior managers to develop and manage the annual and multi-year budget based on the Strategic Plan, with guidance from the Executive Team. Providing support and guidance to the rest of the management team.
* Overseeing third-party service providers for information technology systems and information management systems.
* Developing and implementing policies and programs for administrative, financial, facility operations, and building security.
* Overseeing and ensuring financial reporting compliance with all granting agencies as appropriate.
* Actively participating in relevant organizational committees.
* Promoting a positive corporate culture, and experienced with employment engagement strategies.
* People leadership accountabilities for managers, contractors, and other positions as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years management experience in finance or operations, including supervising staff.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close, financial statements, budgeting, and forecasting.

* Strong accounting knowledge (GAAP familiarity preferred).
* Demonstrated vendor/contract management and operational process-improvement experience.
* Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar) and Excel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field required.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills for non-finance audiences and boards.
* Commitment to CAMSC’s mission and values.

Preferred
