Title: Customer Success Manager - Finance/Accounting
Description:
**Join Teleperformance – Where Excellence Meets Opportunity!**

Teleperformance is a leading provider of customer experience management, offering premier omnichannel support to top global companies. Our diverse service locations, including on-site and work-at-home programs, ensure flexibility and broad reach.

**Why Choose Teleperformance?**

We emphasize the importance of our employees, fostering enduring relationships within our teams and communities. Our dedication to employee satisfaction distinguishes us.

Utilize advanced support technologies and processes engineered to achieve outstanding results.

We cultivate lasting client relationships and make positive contributions to our local communities.

**Become Part of an Exceptional Team!**

Join Teleperformance, where our world-class workforce and innovative solutions drive success. Experience a workplace that values your development, supports your goals, and celebrates your accomplishments.

**Job Description**

**About Us**

TP is a worldwide leader in client experience management, digital business services, and strategic contact center outsourcing. With more than 500,000 employees globally, TP combines high-performing on-site infrastructure with cutting-edge remote delivery models, providing support across 300 languages and dialects. Consistently recognized in Fortune Magazine's Top 25 World's Best Workplaces in partnership with Great Place to Work®, TP empowers enterprise technology partners to scale strategic go-to-market and partner success operations seamlessly across premier global markets.

**Our Work Culture**

At TP, we remain true to our core values of integrity, respect, professionalism, innovation, and commitment:

* **Autonomous:** We encourage and trust your independent judgment to prioritize high-leverage interventions across your portfolio.
* **Progressive Work Environment:** Clear vertical and horizontal growth pathways backed by structured coaching and tier-readiness programs.
* **Flexible & Impact-Driven:** We emphasize tangible outcomes, commercial retention, and partner health over activity volume.
* **Innovative:** Every idea matters—we empower operators to build new 0-to-1 playbooks and optimize operational workflows.
* **Inclusive:** A collaborative global culture where diverse perspectives are celebrated and everyone wins together.

**About the job**

As a Partner Customer Success Manager (PCSM), you are the dedicated post-sales commercial owner and strategic platform advisor for a high-value portfolio of 150–250 accounting firms, bookkeepers, and fractional CFOs. Within our partner GTM model, this segment represents highly defensible recurring revenue and the foundation of end-client subscription adoption. In this role, you protect the partner book against competitor migration, accelerate multi-product adoption (including Core Accounting, Payroll, Payments, Expense Management, Time, and Accountant Suites), and empower advisory firms to scale their practices efficiently.  
  
You operate through a proven Scaled Success motion—pairing an annual scheduled value cadence with real-time, signal-triggered 1:1 interventions and digital 1:many leverage. This is a high-impact role combining consultative account stewardship, data-driven prioritization, and authentic domain credibility.

*Competitive annual base salary, 60,000 Annual CAD, commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive performance-based incentive programs tied to portfolio retention, expansion ARR, and partner health metrics with an annual OTE of up to 10%.*

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

The Partner Customer Success Manager executes across four strategic pillars to drive partner health, revenue retention, and ecosystem expansion:

* **Scaled Portfolio Management & Cadence:** Own and manage a designated portfolio of 150–250 accounting, bookkeeping, and advisory firms as their primary post-sales point of contact; execute structured annual value reviews supported by automated mid-year health check-ins.
* **Signal-Triggered Rapid Intervention:** Monitor CRM health metrics, engagement indicators, and platform telemetry in real time; proactively intervene 1:1 whenever risk triggers fire (e.g., stalled client onboarding, platform usage drops, or competitor migration signals).
* **Revenue Defense & Churn Prevention:** Protect whole-book partner relationships to prevent silent attrition of entire underlying client subscriptions, developing proactive recovery playbooks for accounts showing disengagement or decline.

Title: Americas Logistics- Delivery Exception Manager
Description:
Summary
  
  
Every Apple product is a promise to a customer. When that promise breaks somewhere between our dock and their door, we find out why, and we make sure it doesn't happenagain. The AMR Delivery Exception Management (DEM) team protects Apple's customers and bottom line by turning exception, loss, and claims trends into lasting fixes across our carrier network. We are looking for a strategic leader who looks beyond today's cases, using trend analysis to anticipate where losses will occur and driving the process andcommercial changes that prevent them across the Americas network. You will own the DEM strategy and roadmap for the Americas, lead a team of analysts, and represent DEM with senior leaders across Logistics, Finance, Product Security,AppleCare, and our carrier partners. You will lead the business side of a next-generation platform that automates investigations and standardizes how exceptions are handled,using it to shift the team's capacity from case work to prevention. If you build strong teams, follow the data to the root cause, and can change minds in difficult conversations,we'd love to hear from you!
  
  
Description
  
  
Own the Americas DEM strategy, multi-year roadmap, and results for exception management, carrier claims and recovery, and loss investigations, including budget,methods, and staffing. Set operating objectives, performance standards, and a tiered review cadence for exceptions, claims, and loss, with clear owners and success criteria. Own exception, claims, and credit policies that affect DEM and the wider Apple logistics network, and make the call on DEM operational decisions and escalations. Define and publish the DEM scorecard, including exception rate, loss and credit exposure, claims recovery, claim cycle time, and repeat defects. Shift the team from reactive case resolution to predictive, upstream prevention, using trend analysis to anticipate emerging risks and building fixes into process, policy,training, and carrier commercial terms. Lead carrier performance and commercial management, including quarterly business reviews, recovery targets, claims settlement and liability terms, and joint data visibility. Partner with Product Security on high-value shipment risk, theft and loss trends, carrier vetting, and freight security controls. Own a next-generation exception management platform and automation roadmap from the business side. You will connect data across order, shipment, carrier, claims, andservice systems, drive adoption across sites and carriers, and lead ongoing enhancements. Serve as DEM's point of contact for Logistics Operations, Finance, AppleCare, Reseller, Retail, and carrier partners, and represent DEM in senior management and executivereviews, bringing recommendations and decisions, not just performance updates. Lead DEM readiness for peak events such as New Product Introductions and Order By Deliver By, and partner with Inventory Control on shared root causes andcross-coverage. Hire, develop, and coach analysts, building bench strength through cross-training and rotation, and growing senior analysts to lead work streams. What Success Looks Like (6 to 12 Months) -A consistent review cadence runs with clear owners and documented root-cause closure. -The weekly DEM scorecard shows measurable improvement in loss exposure, claims recovery, and repeat defects. -At least one top recurring failure mode has been fixed upstream through a process or commercial change with a carrier or logistics partner. -The next-generation platform is delivered on plan, and automation is returning measurable analyst hours to prevention work. -The team operates as one cross-trained Americas function, with documented SOPs and a development plan for every team member. -You are DEM's senior leader for the Americas, owning strategy, executive reviews, carrier escalations, and the platform roadmap from start to finish.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 10 or more years of experience in Transportation, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations, including 5 or more years of people leadership.
* Proven experience leading logistics or supply chain operations teams, ideally in delivery exception management, carrier claims, loss prevention, or freight security.
* Track record of setting strategy and objectives, managing budgets and staffing, and running multi-site or multi-carrier programs with clear cadence and governance.
* Deep end-to-end knowledge of inbound, outbound, forward, and reverse logistics, and of how carrier, claims, and service processes connect.
* Strong data judgment, using trend analysis to anticipate risk, find root causes, and quantify financial exposure, with comfort reviewing technical queries and BI dashboards.
* Experience negotiating commercial terms with carriers or vendors, such as claims settlement, liability, or service-level agreements.
* Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence senior leaders, carriers, and partners in sensitive situations while preserving the relationship.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Experience leading automation, agentic workflows, or systems integration projects with IT, from requirements through adoption.
* Lean Six Sigma or equivalent continuous improvement experience.
* Background supporting Reseller, Retail, and Online channels across a multi-DC footprint.
* Familiarity with inventory control or reconciliation.

**Events**

Title: Director, Pharmacy Operations
Description:
**About Pillway:**

Pillway is Canada’s pharmacy infrastructure company. We operate licensed pharmacies in Ontario, British Columbia and Manitoba and power digital pharmacy programs for some of the country’s largest health insurers. Patients get their medications delivered to their door. Our partners get a pharmacy experience under their own brand. Behind both sits one operation that has to run with precision every day. We are scaling that operation, and this role is the person who runs it.

**The Role:**

This is a hands-on operating role, not an oversight role. You own day-to-day pharmacy operations across all three provinces, from prescription intake and processing through dispensing, packaging, fulfillment and shipping. You lead the Pharmacy Managers at each site and our intake and processing team, you build the operating model that every site runs on, and you own the numbers.

You report to the Chief Administrative Officer and work alongside the Chief Pharmacist and the Director of Pharmacy Compliance. Dispensing and clinical governance remain with the Pharmacy Managers as Designated Managers at each site. Your job is to build and run the operation so they can do theirs well.

**What you will own:**

* **Daily operations across Ontario, BC and Manitoba.** Intake, processing, adjudication, dispensing, packaging, fulfillment and shipping, on time and accurate, every day.
* **The team.** The Pharmacy Managers at each site and the Intake and Processing team lead report to you. You hire, set expectations, develop people and manage performance.
* **The operating model.** Workflows, SOPs, templates, handoffs and role definitions. You build it, document it and make it consistent across every site.
* **Throughput and service levels.** Turnaround time, same-day fulfillment, accuracy and rework, and the daily rhythm that keeps work moving through the day instead of piling up at the end of it.
* **Staffing and capacity.** Scheduling, shift coverage, pharmacist-to-assistant ratios and labour productivity.
* **The numbers.** Operational KPIs, the dashboard, and a daily and weekly operating cadence. You own the metrics and the improvement plans behind them.
* **Automation and systems.** Kroll workflow, automated dispensing (Parata, PacMed) and the operations side of new tooling, in partnership with our product and engineering teams.
* **Operational vendors.** Couriers and logistics, packaging, automation and equipment: service levels and operational cost. You also hold a seat in formulary and purchasing discussions led by the Chief Pharmacist and CAO.
* **Patient experience, from the operations side.** Work with our Customer Experience team on escalations, handoffs and response standards so pharmacy teams stay on their core work and patients get answers fast.
* **Compliance.** With the Pharmacy Managers and the Director of Pharmacy Compliance, keep every site within provincial college requirements and our quality standards.
* **Partners.** Contribute to service reporting and operational escalations for our insurer partners through the CAO, with more direct involvement as the role matures.

**Your first 90 days:**

* **First 30:** on the floor every day. Learn the flow end to end, meet every team, baseline the numbers.
* **By 60:** operating model documented, leads aligned, KPI dashboard live, daily cadence running.
* **By 90:** measurable improvement in turnaround and accuracy, and a plan to standardize the model across all sites.

**What you bring:**

* **Licensed pharmacist** in good standing with a provincial college of pharmacists. Ontario required; eligibility to register in BC and Manitoba is an asset
* 6+ years of progressive pharmacy operations experience, including leading managers across multiple sites or in a high-volume central-fill or fulfillment pharmacy.
* **Hands-on Kroll experience and experience with pharmacy automation** (Parata, PacMed or equivalent). Required.
* You have built or rebuilt an operation: designed the workflows, written the SOPs, restructured a team and delivered measurable results. Not just managed one that was already running.
* Strong in workflow design, capacity planning, performance management and change management.
* Comfortable on the floor, comfortable with data, direct in how you communicate.
* An asset: centralized dispensing, mail-order or technology-enabled pharmacy; experience working alongside product and engineering teams.

**How we work:**

We are a growing company and this seat carries real authority and real accountability. Decisions get made quickly, with data, and reviewed in 90-day cycles. If you are looking for a title, this is not it. If you want to build the operation that a national digital pharmacy runs on, it is.

### **Our Commitment to You**

Pillway supports a workforce of diverse backgrounds and encompasses policies and initiatives designed to help all employees feel welcomed and well-equipped to succeed. We are an inclusive employer and provide accommodations for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if you require accommodation.

*Note: We appreciate every application we receive, but due to our overwhelming response, we will only be able to contact those who are under consideration for the position.*

**Disclosure:** We use AI tools to assist with screening and evaluating application

The Director establishes, implements, and enforces comprehensive safety and security policies, procedures, and operational standards consistent with Pyramid Global Hospitality (PGH) expectations and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

As a member of the resort's leadership team, the Director collaborates with executive leadership and departmental leaders to promote accountability, regulatory compliance, proactive risk prevention, and a culture of safety.

  
  

The Director serves as a primary liaison with local law enforcement, fire departments, emergency medical services, and other public safety agencies.

  
  

Through professional leadership, sound judgment, and a People First approach, the Director ensures that safety and security remain essential priorities in the overall guest and Curator experience.

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Public Safety, Emergency Management, Security Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant training and professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive leadership experience in security, law enforcement, public safety, or a related field, preferably within a large hotel, resort, entertainment venue, or hospitality operation.
* Demonstrated experience managing security personnel, departmental operations, emergency response programs, and workplace safety initiatives.
* Relevant certifications in CPR, First Aid, life safety, or emergency response.
* Strong knowledge of investigative procedures, incident documentation, report writing, evidence preservation, and corrective action recommendations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, security management systems, surveillance technology, and electronic reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of fire protection systems, access control, surveillance equipment, keyless entry systems, and emergency communication procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold team members accountable while maintaining a positive and professional working environment.
* Knowledge of applicable OSHA requirements and federal, state, and local safety regulations.

**Leadership & Performance Standards**
--------------------------------------

### **1. Strategic Safety & Security Leadership**

* Provide executive-level direction and oversight of the resort's Safety & Security Department.
* Establish and maintain comprehensive security procedures designed to protect guests, Curators, resort assets, and property.
* Develop and implement preventive security measures to identify, assess, and reduce operational risks.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the resort, promoting safety awareness, professionalism, and operational accountability.
* Collaborate with resort executive leadership to evaluate security needs, operational challenges, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure departmental practices align with Pyramid Global Hospitality policies, operating standards, and organizational values.

### **2. Emergency Preparedness & Crisis Management**

* Direct the development, implementation, and continuous evaluation of the resort's emergency response procedures.
* Coordinate emergency preparedness activities, including fire drills, evacuation exercises, alarm testing, and emergency response simulations.
* Maintain effective working relationships with law enforcement, fire departments, emergency medical services, and other public safety partners.
* Provide leadership and coordination during emergencies, critical incidents, and situations requiring immediate protective action.
* Ensure timely notification and escalation of significant incidents to resort executive leadership and other appropriate stakeholders.
* Evaluate emergency response outcomes and recommend procedural improvements to strengthen operational readiness.

### **3. Incident Management & Investigations**

* Oversee the timely and accurate documentation, investigation, and reporting of guest and Curator incidents, accidents, complaints, and security concerns.
* Conduct or direct internal and external investigations within the scope of departmental authority and in coordination with Human Resources and executive leadership when appropriate.
* Ensure investigative records are factual, objective, confidential, and maintained according to company procedures.
* Review Security Officer daily activity reports, incident reports, and investigation findings to identify trends and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Human Resources on employee-related investigations, workplace conduct concerns, and disciplinary recommendations.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and communication concerning incidents that may present legal, financial, operational, or reputational risks.

### **4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Prevention**

* Support compliance with applicable OSHA standards, life safety requirements, fire prevention procedures, and other relevant regulatory obligations.
* Participate in safety committee activities, hazard identification initiatives, inspections, and workplace accident prevention programs.
* Identify unsafe conditions and ensure timely reporting, corrective action, and appropriate escalation.
* Maintain accurate departmental records involving inspections, licenses, certifications, and applicable service contracts.
* Partner with Human Resources, Engineering, and resort leadership to support workplace injury prevention and workers' compensation risk reduction.
* Evaluate existing safety and security programs and recommend improvements to minimize incidents and operational exposure.

### **5. Departmental Operations & Asset Protection**

* Direct the daily operations of the Safety & Security Department to ensure effective coverage and operational readiness.
* Oversee security patrols, surveillance activities, facility access, key control, and the protection of resort assets.
* Establish and maintain appropriate security staffing for resort functions, special events, and operational demands.
* Ensure security equipment, technology, supplies, and departmental resources are properly maintained and operational.
* Oversee lost-and-found security procedures in collaboration with Housekeeping and other relevant departments.
* Review staffing schedules, payroll hours, departmental reports, and resource utilization.
* Support responsible financial management while maintaining appropriate security standards.
* Maintain the ability to perform essential departmental functions when operationally necessary.

### **6. People Leadership & Curator Development**

* Lead the recruitment, selection, onboarding, training, supervision, and professional development of Safety & Security personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable for consistently meeting departmental and company standards.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations, coaching discussions, and departmental meetings.
* Administer progressive disciplinary actions in partnership with Human Resources and in accordance with PGH policies.
* Promote a People First leadership culture that values professionalism, fairness, collaboration, and respect.
* Develop supervisory talent through mentoring, cross-training, and succession planning.
* Address workplace concerns promptly, professionally, and consistently.
* Foster a positive working environment that supports employee engagement, retention, and service excellence.

### **7. Guest Experience & Professional Standards**

* Ensure Security personnel provide professional, respectful, and timely assistance to guests and Curators.
* Maintain a calm, approachable, and reassuring presence when addressing sensitive or challenging situations.
* Resolve security-related guest concerns while protecting the safety and interests of all involved parties.
* Uphold company standards regarding appearance, attendance, punctuality, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
* Collaborate with operational departments to support a seamless guest experience without compromising safety requirements.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

**Constantly**

* Direct and oversee effective daily Safety & Security Department operations.
* Conduct or oversee security patrols throughout the resort.
* Enforce established safety, security, and emergency response procedures.
* Maintain effective access control and key management programs.
* Review daily Security Officer shift reports and significant incident documentation.
* Monitor unsafe conditions and ensure timely reporting and escalation.
* Provide leadership, direction, and operational support to departmental personnel.
* Maintain professional communication with resort leadership regarding significant safety and security concerns.

**Frequently**

* Lead the development and implementation of City Operations health, safety and worker welfare governance, translating Strategic Delivery Unit (SDU) policies, standards and guidelines and applicable legal requirements into operational procedures.
* Establish City Operations minimum requirements and contractual schedules for health, safety and worker welfare, ensuring service providers and contractors understand the standards against which their performance will be assured.
* Maintain and improve the health, safety and worker welfare framework as the city asset base, services and workforce expand.
* Define induction, training and competency requirements for City Operations employees and relevant service providers.

**Operational Compliance and Assurance**

* Direct the risk-based assurance programme across City Operations-managed assets, public realm and operational services, covering compliance reviews, inspections, audits and follow-up activities.
* Monitor contractor, operator and service-provider compliance, directing corrective action through the relevant contract and service owners.
* Track performance through incident data, risk registers, permit-to-work compliance, regulatory reporting, leading indicators and corrective-action status.
* Report material risks, non-conformances, trends and overdue actions to leadership, escalating issues affecting people, public safety, compliance or Qiddiya’s reputation.
* Stop unsafe work within the City Operations remit where required and coordinate formal corrective action through the accountable contract holder.

**Worker Welfare Operations**

* Lead oversight of worker welfare conditions for employees and contracted workforces within the City Operations remit, recognising the public-facing nature of operational workers.
* Establish and monitor welfare requirements covering working conditions, welfare facilities, access to support and applicable Saudi labour and welfare requirements.
* Coordinate with workplace, accommodation, contractor and service-provider teams to address welfare risks and escalate unresolved issues.
* Build internal worker welfare capability through recruitment, development and knowledge transfer.

**Environmental Compliance**

* Oversee environmental compliance across City Operations-managed assets, public spaces and service arrangements, focusing on prevention of harm and compliance with approved environmental management plans.
* Establish requirements for pollution prevention and control, including oil and chemical storage, waste handling, noise and nuisance.
* Monitor contractors and service providers against environmental requirements, ensuring incidents, non-conformances and corrective actions are tracked to closure.
* Coordinate environmental reporting and relevant Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) inputs while maintaining the distinction between environmental compliance and broader

sustainability ownership.

**Incident Management and Operational Resilience**

* Provide health, safety, environmental and worker welfare subject-matter expertise to the City Command Unit during incidents, crises and emergency exercises.
* Support the Gold, Silver and Bronze response structure by advising on technical risks, immediate controls, regulatory requirements and recovery actions.
* Develop, maintain and test relevant crisis playbooks in alignment with City Command Unit and Operational Resilience requirements.
* Lead or oversee post-incident and near-miss investigations within the remit, ensuring root causes, lessons learned and preventive actions are embedded.

**Asset Readiness and Handover**

* Define health, safety, environmental and worker welfare requirements for new assets and services entering City Operations, engaging with delivery teams from design through handover.
* Lead readiness reviews from the agreed pre-handover period, validating operational requirements, documentation, controls and service arrangements before go-live.
* Provide functional sign-off and readiness input for handover and takeover processes, escalating unresolved risks through stage-gate and governance forums.
* Work with City Assets Management and delivery teams to transfer defects, risks, warranties, procedures and assurance findings into live operations.

**Stakeholder and Regulatory Coordination**

* Act as the City Operations focal point for health, safety, environmental and worker welfare matters with SDU, City Assets Management, delivery teams, operational functions and central QIC stakeholders.
* Coordinate with contract holders and service providers to embed requirements into scopes of work, mobilization plans, procedures and performance reviews.
* Support engagement with relevant regulators, authorities and emergency-response stakeholders, ensuring submissions, observations and actions are coordinated and closed out.
* Maintain constructive relationships while preserving the professional judgement required to challenge unsafe or non-compliant practices.

**Capability, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead development of the Health, Safety and Worker Welfare team in line with the phased asset handover plan.
* Establish dashboards and management information combining lagging and leading indicators to identify emerging risks and guide improvement.
* Review assurance findings, incident trends and operational feedback to improve standards, contracts, procedures and service-provider performance.
* Promote a proactive culture while ensuring accountability remains with the teams and providers delivering the work.

 **Requirements**

**Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Health and Safety, Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, Environmental Management, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred:** Master’s degree in Health and Safety, Environmental Management, Engineering, Public Health, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional certifications or memberships with recognized health and safety, environmental, worker welfare, emergency management or related professional institutes are preferred; Chartered or equivalent professional standing is preferred.

A minimum of 10-12 years of experience in health and safety, occupational health and safety, environmental compliance, worker welfare, operational assurance or related fields is required, including relevant experience in a leadership role.

Demonstrated experience leading health, safety and worker welfare governance and assurance across complex operational, infrastructure, development or asset environments, including establishing standards and contractual requirements; overseeing contractor compliance; leading audits, inspections, investigations and corrective actions; supporting asset readiness and handover; advising on incident and crisis response; and coordinating with delivery teams, asset owners, regulators and public authorities. Experience across the asset lifecycle and in the Middle East is preferred.

Title: Area Sales Manager
Description:
**Position Objective**
The objective of the Area Sales Manager role is to oversee the operations and financial performance of multiple retail stores within an assigned area for 1 or more assigned brands in a region. This includes driving sales growth, ensuring exceptional customer service, managing and developing store teams, and maintaining compliance with company standards. The role requires strategic market analysis, financial acumen, and effective communication with senior management/Brand teams to optimize store performance, manage inventory, promotion, marketing campaign implementation in stores and achieve business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibility**
Operations Management
  
  

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of multiple fashion retail stores within the assigned area.
* Ensure all stores operate efficiently and adhere to company standards, including opening and closing procedures.
* Delegate tasks, assign responsibilities to store managers, and monitor progress.
* Adhere and enforce Company SOPs, Policies, and procedures, and loss prevention audit guidelines in all the assigned stores. Also, create measures to ensure compliance by all employees.
* Interpret and make decisions on operations and visual standards based on store and client needs.
* Single point contact with Brand Teams to implement business/marketing and other strategy elements in the stores uniformly

Financial Management
  
  

* Monitor and analyze sales data, key performance indicators (Units per transaction, Average transaction value, sales per month, sales per square foot, sales turnover, shrinkage control, increase in conversion percentage), and overall financial performance, especially P&L and EBITDA, to identify areas for improvement.
* Analyze financial reports and make data-driven decisions to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Monitor and manage budgets, expenses, and financial performance for each store.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives to enhance profitability while maintaining quality.

Customer Experience
  
  

* Ensure exceptional customer service by coaching and setting service standards for the team at all the stores.
* Conduct regular store visits to assess customer service quality and address any issues immediately.
* Collaborate with store managers to implement customer feedback and improve the shopping experience.

Market Analysis & Strategy
  
  

* Utilize market insights to identify opportunities for growth and adapt strategies accordingly.
* Stay informed about market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activities.
* Develop and execute area-specific marketing and sales strategies to drive footfall and revenue.

Communication & Reporting
  
  

* Regularly communicate with senior management to provide updates on store performance and area-wide initiatives.
* Communicate business drivers, merchandise and quality issues, and other related information to the Retail Operations Manager, Retail Buying Team, and Corporate Office as required.
* Prepare detailed reports on area performance, including successes, challenges, and opportunities for growth.

Staff Management & Development
  
  

* Recruit and train the staff on sales techniques, customer service, teamwork, and other etiquettes as per the company and brand requirements.
* Evaluate the performance of the employees annually and promote open lines of communication through coaching and motivation.
* Responsible for assessing additional training needs required for optimal performance within the store.
* Foster a positive work environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and growth.
* Develop succession plans to ensure a pipeline of qualified candidates for key positions within the area.

**Desired Experience**
The ideal candidate should have 5-7 years of experience in retail management, with at least 2-3 years in a multi-store management role, such as an Area or District Manager. Proven track record of successfully overseeing multiple retail stores, particularly in the fashion or related industries.

Title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.
  
  
You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
  
  
**Location:**
*These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.*
The role entails
  
  

* Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
* Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
* Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
* Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
* Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
* Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
* Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
* Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
* Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
* Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
* Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
* Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
* Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
* An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
* Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
* Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills
  
  

* Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
* Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
* Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
*We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.*

Title: Senior Manager, Supply Chain
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager, Integrated Supply Chain Planning leads end-to-end planning for Electronic Locks, from customer demand through material readiness, production scheduling, and delivery. This role owns forecast alignment, multi-site supply and production plans, and planning trade-offs across customer service, inventory, working capital, and cost. The leader directs a global planning team and establishes one integrated plan across the manufacturing and distribution network.

  

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* **(15%)** Lead, mentor, and develop demand, supply, CPFR, and production planning employees across multiple sites and time zones. Set clear expectations, provide ongoing coaching and feedback, build planning capabilities, support career growth and succession, and hold the team accountable for results. Establish common planning processes, data, performance measures, and escalation standards.
* **(20%)** Own the Electronic Locks demand plan and S&OP demand alignment process. Partner with Sales and Product Management to improve forecast accuracy and bias by customer, channel, and product, and translate demand volatility into supply and capacity plans.
* **(20%)** Own time-phased material requirements for mechanical components, electronics, semiconductors, and PCBAs. Maintain visibility to lead times, minimum order quantities, lifecycle status, supplier-confirmed availability, and factory capacity; provide Sourcing with clear requirements and escalate supply gaps.
* **(15%)** Own the weekly master production schedule across the global manufacturing footprint. Maintain clear-to-build visibility, planning parameters, frozen-window discipline, and schedule change control; resolve competing priorities when supply or capacity is constrained.
* **(10%)** Optimize inventory and working capital while controlling excess, obsolete, stranded, and premium material exposure. Quantify impacts including downtime, lost output, labor inefficiency, expedite cost, premium freight, delayed revenue, and customer penalties.
* **(10%)** Build plans to customer ship dates and coordinate with Manufacturing, Transportation, Distribution, and Customer Service to manage inbound flow, backlog, fulfillment risk, on-time delivery, and on-time in-full performance.
* **(5%)** Own material and schedule readiness for launches, transfers, engineering changes, phase-in and phase-out, and end-of-life transitions.
* **(5%)** Improve planning processes, master data, ERP parameters, reporting, and decision routines. Present decision-ready scenarios to senior leadership and drive corrective action that reduces recurring shortages and expedite activity.

**Education and Experience Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.

* 7-10 years of progressive supply chain experience, including leadership of planning teams; APICS CPIM or CSCP preferred.

  

**Required Skills**

* Strong command of S&OP, MRP, demand planning, master production scheduling, bills of material, lead-time logic, safety stock, time fences, allocation, and component lifecycle planning.
* Planning experience with mixed mechanical and electronic products, including PCBAs, semiconductors, long-lead components, and multi-site or offshore manufacturing.
* Ability to connect component availability and manufacturing schedules to customer service, inventory, working capital, cost, revenue, and operational performance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, people-leadership, and executive-communication skills, with hands-on experience using ERP, planning systems, reporting, and advanced data analysis.

  

**Work Environment:**

Working conditions are normal for an office environment. The role requires regular collaboration across global functions, manufacturing sites, suppliers, customers, and time zones, with periodic domestic and international travel.

The above information indicates the general nature and level of work performed and is not a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required for this role.

This position will be Hybrid (onsite Tuesday through Thursday) based in Lake Forest, California.

The annual salary for this role is $105,000-$165,000.

The final pay rate offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role. Benefits and additional compensation offered for this position are

Title: Warehouse Operations Manager
Description:

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Title: Chef de service - Données et Intelligence artificielle - Responsable technique - Intégration des systèmes et solutions
Description:
**Appartenir à Air Canada, c’est appartenir à un symbole canadien, Air Canada récemment élue meilleur transporteur aérien en Amérique du Nord. Faites décoller votre carrière en vous joignant à notre équipe novatrice et diversifiée à l’avant-garde du transport aérien de passagers.**
La personne qui occupe le poste de chef de service – Données et Intelligence artificielle dirige l’intégration technique, le déploiement et les capacités de préparation à la production requises pour opérationnaliser des produits, des modèles et des agents d’IA, ainsi que des pipelines de données de soutien dans l’ensemble des environnements d’entreprise d’Air Canada. Elle veille à ce que les solutions d’IA passent d’une architecture et d’une conception technique approuvées à des phases de développement, de tests et de production de manière sécurisée, contrôlée, reproductible et de plus en plus automatisée. Elle dirige les intégrateurs de systèmes d’IA et les spécialistes – Déploiement, établit des modèles d’intégration et de déploiement réutilisables, et travaille avec les équipes de l’ingénierie de l’IA, de l’ingénierie des données, l’ingénierie des plateformes, de l’Architecture, de la Cybersécurité, des opérations infonuagiques et des Opérations de données pour obtenir des résultats de production durables. La personne qui occupe ce poste doit trouver un équilibre entre la rapidité d’ingénierie et la gouvernance d’entreprise, la stabilité opérationnelle, la traçabilité et les contrôles fondés sur les risques.
  
  
**Le poste peut-être basé à Montréal ou Toronto.**
**Responsabilités**

* Diriger l’intégration des systèmes d’IA et gérer les spécialistes responsables de la transition des solutions d’IA de conceptions approuvées vers les environnements de l’entreprise.
* S’assurer que les produits, les modèles, les agents et les API d’IA et les pipelines de données de soutien sont correctement intégrés aux plateformes d’entreprise et aux systèmes en amont et en aval.
* Superviser le déploiement et la configuration des charges de travail liées à l’IA dans l’ensemble des environnements de développement, de mise à l’essai et de production.
* Piloter l’infrastructure en tant que code, les pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, les modèles relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), notamment la promotion des applications et des modèles et la gestion des versions, des replis et de l’environnement.
* Mettre en place des modèles d’intégration, des composants de déploiement, des gabarits et des processus d’automatisation réutilisables afin de réduire les tâches d’ingénierie propres à la solution et d’accélérer l’adoption.
* Collaborer avec les chefs des Produits – Intelligence artificielle, les scientifiques des données, les ingénieurs – Intelligence artificielle, les architectes de solutions, les architectes informatiques de l’entreprise, la Cybersécurité, les opérations infonuagiques, l’ingénierie des plateformes et les Opérations de données pour traduire les conceptions en versions prêtes pour la production.
* Définir et appliquer des critères de préparation à la production, notamment en ce qui concerne la surveillance, la journalisation, les alertes, les guides d’exploitation, la documentation de soutien, les responsabilités opérationnelles et les procédures de récupération.
* S’assurer que les intégrations et les déploiements répondent aux exigences en matière d’architecture, de cybersécurité, d’infrastructure, de gouvernance des données, de protection des renseignements personnels et d’exploitation.
* Mettre en œuvre des contrôles fondés sur les risques et comprenant les points d’approbation humaine appropriés pour les solutions concernant des données sensibles, des modèles d’IA, des agents autonomes ou des décisions d’affaires importantes.
* Diriger la validation technique, la préparation de la mise en service, la vérification après le déploiement et la transition ordonnée vers un soutien opérationnel stable.
* Définir et assurer le suivi des mesures de la réussite des déploiements, de la qualité des intégrations, de l’automatisation, de la fiabilité, des remaniements et de la préparation opérationnelle.
* Déterminer les problèmes récurrents en matière d’intégration et de déploiement et améliorer les pratiques d’ingénierie, les normes et les outils réutilisables en amont.
* Gérer la demande, les priorités, la capacité, les dépendances et les engagements en matière de prestation pour la fonction d’intégration des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle.
* Diriger, encadrer et perfectionner une équipe technique à haut rendement, établir des responsabilités claires et soutenir l’avancement professionnel.
* Assurer le leadership lors de mises en œuvre complexes ou à haut risque et agir à titre de personne-ressource pour les recours hiérarchiques en ce qui concerne les problèmes d’intégration et de déploiement.
* Gérer les relations avec les partenaires technologiques et les fournisseurs externes qui complètent les capacités de prestation internes.
* Maintenir ses connaissances à jour sur les pratiques d’ingénierie liées à l’IA, à l’infonuagique, à l’intégration, au déploiement et à la production, et évaluer leur applicabilité à Air Canada.

**Qualifications**

* Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologie de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience de travail équivalente.
* Au moins sept ans d’expérience en technologies à différents échelons, dont au moins trois ans à un poste de direction d’équipes techniques au sein d’un environnement d’entreprise vaste et complexe.
* Expérience avérée de l’intégration des systèmes, de l’ingénierie infonuagique, de l’ingénierie des plateformes, du développement et de l’exploitation, de la distribution de logiciels ou des activités de production.
* Excellente compréhension des pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, du contrôle des sources à l’aide de Git, des stratégies d’embranchement, des tests automatisés, de l’infrastructure en tant que code, des pipelines de déploiement et du déploiement dans différents environnements.
* Connaissance pratique des écosystèmes de données et d’IA modernes, notamment Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure DevOps ou GitHub, des plateformes d’orchestration et des outils de déploiement de l’IA et de l’apprentissage automatique.
* Compréhension des concepts relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), au déploiement des modèles et des applications, à la gestion des versions, à l’observabilité et à la gestion du cycle de vie de la production.
* Expérience de l’intégration d’API, des pipelines de données, de services infonuagiques, des contrôles de l’identité et des accès, des applications d’entreprise et des composants dirigés par les événements.
* Excellente connaissance des pratiques de l’entreprise en ce qui a trait à l’architecture informatique, à la cybersécurité, aux changements, aux versions et à la gestion des services TI.
* Capacité avérée à établir un équilibre entre la gouvernance, les risques liés à la production et les contrôles, et la rapidité d’exécution et l’automatisation.
* Aptitudes avérées pour le leadership humain, la gestion des parties prenantes, la communication, la prise de décision et la résolution de problèmes.
* Faire preuve de ponctualité et fiabilité avérées pour favoriser la réussite globale de l’équipe dans un milieu trépidant.
* Expérience à un poste critique sur le plan opérationnel dans le secteur de l’aviation ou du transport, ou dans un autre secteur hautement réglementé, un atout.

**Conditions D’emploi**
Les candidats doivent être admissibles à travailler dans le pays concerné au moment où une offre d’emploi est présentée et sont responsables de l’obtention des permis de travail, visas ou autres autorisations nécessaires. La preuve de l’admissibilité doit être fournie avant la date de début.
  
  
**Exigences Linguistiques**
À compétences égales, la préférence sera accordée aux candidats bilingues.
  
  
**Diversité et inclusion**
Air Canada est résolument engagée en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion et vise à créer un milieu de travail sain, accessible et gratifiant qui met en valeur la contribution unique de nos employés au succès de notre entreprise.
  
  
En tant qu'employeur qui garantit l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, nous encourageons les candidatures les plus diverses afin de pouvoir nous doter d’un effectif varié et représentatif de nos clients et des communautés où nous vivons et offrons nos services.
  
  
**Air Canada remercie tous les candidats de leur intérêt, mais seules les personnes sélectionnées pour une entrevue seront contactées.**

Title: Principal, International CX, Amazon Customer Service
Description:
**Description**
Come build the future of international customer experience with us. Every year, millions of customers across Amazon's global stores — from Dubai to São Paulo, Warsaw to Bangalore — experience moments where Amazon falls short. CXI's vision is to ensure every one of them — regardless of where they shop, what language they speak, or whether they ever contact us — gets an experience worthy of Amazon's promise. We do this by holding the most direct and comprehensive view of what's going wrong for customers, and driving the product, policy, and partnership changes that fix it at the root.
  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed senior product leader to join us as a Principal within the Customer Experience Improvement org (CXI) within Customer Service. You will dig deep into customer friction across all of Amazon's international stores — EU, India, MENA, LATAM, AU/ZA, and emerging markets — trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product improvements to improve CX. You will force-multiply the work of CXI's regional teams by building the frameworks, mental models, and measurement approaches they need to solve CX problems at scale — and influencing across organizations and senior leadership to drive systemic, durable change for international customers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Improve customer experience by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction across all international stores
* Build frameworks and mental models for solving CX gaps at scale — creating reusable approaches that force-multiply the work of CXI's regional teams across markets
* Author product strategy documents that drive alignment and investment decisions at VP and SVP level
* Define and own the metrics framework for international CX — including developing new measurement approaches that capture customer harm beyond traditional contact-based metrics, and that quantify the impact of policy and enforcement decisions on genuine customers
* Establish data-driven approaches to surface customer pain points — across human contacts, self-service, and customers who never reach CS — and drive upstream action across organizations
* Partner with product and technology teams to translate customer insights into product requirements and scalable solutions
* Partner with internal CS teams across product, quality of service, and technology to co-create the roadmap and plan for international stores — spanning self-service, associate service, and concessions — ensuring international customer needs are embedded in CS's product and tech priorities
* Work with central CXI teams — including DXI and Returns and Refunds — to embed the international lens into centrally-driven initiatives, ensuring that solutions designed at the global level reflect the realities of international customers and markets
* Partner on VP-level engagements across international markets, establishing shared CX improvement goals and joint accountability for outcomes
* Advocate for international customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations
* Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals
* Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making at senior leadership level

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
* Experience understanding product and technical requirements and interfacing with Product/Technology teams
* Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
* Experience writing strategy documents for executive audiences with clear recommendations in the midst of ambiguity
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience owning product strategy across complex, multi-market environments
* Strong understanding of international customers, businesses, and cultures across multiple geographies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning technology products
* Prior experience based in or covering MENA, LATAM, EU, or South Asia markets
* Proficiency in Arabic, Spanish, French, or other non-English languages is a plus

Title: Cook

Anthony’s is a family-owned group of restaurants with 26 locations across the Pacific Northwest, including Washington, Idaho, and Oregon. Our deep commitment to quality is reflected in our unique approach—we operate our own wholesale company, which allows us to source directly from local fishermen, ranchers, and trusted partners. * Proven experience in food preparation and cooking in a professional kitchen environment.
* Ability to read and speak English to understand recipes, safety instructions, and communicate with team members.
* Manual dexterity and physical stamina to handle kitchen tools and stand for long periods.
* Knowledge of food safety standards and sanitation practices.
* Capability to follow directions from the Head Chef and work collaboratively within a team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Formal culinary training or certification from an accredited institution.
* Experience working in a fast-paced kitchen setting.
* Familiarity with inventory management and food cost control.
* Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently during peak service hours.
* Additional language skills to support diverse kitchen teams and customer base.

**Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and cook menu items according to standardized recipes and quality standards.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the kitchen, including utensils, equipment, and workstations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety and sanitation guidelines at all times.
* Communicate effectively with kitchen staff and front-of-house team to coordinate meal preparation and delivery.
* Stand for extended periods and perform physical tasks such as climbing stairs and moving kitchen supplies.
* Monitor food stock levels and report shortages or spoilage to management.

The required skills such as food preparation and production are essential for daily cooking tasks, ensuring dishes are prepared accurately and efficiently. Speaking and reading English enable clear communication with the kitchen team and understanding of recipes and safety protocols. Manual dexterity is critical for handling kitchen tools and performing precise cooking techniques, while physical stamina supports standing for extended periods and moving objects as needed. Description:
**SUMMARY**

The role of the **Workplace Ambassador** will collaborate with various partners to ensure a high-quality seamless workplace experience is provided consistently for all employees. These partners include facilities and workplace experience teams, client employees, BGIS facilities and project teams, food service operators and fitness center operators. In this role, there is a unique opportunity to influence how employees work, and directly impact their workday. You will work with a team of professionals delivering workplace services including hospitality, reception, event space coordination, space occupancy and mail/package deliveries. In this role, you will be empowered to make decisions that are aligned with the organization’s workplace standards to ensure that the space continues to meet the needs of all employees. This role will support the key differentiator of the organization – it’s people, by enabling a culture of high-performance teams.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support**

* Face and go to person for the workplace strategy program in the office environment.
* Greet visitors, new hires and existing employees to explain the office space and how to work effectively in the space, how to utilize meeting rooms & access reservation system.
* Conduct periodic workstation reviews. Work with building property management and corporate Facilities Management, manage mail receipt and distribution, parking validations and guest access.
* Manage office supplies, relationship with offsite storage (Iron Mountain) security access cards (including reports and audits by security). Enforce clean desk policy. Rounds to ensure supplies in place – morning and evening.

**Technology Assistance**

* Program subject matter expert, provide problem solving solutions for administrative problems. Manage drop off for technologies requiring service. Escalation point of contact for office and technology issues.
* Provide basic how - to tech support and escalation process for all WTP toolkit technologies (wireless network, soft tokens, print release, AVAYA phone system, AV equipment, video conferencing, Smart Boards, etc.). Administer triage for meeting room technology – i.e. reset, reboot meeting room panels and lobby touch screens and/or manage escalations.
* Learn HR technology tools and provide HR and communications support (i.e. Yammer). Assist with minor event planning and meeting space set up. Provide local amenities maps.
* Manage the office sundry equipment for term use (mouse, power cords, power bars, spare laptops and desktops, monitor cables, network cables, head - sets, docking stations, keyboards, privacy filters, etc.). Manage locker / file cabinet inventory assignment and associated key control, name plates, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

* University degree with 1-3 years’ of job-related experience.
* Service oriented, able to be customer-facing and can-do attitude.
* Able to exercise sound judgement, make decisions, provide direction.
* Comfortable dealing with issues and people. Strong communication skills.
* Strong computer skills, including MS suite of software.
* Self-starter, able to work independently as well as in a team.
* Pro-active, approachable, and solution-based.
* Ability to multi-task.
* Accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure.
Strong organization skills.  

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**

* None required

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $44,303 - $52,121 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role. |

Title: Consultant principal, stratégie et négociations
Description:
**Req Id:**
431929
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**À propos du poste**
À titre de Gestionnaire principal, négociations stratégiques, vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) stratégique auprès de l’équipe de direction d’IA tissé, en contribuant à l’avancement des priorités commerciales, opérationnelles et de croissance les plus importantes de l’entreprise. En combinant une approche structurée de résolution de problèmes, d’excellentes compétences en communication auprès des dirigeants et un leadership transversal, vous soutiendrez les décisions clés liées aux occasions clients et locataires, à la priorisation des sites, à la planification de la capacité, aux présentations destinées à la haute direction, aux relations gouvernementales et à la performance de l’entreprise.
  
  
Une responsabilité essentielle du rôle consistera à aider la direction à déterminer quels locataires et clients doivent être attribués à quels sites, en équilibrant la demande des clients, la disponibilité de l’alimentation électrique, les exigences en matière de connectivité, le niveau de préparation des sites, les considérations économiques, les échéanciers, la valeur stratégique et les risques d’exécution.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**

* Gérer et améliorer continuellement le pipeline des occasions clients et locataires d’IA tissé, en assurant le suivi de l’avancement commercial, des dépendances clés, des risques et des prochaines étapes.
* Élaborer des recommandations et des cadres décisionnels afin d’aider la direction à prioriser les clients, les locataires, les sites, les investissements et les occasions stratégiques.
* Agir à titre de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des dirigeants en appliquant des méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes et des analyses fondées sur les données pour relever des défis d’affaires complexes.
* Diriger des analyses stratégiques à fort impact, des analyses de rentabilité, des exercices de planification par scénarios et le soutien à la prise de décision exécutive concernant les priorités les plus critiques de l’entreprise.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des ventes, des partenariats, des finances, des affaires juridiques, de l’immobilier, du réseau, des opérations ainsi qu’avec les dirigeants afin de favoriser l’alignement et d’accélérer l’exécution.
* Identifier les goulots d’étranglement, les risques et les enjeux interfonctionnels, recommander de façon proactive des solutions et en assurer la résolution.
* Diriger l’élaboration de documents d’information pour le chef de la direction, de présentations au conseil d’administration, de présentations gouvernementales, de présentations destinées aux dirigeants et de communications aux parties prenantes.
* Traduire des informations complexes en recommandations concises et orientées vers la prise de décision, en mettant en évidence les principales occasions, les risques, les compromis et les actions à entreprendre.
* Soutenir les échanges avec les hauts dirigeants de Bell, les intervenants gouvernementaux, les clients, les partenaires, les investisseurs et les leaders de l’écosystème.
* Faire preuve d’une discipline exceptionnelle en gestion de projet dans le cadre d’initiatives rapides et ambiguës, en veillant à ce que les priorités demeurent sur la bonne voie et que les livrables critiques soient exécutés efficacement.
* Mettre en place une gouvernance claire, une responsabilisation accrue et des mécanismes de fonctionnement qui améliorent la visibilité, la prise de décision et l’exécution à l’échelle de l’organisation.
* Accroître la vitesse d’exécution en réduisant l’ambiguïté, en favorisant l’alignement et en veillant à ce que les priorités critiques progressent efficacement.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* De 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil en gestion, en stratégie, en opérations, en infrastructures, en technologie, en télécommunications ou dans d’autres environnements à haute performance.
* Succès démontré dans le soutien à des cadres supérieurs au sein de contextes dynamiques, ambigus et à fort enjeu.
* Excellentes compétences en exécution et en gestion de projet, avec un historique démontré de réalisation d’initiatives complexes.
* Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes, notamment pour structurer l’ambiguïté, identifier les causes profondes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques, évolutives et légères en processus.
* Expérience dans la direction de programmes interfonctionnels, la production de rapports destinés aux dirigeants, la gestion de pipelines critiques pour l’entreprise, de tableaux de bord et de priorités stratégiques.
* Capacité à synthétiser des situations complexes en constats, recommandations et actions clairs.
* Curiosité, grande capacité d’apprentissage et intérêt marqué pour les outils d’intelligence artificielle favorisant la productivité et la prise de décision.
* Le bilinguisme français-anglais est considéré comme un atout.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience de soutien auprès d’équipes de direction, de comités exécutifs, de conseils d’administration, d’instances gouvernementales ou de programmes interfonctionnels d’envergure.
* Expérience dans la gestion de pipelines liés aux clients, aux activités commerciales, aux ventes, aux partenariats, aux investissements, aux locataires ou aux occasions d’affaires.
* Une exposition aux domaines des infrastructures, de l’intelligence artificielle, des télécommunications, de l’énergie, de l’immobilier, des politiques publiques, des technologies d’entreprise, des réseaux, de la connectivité ou des partenariats commerciaux constitue un atout, sans être obligatoire.
* Expérience dans la préparation de présentations destinées aux dirigeants, de documents d’information pour le chef de la direction, de documents à l’intention des gouvernements, de tableaux de bord ou de mises à jour stratégiques.
* Intérêt démontré pour l’intelligence artificielle, les infrastructures numériques, la compétitivité nationale ou le développement d’entreprises à grande échelle.

Description:
Clerk - Health
