**Job Description:**

TDSGI Network is seeking a Senior Network Infrastructure Specialist based in Canada to support TDS network infrastructure globally. The successful candidate will bring deep, hands-on expertise in enterprise networking, low-latency infrastructure, IP multicast, market-data distribution, exchange connectivity, routing and switching, incident management, and controlled production delivery. The role will help maintain and enhance the resilient, secure, and high-performing network services that support TDS electronic-trading platforms and global business operations.

  

This is a hands-on senior position covering data-center networks, colocation environments, WAN, MAN, LAN, SD-WAN, Internet, B2B connectivity, office infrastructure, and network security integration. The individual will collaborate with regional and global technology teams, Enterprise Network Engineering, Network Operations, cybersecurity partners, application teams, telecommunications carriers, exchanges, colocation providers, managed service providers, and technology vendors.

The role requires strong technical judgment, disciplined change execution, effective incident leadership, comprehensive technical documentation, and the ability to coordinate complex infrastructure initiatives across regions and time zones.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

**Global Network Infrastructure Delivery**

* Lead and support the design, implementation, configuration, migration, integration, and lifecycle management of global TDS network infrastructure.

* Deliver network solutions across data centers, colocation facilities, trading locations, offices, WAN, MAN, LAN, SD-WAN, Internet, B2B, exchange connectivity, and out-of-band-management environments.

* Translate business, application, security, resiliency, capacity, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, supportable, and highly available network solutions.

* Lead or contribute to network modernization, infrastructure currency, data-center expansion, office buildouts, network segmentation, hardware replacement, software upgrades, and technology transformation initiatives.

* Coordinate implementations involving multiple regions, technical teams, telecommunications providers, colocation providers, exchanges, vendors, and business stakeholders.

* Ensure solutions align with approved architecture, engineering standards, security controls, operational requirements, naming conventions, and support models.

Complete technical validation and operational-readiness activities before transitioning new or changed infrastructure into production.  

  

**Low-Latency and Multicast Networking**

* Design, implement, support, optimize, and troubleshoot low-latency network infrastructure supporting electronic-trading and market-data applications.

* Support multicast market-data distribution, including multicast routing, source and receiver connectivity, group management, traffic replication, and end-to-end delivery.

* Troubleshoot multicast issues involving: PIM, IGMP, Rendezvous points, Reverse Path Forwarding, Multicast routing and forwarding tables, Duplicate or missing multicast traffic, Packet loss, congestion, latency, and out-of-sequence traffic

* Analyze latency-sensitive traffic using packet captures, interface statistics, network telemetry, routing information, device logs, and monitoring platforms.

* Identify and help remediate latency, jitter, packet loss, microbursts, congestion, buffering, unnecessary network hops, and capacity constraints.

* Work with trading-application, market-data, exchange-connectivity, security, server, and infrastructure teams to understand traffic flows, latency expectations, resiliency requirements, and failover behavior.

* Support connectivity to exchanges, market-data providers, B2B partners, external clients, vendors, and colocation facilities.

* Validate primary and disaster-recovery network paths, multicast convergence, redundancy, capacity, and failover behavior.

Lead technical troubleshooting during incidents affecting electronic trading, market-data delivery, exchange connectivity, or other latency-sensitive services.  

  

**Routing, Switching, and Network Services**

* Configure, support, and troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 network environments.

* Provide advanced expertise in technologies such as: BGP, OSPF, TCP/IP, IP multicast, VLAN, VRF, Route filtering and redistribution, First-hop and routing resiliency, Quality of Service, EVPN/VXLAN, Network segmentation, High-availability routing and switching

* Support Arista and Cisco network platforms in data-center, colocation, and low-latency environments.

* Support routing integration, segmentation, policy implementation, NAT, and connectivity troubleshooting involving Palo Alto firewall infrastructure.

* Analyze end-to-end traffic paths across switching, routing, firewalls, telecommunications carriers, exchange networks, third-party services, and application infrastructure.

* Support DNS, DHCP, IP address management, AAA, logging, network-time, and related infrastructure-service integrations where applicable.

Maintain alignment with approved hardware, software, configuration, and security standards.  

  

**Operational Support and Incident Management**

* Provide senior-level troubleshooting and escalation support for complex network incidents, service degradation, and production connectivity issues.

* Lead or participate in major-incident technical triage, impact assessment, service restoration, stakeholder communication, and follow-up remediation.

* Diagnose routing, switching, multicast, firewall, circuit, packet-loss, latency, capacity, application-connectivity, network-path, and device-health issues.

* Work with Network Operations and other infrastructure teams to maintain service availability, stability, and resiliency.

* Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, exchanges, colocation providers, managed service providers, equipment vendors, and B2B partners during service-impacting events.

* Develop corrective actions addressing the underlying stability, resilience, capacity, monitoring, or maintainability concerns identified during incident investigations.

* Contribute to post-incident reviews and ensure agreed technical remediation actions are documented and completed.

Participate in an on-call or after-hours support rotation where required.  

  

**Monitoring, Performance, and Capacity Management**

* Use enterprise and TDS monitoring platforms to identify incidents, investigate performance, validate infrastructure health, and support capacity planning.

* Monitor and analyses latency, jitter, packet loss, interface errors, discards, utilization, routing state, device health, multicast behavior, and network-path performance.

* Ensure new or changed infrastructure is integrated with the required monitoring, logging, configuration-management, inventory, and alerting platforms.

* Contribute to network-performance baselines, service-availability reviews, capacity assessments, and proactive remediation.

* Identify opportunities to improve visibility through telemetry, dashboards, higher-frequency monitoring, packet analysis, and automation.

Support performance testing and technical validation for new applications, infrastructure changes, capacity increases, and disaster-recovery exercises.  

  

**Change, Risk, and Control Management**

* Prepare and execute production changes in accordance with established change-management, risk-management, and approval requirements.

* Produce clear implementation, validation, rollback, impact, dependency, risk, and communication plans.

* Ensure production changes are technically reviewed, appropriately approved, completed within authorized implementation windows, and closed with the required evidence.

* Evaluate technical and operational risks associated with network implementations, migrations, incidents, exceptions, and temporary solutions.

* Escalate design exceptions, operational gaps, infrastructure risks, and deviations from approved standards to the appropriate stakeholders.

* Support audit, compliance, security, software-currency, asset-management, vulnerability-remediation, and control-remediation activities.

* Ensure network infrastructure remains on approved and supportable hardware and software versions.

Participate in failover tests, disaster-recovery exercises, resiliency validation, and remediation of identified gaps.  

  

**Documentation and Operational Readiness**

* Create and maintain high-quality network diagrams, high-level designs, low-level designs, implementation plans, rollback plans, operational support documents, standards, procedures, inventories, and troubleshooting guides.

* Document network topology, routing, segmentation, multicast flows, monitoring, failover behavior, circuit information, service dependencies, support contacts, and escalation paths.

* Ensure newly delivered infrastructure has complete monitoring, support, asset, configuration, security, recovery, and operational documentation.

* Maintain accurate infrastructure information within approved repositories and operational systems.

* Conduct or participate in design reviews, operational-readiness reviews, change reviews, post-implementation reviews, and knowledge-transfer sessions.

Develop reusable documentation and implementation patterns that improve global consistency and reduce operational risk.  

  

**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Act as a senior technical resource and escalation point for complex network initiatives, incidents, and infrastructure decisions.

* Independently lead technically complex implementations, migrations, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and service-restoration efforts.

* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other team members while promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across regions.

* Lead technical discussions involving architecture, engineering, operations, security, application teams, project stakeholders, vendors, and service providers.

* Review technical designs and deliverables to identify implementation, resilience, security, capacity, supportability, monitoring, and operational-readiness gaps.

* Communicate complex technical matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

* Manage multiple concurrent priorities while maintaining delivery quality, control compliance, and production stability.

* Promote standardization, automation, repeatable delivery, improved observability, and operational simplification.

Represent TDSGI Network requirements while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture, engineering, and security direction.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience supporting complex enterprise network infrastructure, preferably within financial services or another highly available, regulated environment.

* Advanced experience supporting low-latency networks in capital-markets, electronic-trading, market-data, or similarly time-sensitive environments.

* Strong understanding of packet forwarding, latency, jitter, packet loss, microbursts, congestion, buffering, and end-to-end network-path analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of IP multicast, including: PIM Sparse Mode, IGMP, Rendezvous-point concepts, Reverse Path Forwarding, Multicast source and receiver behavior, Multicast routing and forwarding tables, Multicast troubleshooting

* Experience supporting multicast market-data distribution across datacenter, colocation, or exchange-connectivity environments.
* Advanced routing and switching knowledge, including: BGP and eBGP, OSPF, TCP/IP, VLANs and VRFs, Route filtering and redistribution, Quality of Service, High-availability routing and switching, Resilient Layer 2 and Layer 3 designs

* Hands-on experience with Arista and Cisco networking platforms in production environments.

* Practical experience with Arista Cloud Vision.

* Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, including routing integration, segmentation, NAT, security-policy implementation, and troubleshooting.

* Experience supporting WAN, MAN, LAN, Internet, MPLS, SD-WAN, data-center, branch, office, and colocation connectivity.

* Experience supporting B2B, third-party, client, vendor, exchange, or extranet connectivity.

* Strong troubleshooting skills using CLI diagnostics, packet captures, telemetry, device logs, routing tables, multicast tables, interface statistics, and monitoring data.

* Experience executing production network changes within formal change-management and risk-control processes.

* Ability to create and review high-level designs, low-level designs, network diagrams, implementation plans, validation plans, rollback plans, and operational documentation.

* Experience working with telecommunications carriers, exchanges, colocation providers, equipment vendors, managed service providers, and external technical teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work effectively across geographic regions, time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries.

Ability to provide after-hours support for production changes, incident response, testing, and service-restoration activities when required.  



**Working Conditions**

* The position is based in Canada and supports TDS network services and infrastructure globally.

* Regular collaboration with teams and stakeholders across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific will be required.

* Evening or weekend work is required for production changes, maintenance, failover testing, incident response, disaster-recovery exercises, and business-continuity activities.

* Participation in an on-call support arrangement may be required.

* Occasional travel to TDS offices, data centers, colocation facilities, or other technology locations may be required.

Title: Dean of Students
Description:
### **Job Description**

**Dean of Students**
====================

**Department:** Student Affairs / Pastoral Care
  
**Direct Reports:** As assigned
  
**Location:** School Campus
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Dean of Students is responsible for promoting a safe, positive, inclusive, and supportive school environment in which students can thrive academically, socially, and personally.

The role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership of student wellbeing, behaviour, discipline, attendance, student engagement, and pastoral systems. The Dean works closely with school leadership, teachers, counsellors, parents, and support staff to ensure that student-related matters are managed consistently, fairly, and in accordance with school policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Student Behaviour and Discipline**

* Lead and oversee the school's student behaviour and discipline processes.
* Ensure that behaviour expectations and consequences are applied consistently and fairly.
* Investigate and manage significant student behaviour incidents and disciplinary cases.
* Maintain accurate records of disciplinary incidents, interventions, and outcomes.
* Work with teachers and school leaders to develop appropriate behaviour interventions and support plans.
* Monitor recurring behaviour concerns and identify patterns requiring further intervention.
* Support restorative practices and strategies that promote accountability and positive behaviour.
* Escalate serious or repeated concerns to the appropriate member of the Senior Leadership Team.

### **2. Student Wellbeing and Pastoral Care**

* Promote a positive school culture focused on student wellbeing, belonging, respect, and inclusion.
* Work closely with school counsellors and pastoral staff to identify and support students requiring additional assistance.
* Monitor students who may be experiencing academic, social, behavioural, or personal difficulties.
* Coordinate appropriate interventions and follow-up support.
* Ensure student concerns are appropriately documented, managed, and escalated where required.
* Promote student voice and encourage students to take an active role in the school community.

### **3. Attendance and Student Engagement**

* Monitor student attendance, punctuality, and patterns of absence.
* Work with relevant staff and parents to address persistent attendance or punctuality concerns.
* Identify students who may be disengaged from school and coordinate appropriate interventions.
* Support initiatives designed to improve attendance, participation, and student engagement.

### **4. Safeguarding and Student Protection**

* Work collaboratively with the school's safeguarding team to promote student safety and welfare.
* Follow all school safeguarding policies and procedures.
* Report and escalate safeguarding concerns in accordance with school requirements.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when dealing with sensitive student matters.
* Contribute to safeguarding education, awareness, and prevention initiatives.

### **5. Parent and Community Relations**

* Serve as a key point of contact for parents and guardians regarding significant student behaviour, wellbeing, attendance, and pastoral matters.
* Conduct meetings with parents to discuss concerns, interventions, and student progress.
* Communicate professionally and constructively, particularly when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations.
* Build positive relationships with families and promote partnership between home and school.

### **6. Student Leadership and Activities**

* Support and develop student leadership opportunities.
* Encourage student participation in school activities, events, clubs, and community initiatives.
* Support student councils and other student leadership structures.
* Promote student responsibility, leadership, citizenship, and positive contribution to the school community.

### **7. School Culture and Community**

* Promote the school's values, expectations, and standards of conduct.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen school culture, student belonging, and community spirit.
* Support the organisation and delivery of assemblies, student events, campaigns, and wellbeing initiatives.
* Act as a visible and approachable presence around the school campus.

### **8. Staff Support and Collaboration**

* Provide guidance to teachers and staff regarding student behaviour, pastoral concerns, and appropriate interventions.
* Work collaboratively with Heads of School, Heads of Department, Year Leaders, Counsellors, SEN/SEND staff, and other relevant teams.
* Support staff in implementing consistent behaviour and pastoral expectations.
* Deliver or coordinate staff training related to student behaviour, wellbeing, safeguarding, and pastoral care where appropriate.

### **9. Data, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate student records relating to behaviour, attendance, wellbeing, and interventions.
* Analyse student behaviour and attendance data to identify trends and areas requiring action.
* Prepare reports for school leadership as required.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of student support and behaviour systems.
* Recommend improvements to policies, procedures, and student support programmes.

### **10. Leadership and School Operations**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of school policies relating to students.
* Participate in leadership meetings and relevant school committees.
* Support the Principal and Vice Principal with student-related matters and school-wide initiatives.
* Assist with crisis management and major student incidents when required.
* Undertake other duties reasonably assigned by the Principal or designated member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Social Sciences, Leadership, or a related field.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or leadership qualification is desirable.
* Previous experience in a school-based pastoral, student affairs, behaviour, safeguarding, or leadership role.
* Experience managing complex student behaviour and wellbeing matters.
* Experience working collaboratively with parents, teachers, school leaders, and external professionals.
* Knowledge of safeguarding principles and child protection practices.
* Experience in an international or multicultural school environment is desirable.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Strong understanding of student behaviour, wellbeing, and pastoral care.
* Excellent conflict-resolution and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Strong organisational and case-management skills.
* Ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations.
* Strong decision-making and judgement.
* Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural and social backgrounds.
* Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and using student information systems.
* Commitment to safeguarding, inclusion, student wellbeing, and educational excellence.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Integrity and professionalism.
* Empathy and emotional maturity.
* Fairness, consistency, and sound judgement.
* A student-centred approach.
* Resilience and composure.
* Strong accountability and ownership.
* Collaborative and approachable leadership.
* Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trust with students, parents, and colleagues.

**Key Performance Areas**
-------------------------

Performance in the role may be assessed against:

* Effectiveness of student behaviour and discipline systems.
* Student wellbeing and pastoral support.
* Attendance and punctuality improvement.
* Consistency and effectiveness of behaviour interventions.
* Quality and timeliness of student case management and documentation.
* Parent and student engagement.
* Safeguarding compliance.
* Student leadership and engagement initiatives.
* Staff support and collaboration.
* Contribution to a positive and inclusive school culture.

Title: Oshawa Power Control Room Operator
Description:
**CONTROL ROOM OPERATOR**
-------------------------

Oshawa Power Group of Companies is a parent company of fiber optic, district energy and renewable generation businesses, and the local electricity distribution company that supplies electricity to more than 63,000 customers in the city of Oshawa. Located just 45 minutes east of Toronto off the shores of Lake Ontario, Oshawa serves as the economic engine for the Durham Region. Oshawa Power maintains 1000 km of overhead and underground distribution lines within a 150 km2 service territory, operated at 44 and 13.8 kV, supplied by 9 distribution and 3 transmission substations. The organization is committed to the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of electricity through responsible financial management, strategic reinvestment and continuous innovation.

**ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY**

Reporting to the Manager, Distribution Construction, the Control Room Operator is responsible for the safe, reliable and efficient real-time operation and control of the company's electrical distribution and sub-transmission systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.

As a designated Controlling Authority, the position monitors system conditions, authorizes and directs switching, administers work protection, coordinates field response and manages power restoration while protecting employees, contractors, the public and electrical equipment.

**Hourly Rate:** $44.99- $59.23 per our Collective Agreement with **IBEW 636**

**Vacancy Type:** Replacement

**AS THE SUCCESSFUL APPLICANT, YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO BE INVOLVED WITH:**

**System Operations & Monitoring**

* Exercise real-time operational control of the company's distribution, sub-transmission and station systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.
* Monitor SCADA, ADMS, GIS, alarms, voltage, loading, equipment status and other operating information; identify abnormal conditions and take or direct timely corrective action to maintain safe and reliable system operation.
* Authorize and direct the safe operation of switches, breakers, reclosers, intelligent field devices, station equipment and other electrical apparatus.
* Monitor feeder, station, transformer and equipment loading; respect established ratings and operating limits and initiate or recommend corrective action.
* Use automated and self-healing distribution devices to support sectionalizing, fault isolation, load transfer and service restoration.

**Switching & Work Protection**

* Prepare, check, issue and administer switching orders, Orders to Operate, Hold-Offs, work permits and other work protection documents in accordance with the Utility Work Protection Code (UWPC), Electrical Utility Safety Rules (EUSR), and company procedures.
* Control and authorize operational access to electrical plant and equipment in accordance with the UWPC, EUSR, and company procedures.
* Review planned work with field crews, supervisors, contractors and authorized parties to confirm system configuration, isolation requirements, operating sequences and appropriate work protection.
* Direct overhead, underground, station and sub-transmission switching for planned work, system reconfiguration, load transfers, equipment isolation and service restoration.

**Outage & Emergency Response**

* Coordinate planned and unplanned interruptions; dispatch and direct field personnel to investigate trouble, isolate hazards, complete emergency repairs and safely restore service.
* Assess disturbances and establish restoration priorities that protect public and employee safety, safeguard equipment, maintain system integrity and minimize customer impact.
* Respond to emergencies involving downed conductors, damaged equipment, fires, motor-vehicle incidents, public hazards and possible life-safety concerns.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate planned and emergency switching, supply interruptions, load transfers and station operations with Hydro One's control centre.
* Communicate with the IESO, Electrical Safety Authority, emergency services, neighbouring LDCs, contractors, major customers and other authorities as required.
* Provide clear operational direction to field personnel and accurate, timely outage and system information to internal and external stakeholders.
* Respond professionally to customer inquiries involving outages, partial power, voltage concerns and other distribution-system conditions, and arrange investigation as required.

**Operating Records, Systems & Improvement**

* Maintain accurate operating diagrams, maps, open-point records, equipment status information, switching records, outage records, operating logs and required reports.
* Support investigations of system events, equipment operations, interruptions, power-quality concerns and feeder performance, and assist with corrective actions.
* Assist with the development and continuous improvement of operating procedures, emergency and restoration plans, switching practices and System Control Center processes.

**Training, Safety & Other Requirements**

* Provide instruction and operational support to Apprentice or backup operators and maintain required technical, safety, emergency-response and cybersecurity training.
* Comply with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, applicable regulations, UWPC, EUSR, company policies and safe work practices.
* Available for emergency response, overtime and call-ins on an as-needed basis in accordance with established schedules and the collective agreement. Rotational shifts may be introduced in the future and would be included in the collective agreement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU HAVE TO OFFER**

**Education:**

* Three-year college diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Engineering Technology or a related electrical discipline; an equivalent combination of relevant utility experience, education and technical training may be considered.
* Successful completion of the MEARIE Operator-in-Training Program and certification as an EDA Journeyperson Electrical Operator is required.
* OACETT certification, or eligibility for certification, as a C.E.T. or C.Tech. is considered an asset.
* Current UWPC certification is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum four years of progressively responsible experience in electrical distribution-system operations, System Control Center operations, utility field operations, protection and control, stations or a directly related electrical utility function.
* Demonstrated experience with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, switching orders, work protection, system isolations, load transfers and service restoration.
* Experience coordinating field crews and external authorities during planned work, outages and emergencies.
* Experience operating 13.8 kV distribution and 44 kV sub-transmission systems, including associated stations and protection schemes, is preferred.

**Required Competencies**

* Advanced knowledge of overhead and underground distribution, sub-transmission, transformer stations, protection schemes and associated equipment.
* Advanced knowledge and practical application of the UWPC, electrical isolation, switching and work-protection principles.
* Strong understanding of electrical fundamentals, loading, voltage, equipment ratings, fault response, system restoration and operating contingencies.
* Ability to interpret and maintain single-line diagrams, operating maps, schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings and switching documents.
* Ability to assess complex, changing conditions and make timely, accurate and defensible operating decisions with minimal supervision.
* Advanced problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to remain calm and decisive during outages and emergencies.
* High accuracy and attention to detail when preparing and administering operating and work-protection documents.
* Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate simultaneous switching, outage, dispatch and communication activities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear and unambiguous direction by radio, telephone and electronic systems.
* Ability to direct field activities and establish operational priorities without direct supervisory authority.
* Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, contractors, customers, emergency services, regulators and other utilities.
* Proficiency with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, Microsoft Office and other operational technology systems.
* Strong commitment to safety, system reliability, customer service, teamwork, respect and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work established schedules and maintain the concentration required to safely manage multiple concurrent activities, including rotational shifts if introduced in the future.
* Valid Ontario Class G driver's licence with a driving record satisfactory to the company.

Title: Home Care Startup & Operations Consultant – Ontario
Description:
Home Care Startup & Operations Consultant – Ontario

**Company:** Altura Care Group Inc.  
**Location:** Mississauga, Ontario (Hybrid / Remote, with occasional GTA meetings)  
**Job Type:** Contract / Project-Based Consulting  
**Compensation:** Negotiable based on experience, project scope and deliverables  
**Schedule:** Flexible, with sufficient availability to support startup planning, implementation and launch

About Altura Care Group Inc.

Altura Care Group Inc. is a newly incorporated Ontario company preparing to launch a premium private home-care service in Mississauga and surrounding GTA communities.

Our goal is to establish a reputable, professionally managed home-care organization providing safe, compassionate, reliable and high-quality services to clients and their families.

We are seeking an experienced **Home Care Startup & Operations Consultant** to work directly with the founder and provide comprehensive, step-by-step guidance throughout the development and launch of our agency.

The founder brings business ownership and management experience but is new to the home-care industry. We are therefore looking for someone who can proactively identify what needs to be done, establish priorities, guide implementation and help build the business from the ground up.

**This is not a traditional nursing position or a role limited to providing occasional professional advice.**

We are looking for someone who has personally participated in establishing, launching, expanding or managing a home-care agency, preferably within Ontario's private-pay home-care sector.

Key Responsibilities1. Startup Planning and Project Leadership

* Evaluate the company's current stage of development.
* Develop a comprehensive startup roadmap, including milestones, priorities, responsibilities and timelines.
* Identify the operational, staffing, administrative and regulatory preparations required before launch.
* Provide proactive, step-by-step guidance throughout the startup process.
* Assist with implementation, coordinate agreed activities and monitor progress.
* Identify when additional specialized professionals are required.

2. Business Model and Operational Development

* Advise on the selection of initial home-care services and service packages.
* Help establish pricing structures, staffing models and operational budgets.
* Develop practical workflows and day-to-day management procedures.
* Assist with organizational planning and operational responsibilities.
* Help establish sustainable processes that can support future business growth.

3. Regulatory Readiness, Policies and Risk Management

* Identify applicable Ontario home-care operational and regulatory requirements.
* Assist with insurance, privacy, employment and workplace safety preparations in coordination with qualified professionals.
* Help develop and implement essential policies, procedures and documentation.
* Establish processes for client intake, care planning, service agreements, incidents, complaints, emergencies and continuity of care.
* Help establish quality assurance and risk-management systems.

4. Recruitment, Staffing and Training

* Advise on the appropriate staffing and management structure.
* Help identify and recruit key local clinical and operational personnel.
* Develop job descriptions, recruitment procedures and interview criteria.
* Establish caregiver screening, onboarding, training and competency-assessment processes.
* Assist with supervision, performance evaluation and ongoing staff development systems.

5. Software and Administrative Systems

* Recommend appropriate home-care management and scheduling software.
* Assist with implementation of client records, care documentation and staff scheduling systems.
* Establish administrative processes for time tracking, invoicing, payroll coordination and reporting.
* Help create practical systems that are efficient, secure and suitable for a growing agency.

6. Business Development, Referral Relationships and Client Acquisition

**Strong preference will be given to candidates with proven hands-on experience acquiring private-pay home-care clients and developing referral relationships.**

An important objective for Altura is establishing a reliable client acquisition process from the beginning.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can help us:

* Develop a practical client acquisition and community outreach strategy for Mississauga and surrounding GTA communities.
* Identify appropriate referral partners, community organizations and professional contacts.
* Establish relationships with retirement residences, healthcare professionals, senior organizations and other relevant community partners.
* Develop introductory presentations, outreach scripts, follow-up procedures and lead tracking systems.
* Guide initial business development activities and participate in outreach where appropriate.
* Help generate and manage qualified client inquiries.
* Train and mentor an existing team member who will gradually assume responsibility for community outreach and business development.
* Establish measurable activities and sustainable processes for ongoing client acquisition.

**We recognize that startup operations and business development are distinct areas of expertise.**

Candidates who are exceptionally qualified in startup operations but do not personally specialize in client acquisition are still encouraged to apply.

In such cases, we are open to engaging a separate experienced home-care business development specialist to lead outreach and train our team member.

7. Operational Launch and Early Client Support

* Develop a comprehensive launch-readiness checklist.
* Help establish client inquiry, assessment, onboarding and service delivery processes.
* Support preparation for accepting the agency's first clients.
* Assist with initial operational challenges and process improvements.
* Guide the transition toward independent day-to-day management by the founder and local team.

8. Ongoing Guidance and Knowledge Transfer

* Provide regular progress meetings and clear recommendations.
* Proactively identify upcoming tasks, priorities and potential challenges.
* Explain important operational decisions and industry practices.
* Help the founder develop the knowledge and confidence to manage the business effectively.
* Deliver agreed project milestones and practical implementation support.

Required Qualifications

* Significant operational, management or business development experience in the home-care industry.
* Direct experience establishing, launching, expanding or managing a home-care agency, preferably in Ontario.
* Strong understanding of home-care staffing, service delivery, operational systems and quality management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and implement practical business processes.
* Strong project management, communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively with a business owner who is new to the healthcare industry.
* Sufficient availability to provide consistent support throughout the agreed startup project.

Strongly Preferred Experience

* Founding or helping establish a private-pay home-care agency.
* Successfully developing home-care referral networks and acquiring paying clients.
* Building relationships with retirement residences, healthcare organizations and community partners.
* Leading business development teams or training community outreach staff.
* Experience with the Mississauga and Greater Toronto Area home-care market.
* Developing startup policies, procedures, caregiver training programs and operational systems.

An RN or RPN designation, healthcare management qualification or relevant business consulting background is an asset but is not mandatory.

Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is an experienced home-care professional who understands what it takes to build an agency from its earliest stages.

We value practical experience, initiative, accountability and the ability to guide implementation.

We are not simply looking for someone who can tell us what should be done. We are seeking someone who can help us understand **how to do it, in what order, and how to ensure it is completed successfully.**

The founder will retain responsibility for business ownership, management decisions, financial approvals and ongoing operations.

Consulting Structure

We anticipate a phased consulting arrangement beginning with an assessment of our current stage of development and preparation of a detailed startup roadmap.

Subsequent phases may include operational development, staffing, system implementation, launch preparation and early operational support.

The scope, expected deliverables, timeline, availability and compensation will be agreed upon before commencement.

Application Questions

Please include responses to the following questions with your application:

* Have you personally established, launched or significantly expanded a home-care agency? Please describe the organization, your role and the work you performed.
* What experience do you have developing home-care operational systems, policies, staffing procedures and startup processes?
* Have you personally developed referral relationships or helped acquire private-pay home-care clients? If yes, please describe your approach and results.
* Would you be comfortable leading initial business development activities and training an existing employee to manage community outreach?
* If business development is not your specialty, would you be comfortable collaborating with a separate specialist?
* Can you provide proactive, hands-on guidance from startup planning through operational launch?
* What is your approximate weekly availability, and what consulting fee structure would you propose?

Title: IT Operations Centre Analyst - ITOC
Description:

The IT Operations Analyst ensures a safe and reliable technology environment for Air Canada with focus on troubleshooting and operational tasks to support our critical IT services: core infrastructure, applications and digital. The IT Operations Centre team is constantly engaging with the core IT teams to find ways to proactively monitor the environment and develop skills to handle vital operations and is a key enabler of service automation within the IT portfolio.

This position will be reporting to the Manager, IT Operations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Act as an initial escalation point for the service desk and other Air Canada IT teams as they identify issues regarding our technology environment.
* Effectively escalate service impacting issues to the correct teams and collaborate to ensure the issue is resolved as soon as possible. Preliminary troubleshooting before escalating is required. Proactively respond to alerts by performing correctional tasks to remediate issues and prevent larger issues from occurring.

* Work with ITOC BA’s, automation analysts and the extended IT team to expand the ITOC portfolio of services through documenting design, standard operating procedures and other opportunities to provide value.
* Make recommendations for Service Improvement Plans and ensure actions are followed through to completion in a timely manner.
* Work with internal and third-party teams to ensure actions are taken and completed to protect and improve services.
* Provide assistance to cyber defence teams regarding IT certificate management.
* Conduct initial investigations and make proactive decisions in cloud web portals according to IT security procedures.
* Develop knowledge of monitoring tools that will be used to monitor Air Canada's IT infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the IT operations team to investigate and mitigate repetitive incidents in the IT service.

**Qualifications**

* A relevant University degree/technical certification, and/or relevant experience commensurate to the role.
* 3-5 years’ experience in an enterprise IT environment or global NOC.
* At least 3-5 years of experience in the following: IT Monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk , Glassbox etc. IT Major Incidents, ITIL process concepts and execution (Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management),

* Recent Certifications in a related domain such as CCNA, MSCE, AWS, CSP, ITIL, etc.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and in rapidly changing environments or uncertain conditions.
* Ability to work cooperatively with others on a team and to communicate (verbally and in writing) effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrates concern for satisfying one’s external and/or internal customers.
* Anticipates the implications and consequences of situations and takes appropriate action to be prepared for possible contingencies.

* Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. Do you want to manage supplier relationships in the invoice payment lifecycle? Do you consider yourself well-versed in the world of telecom billing reconciliation, Accounts Payable, program management and vendor relationships? If so, the AWS Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) Business Operations team at Amazon is looking for an experienced professional to provide support of payment, operations and capacity by managing the invoice to payment lifecycle for our global backbone, interconnect and metro fiber circuits increasing our capability to optimize network cost efficiency around the world.  
  
As part of the Business Operations team, you’ll use the levers of process and technology to help our GCID team influence and hold supplier partners accountable.

Maintain relationships with vendors to ensure invoicing/payment procedures are clearly understood, documented and accurately managed.

You will work closely with supplier partners, AP, Finance and Business Development to ensure AWS network costs are closely tracked, easily understood, and managed YoY.  

* You'll be empowered to think big, influence and exercise ownership over your solutions.
* You’ll interface with various levels within AWS as well as external vendors, to influence decisions and manage expectations
* You'll be a trusted resource for GCID and will be a key member of a team of innovative program managers to extend impact across the organization.

  
About the team  
Business Operations works closely with global suppliers and internal Amazon teams to provide timely payment support of network services. This includes vendor management and on-boarding, managing billing accounts, payment issue resolution, etc. Business Operations implements cost savings and process enhancing projects, data integrity initiatives and various special projects in support of these efforts.

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* Experience leading process improvements
* Experience supporting accounting/finance customers to set and effectively manage expectations, project deliverables, and drive resolution when conflicts or issues arise
* Experience with telecom expense management (TEM), including invoice auditing, cost allocation, and spend optimization

----------------------------

* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

Title: Dir Service Delivery Management
Description:
**Build Our Future Together**
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a seasoned Director of Global Network and Compute Service Delivery to own the end-to-end delivery, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement of global network, compute, and storage infrastructure services at a leading biopharmaceutical company. This leader will manage a team of service delivery managers and managed service partners, and will partner with Digital & Technology leadership, network engineering, compute engineering, cybersecurity, cloud, site IT, quality and compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure the network (WAN/SD-WAN, LAN/wireless, data center, cloud connectivity, and internet edge), compute, and storage systems are available, secure, cost-effective, and aligned to business outcomes across R&D, manufacturing, laboratory, and commercial sites worldwide.
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
  
  
**When & Where**
This is an on-site position 4 days/week, based at our Sleepy Hollow, NY or Warren, NJ offices.
  
  
**Discover Your Role**
Own global network service delivery performance, including service availability, incident, problem, change, capacity, and release management, with accountability for SLAs, OLAs, and customer satisfaction across all regions.
  
  
Lead and develop a global service delivery organization, including managers of managers and follow-the-sun coverage; set the operating model, staffing plan, performance goals, and participate with the Service Owners on their development of the succession pipeline for all network, compute, and storage systems.
  
  
Govern managed network and compute service providers, and other vendors, including contract and SLA management, quarterly business reviews, service credit enforcement, and remediation of underperformance.
  
  
Direct major incident response and ensure timely root cause analysis, and drive problem management and corrective actions that reduce repeat incidents and business impact.
  
  
Partner with network and compute engineering, architecture, and cybersecurity to deliver the network, compute, and storage roadmap, ensuring operational readiness as each service transitions into service.
  
  
Ensuring network and compute services meet regulatory and audit requirements for GxP-validated and business-critical environments, including change control, documentation, disaster recovery, and resiliency testing.
  
  
Own the service delivery budget and vendor spend, including forecasting, carrier and circuit cost optimization, managed services invoicing, sourcing strategy, and financial reporting to senior leadership.
  
  
Define and report service metrics, KPIs, risks, and continuous improvement priorities to senior leadership, displaying business value of delivery, and escalate issues appropriately across Digital & Technology and the business.
  
  
**This Role Requires**
12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, network operations, or service delivery, including at least five (5) years leading global teams and managing managers.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (master's degree preferred), or equivalent experience.
  
  
Proven track record managing outsourced network and compute services relationships, including contract negotiation, SLA governance, and vendor performance management.
  
  
Experience with ServiceNow, network monitoring and observability tools (such as ThousandEyes, LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, Splunk, or Cisco/Meraki dashboards), and AIOps or network automation.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of enterprise network technologies and ITIL-based service management, with solid experience in compute and storage service delivery.
  
  
Demonstrated financial acumen, including budget ownership, vendor cost optimization, and business case development.
  
  
Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead through major incidents, and translating technical issues into business impact.
  
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones, and to work in US business hours with flexibility for global coverage and on-call escalation in a hybrid model.
  
  
**Nice To Have Skills**
Experience in a regulated life sciences or healthcare environment, including GxP, computer system validation, and SOX-aligned controls.
  
  
Experience leading managed service transitions, global network transformation, and ensuring compute, and storage operational readiness.
  
  
Certifications such as ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader, CCNP/CCIE, PMP, or Lean Six Sigma.

Title: Network Administrator
Description:

The Network Administrator is responsible for administering, maintaining, upgrading, securing, and troubleshooting the district’s core infrastructure. This includes on-premises and cloud environments, backup and disaster recovery operations, and the administration of identity and access controls across Active Directory and Microsoft 365.

Qualifications:

**Education/Certification****:**

Bachelor’s degree or demonstrable equivalent

**Special Knowledge/Skills****:**

Strong organization, communication, and interpersonal skills  
Experience with network configuration and troubleshooting  
Familiar with Microsoft File and Print share operations  
Familiar with Veeam Backup and Replication or comparable backup solutions

Working knowledge of VMware vSphere/ESXi administration

Proficiency with Microsoft Azure/Entra

Strong knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy

Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange, Teams, Purview)

Experience managing Windows Server 2016/2019/2022

Experience developing and executing disaster recovery plans

Strong understanding of system availability and disaster recovery

Minimum of three years technical support experience

Technical support experience in Texas Public Schools preferred

Configure and maintain Veeam Backup and Replication for disaster recovery and business continuity.

System 5 backup.

Administer and maintain on-premises virtualization infrastructure using **VMware vSphere/ESXi.**

Support and optimize **Microsoft 365** services, including Exchange Online, SMTP Relay, Teams, user account and license management, email security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access policies, and compliance features such as retention policies and Purview eDiscovery.

Monitor and maintain **Active Directory**, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file services.

Administer **Windows Server** infrastructure (2016/2019/2022), including performance tuning, filesystem and permission management, troubleshooting services, SCOM monitoring, and role/service configuration.

Monitor system health using **System Center Configuration Manager**.

Document system configurations and maintain operational procedures.

Provide Tier 2/3 technical support for escalated incidents.

Work with District and campus techs on troubleshooting issues.

Assist peers in troubleshooting when needed.

Demonstrate the ability to plan, organize, and act independently of direct supervision.

Maintain accurate documentation of user configurations, application versions, and other significant areas of responsibility.

Identify, analyze, and report research findings to promote the improvement of District technology.

Promote a departmental culture of customer service through frequent communication, positive relationships, and prompt support.

Frisco ISD is committed to fostering a collaborative work environment that honors and supports the social and emotional well-being of all. Employees are expected to interact in a manner that is becoming of educators and promotes high levels of productivity for the benefit of the students we serve.

Maintain emotional control under stress. Frequent standing, stooping, bending, pulling, and pushing. Prolonged use of computer and telephone. Repetitive hand motions.

Title: Cybersecurity Incident Coordinator
Description:
Overview:

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

As a key member of KPMG Canada Digital Security Group and reporting to the Senior Manager of the CISO office and Director of Security Operations, this role will support the DSG team by coordinating and tracking activities related to high-priority security incidents and KPMG’s global cybersecurity campaigns.

The role helps ensure the right teams are connected, actions and timelines are tracked, documentation remains current and stakeholders receive timely updates.

The position will primarily support Frontier AI Response & Cybersecurity Coordination by supporting the firm's ability to adapt and respond to emerging cyber risks through coordination and tracking of:

* P1/P2 cybersecurity incidents
* Global cybersecurity campaigns and security changes
* Emerging Cyber Risk & Vulnerability Response – Support the firm’s ability to adapt and respond to emerging cyber risks and critical vulnerabilities by coordinating remediation activities, tracking ownership and progress, and helping ensure Global response requirements and SLAs are met

What you will do:

* Coordinate the response to P1 and P2 cybersecurity incidents, emerging cyber risks and priority vulnerabilities, ensuring the appropriate Digital Security Group, technology, business, privacy, data and risk stakeholders are engaged
* Schedule and facilitate incident bridge calls, working sessions and cross-functional meetings with Canadian, Global and external stakeholders.
* Track actions, owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, blockers and outstanding items, including progress against Global requirements and service-level agreements (SLAs)
* Maintain accurate incident timelines, meeting minutes, action trackers, remediation records and key decisions, and follow up with action owners to address overdue items and keep activities on schedule
* Prepare and distribute timely incident updates, consolidated remediation reporting, dashboards, management reports and presentations to support visibility, escalation and decision-making
* Support post-incident reviews and lessons-learned activities, and recommend improvements to the effectiveness, efficiency, resilience and maturity of the security program
* Coordinate the Canadian member firm response to Global cybersecurity campaigns, security changes and related communications across groups such as the Global Information Security Group and Global Quality & Risk Management
* Build and strengthen relationships across KPMG businesses, member firms, Global teams and vendors to support the effective delivery and maintenance of the security program
* Coordinate security escalations and obtain appropriate approvals to support timely resolution of cybersecurity and data protection matters
* Participate in and, where required, lead information security and data protection projects, tracking project progress, portfolio activities, deliverables and budgets
* Stay current on information security and data protection trends, emerging technologies and evolving cyber risks to help inform response and program priorities

What you bring to this role:

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information technology, project coordination or stakeholder management, including experience working with senior leaders or executives
* A university degree in computer science or a related discipline
* Hands-on experience coordinating cybersecurity or IT incident response, including meetings, activities, projects, action tracking and follow-up
* Good understanding of cybersecurity concepts, security terminology and vulnerability detection tools, with experience using tools such as Wiz, Qualys, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) or Cyera

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to document meetings, decisions and action items, prepare status reports, trackers and presentations, and explain technical information clearly to technical, non-technical and executive stakeholders

* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar IT service management or ticketing platform is considered an asset but not required
* One or more relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, ITIL 4 Foundation or a project management certification, is considered an asset but not required
* Availability to participate in rotational 24/7 on-call support, including evenings, overnight periods, weekends and holidays during critical incidents; extended hours may also be required for major outages or other business-critical events

Title: Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) - 12 Month Contract
Description:
**Company Name:** Merrithew International

**Job Title:** Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)

**Reports to:** Vice President of People and Cultured

**Category:** Full time, Hybrid – Permanent

**Position Location:** Scarborough Ontario, Tapscott Office

**Opportunity:** This is a backfill role in the organization

**Compensation:** $80,000.00 - $90,000.00

**About Merrithew:**

Merrithew® is the global leader in mindful movement, the company behind the STOTT PILATES® Movement System™ and a growing portfolio of leading movement education and equipment brands, including Align-Pilates and the **GYROTONIC®** organization. Since 1988, Merrithew has trained more than 100,000 instructors in over 135 countries and developed premium equipment and science-based education trusted by leading studios, rehabilitation centers and fitness professionals.

Merrithew supports instructors, studio owners and wellness leaders with a complete ecosystem to thrive, including training, equipment, digital resources, business tools and a global network of peers. Its vision is to transform lives through intentional, inclusive movement, shaping the next era of mindful movement through innovation, purpose and a commitment to professional excellence.

**GYROTONIC®** and **GYROKINESIS®**are registered trademarks.

**Our Core Values**

These are the values that guide our daily actions, decisions, and how we work with one another and our customers:

* Community – Culture of belonging, encourage connections and engagement
* Passion – Be present, enthusiastic, energetic, committed to purpose, inspiring
* Boldness – Act with courage, change the norm, never settle for “just ok”
* Customer-Centric – Our Vision is fulfilled through our Trainers, Partners and end-customers.
* Accountability – Act like owners, own the results
* Innovation – Delivering the best, highest-quality products, programs and services

**Position Overview****:**

The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) provides strategic advice and hands-on support across the full employee lifecycle. Partnering with leaders, employees and HR colleagues, this role helps Merrithew attract, develop, engage and retain talent while supporting business performance and a positive workplace culture.

Supporting the assigned departments, the HRBP contributes across workforce planning, recruitment, employee relations, performance management, learning and development, total rewards, and HR operations and organizational change. The role balances employee needs with business priorities, promotes consistent people practices and builds managers’ capability to lead effectively.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**1. HR Strategy and Workforce Planning**

* Partner with leaders to translate business priorities into people plans, staffing requirements and organizational capabilities.
* Assess workforce capacity, skills gaps and succession risks, recommending actions to support current and future needs.
* Advise on organizational structure, job design, role clarity and resource allocation.
* Contribute to annual HR planning, headcount budgets and people initiatives.
* Use workforce data to assess progress and adjust priorities.

**2. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define hiring needs, develop job descriptions and establish selection criteria.
* Support recruitment strategies opened positions.
* Coach managers on interviewing, candidate assessment and fair, inclusive hiring practices.
* Support internal mobility, promotions and succession pipelines.
* Collaborate on employment offers, compensation recommendations and hiring approvals.
* Help strengthen the candidate experience and Merrithew’s employer brand.

**3. Onboarding, Employee Transitions and Offboarding**

* Coordinate with managers and internal partners to deliver effective onboarding, orientation and probationary reviews.
* Help new employees understand their roles, performance expectations, workplace practices and Merrithew’s values.
* Support transfers, promotions, contract changes and other employee transitions.
* Guide offboarding activities, including exit interviews, documentation and coordination with payroll and other departments.
* Identify themes from onboarding and exit feedback to improve retention and the employee experience.

**4. Employee Relations**

* Act as a trusted adviser on workplace concerns, policy interpretation and employee relations matters.
* Coach managers on conflict resolution, attendance, corrective action and sensitive employee conversations.
* Conduct timely, impartial and well-documented investigations into workplace complaints.
* Recommend appropriate resolutions and support disciplinary decisions and employment separations in consultation with HR leadership and legal advisers.
* Promote consistent treatment, procedural fairness and respectful workplace behaviour.
* Where applicable, support collective agreement interpretation, grievance management and labour relations activities.

**5. Performance Management**

* Support goal setting, performance reviews, ongoing feedback and performance improvement processes.
* Coach managers to establish clear expectations and address performance concerns promptly.
* Help ensure performance assessments and employment decisions are fair, evidence-based and consistently documented.
* Connect performance outcomes with development, recognition, succession and compensation decisions.
* Monitor completion and effectiveness of performance management activities.

**6. Learning, Leadership Development and Succession**

* Identify employee and leadership development needs through business discussions, performance reviews and skills assessments.
* Partner on training plans, learning resources and development programs.
* Facilitate training on people management, workplace policies and core HR practices.
* Support career development, mentoring, cross-training and internal advancement.
* Coordinate talent reviews and succession planning for critical positions.
* Assess whether learning initiatives improve capability and workplace performance.

**7. Compensation, Benefits and Recognition**

* Support compensation reviews, salary benchmarking, job evaluation and internal equity assessments.
* Advise managers on salary changes, promotions and recognition within approved guidelines and budgets.
* Partner with payroll and benefits providers or internal specialists to resolve employee questions and issues.
* Help communicate compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs, as applicable.
* Support benefits enrolment, changes and program reviews in collaboration with the responsible partners.
* Recommend recognition practices that reinforce contribution, performance and Merrithew’s values.

**8. Employee Engagement, Culture and Inclusion**

* Support engagement surveys, employee listening activities and action planning.
* Coach leaders to respond to feedback and strengthen trust, communication and team effectiveness.
* Promote inclusive practices across hiring, development, advancement and day-to-day management.
* Support employee recognition, wellbeing and community-building initiatives.
* Identify retention risks and recommend practical actions.
* Reinforce Merrithew’s values through leadership behaviours and people programs.

**9. Health, Safety, Wellbeing and Disability Management**

* Partner with operational leaders and health and safety representatives to support safe working practices across office and manufacturing environments.
* Support safety orientation, required training, incident follow-up and corrective actions within the HR function’s responsibilities.
* Coordinate accommodation, disability management and return-to-work processes with employees, managers and relevant providers.
* Support leave administration, attendance management and workplace injury claims processes.
* Promote employee wellbeing and awareness of available support resources.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling medical and accommodation information.

**10. Employment Compliance, Policies and Risk Management**

* Support compliance with applicable employment standards, human rights, accessibility, privacy and occupational health and safety requirements.
* Develop, review and communicate HR policies, procedures and employee guidance.
* Monitor relevant legislative developments and recommend updates with HR leadership or legal advisers.
* Maintain clear documentation of employment decisions and HR processes.
* Support audits, required training and employment-related reporting.
* Identify people risks and escalate complex or sensitive matters appropriately.

**11. HR Operations, Systems and Payroll Partnership**

* Maintain accurate employee information, employment documentation and HR system records.
* Coordinate timely processing of new hires, employee changes, leaves and departures.
* Partner with payroll to validate employee changes, resolve discrepancies and support accurate pay administration.
* Respond to employee inquiries and improve the consistency and responsiveness of HR services.
* Support HR system adoption, data quality, records retention and appropriate access controls.
* Streamline administrative processes and identify opportunities to improve employee self-service.

**12. HR Analytics and Reporting**

* Monitor measures such as headcount, turnover, absenteeism, vacancies, recruitment timelines and training completion.
* Analyze trends to identify workforce challenges and recommend targeted action.
* Prepare clear reports and insights for leaders while protecting employee confidentiality.
* Evaluate the outcomes of HR initiatives and recommend improvements.
* Support accurate workforce reporting and planning.

**13. Organizational Development and Change Management**

* Support organizational growth, restructuring, technology adoption and changes to working practices.
* Assess the people impact of proposed changes and help develop implementation plans.
* Coach leaders on change communication, employee involvement and transition support.
* Help teams improve collaboration, accountability and effectiveness.
* Partner across functions to embed new processes and assess adoption.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Postsecondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ or more years of progressive HR experience, including broad generalist responsibilities and experience advising people managers.
* CHRP or CHRL designation, or progress toward a designation.
* Experience supporting corporate and manufacturing teams is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations, investigations, performance management, recruitment and employee development.
* Working knowledge of compensation, benefits, payroll processes, disability management and workplace health and safety.
* Working knowledge of employment requirements and the ability to coordinate appropriate advice for various jurisdictions.
* Experience using HR systems, reporting tools and workforce data.
* Experience supporting multiple locations, international operations or unionized environments is an asset, where relevant to the assigned portfolio.

Title: Principal Network Developer
Description:
As a Principal Network Development Engineer within NAT, you will serve as a senior technical leader for network acquisition, connectivity delivery, and activation across OCI’s global infrastructure. You will guide the engineering execution of connectivity supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, backbone growth, and strategic network deployments.

You will operate at the intersection of network architecture, telecommunications, optical infrastructure, service providers, data center engineering, deployment, and operations. Your scope will span carrier circuits, dark and lit fiber, DWDM and wavelength services, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects. You will translate complex network designs and business requirements into clear technical specifications, implementation approaches, and acceptance criteria for internal teams and infrastructure partners.

At the Principal level, you will lead engineering decisions across programs and deployments, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and evaluate tradeoffs involving capacity, performance, resiliency, physical route diversity, operational supportability, and delivery constraints. You will partner with architecture and engineering teams to identify implementation gaps early and use delivery and operational experience to influence future designs, technical standards, and supplier requirements.

You will establish the technical requirements for circuit acceptance, fiber and optical validation, turn-up, activation, and production readiness. You will guide teams in evaluating test evidence, resolving deficiencies, and documenting readiness decisions, exceptions, and remediation requirements before operational handoff. As a senior technical escalation point, you will lead the resolution of complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 issues across OCI teams and external providers, drive root cause analysis, and ensure recurring failures result in corrective actions and engineering improvements.

You will work closely with Program Managers to assess technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and recovery options across the delivery portfolio. You will strengthen NAT’s engineering practices through reusable standards, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, acceptance frameworks, accurate infrastructure records, and clear operational handoffs. You will also guide the use of automation, scripting, telemetry, database management tools, and AI-assisted engineering to improve validation, troubleshooting, data quality, and delivery efficiency while maintaining engineering rigor and validating outputs.

This role requires deep network engineering expertise, sound technical judgment, and the ability to drive complex outcomes across organizations and external suppliers. You will influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise engineering standards across NAT, with an emphasis on repeatable practices that improve connectivity quality, reliability, and readiness at global scale.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Provide senior technical leadership for complex global connectivity programs supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, and strategic network deployments.
* Own technical outcomes across the lifecycle of carrier circuits, dark fiber, lit fiber, wavelengths, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects.
* Translate high-level network architecture and business requirements into detailed technical delivery requirements and implementation strategies.
* Lead technical design reviews covering topology, physical paths, diversity, demarcation, transport, interfaces, optics, capacity, routing, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Identify design and delivery risks early and drive engineering decisions that prevent downstream deployment and operational issues.
* Define technical acceptance standards and validation requirements for network infrastructure delivered by external providers.
* Lead complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting across fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, routing, and provider networks.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for systemic or high-impact connectivity issues.
* Lead deep-dive root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions across Oracle and supplier engineering organizations.
* Act as a technical authority in supplier engagements, challenging proposed solutions and ensuring services meet OCI engineering, reliability, scalability, and operational requirements.
* Partner with Program Managers to assess technical risk, establish delivery strategy, make tradeoffs, and develop recovery plans for critical infrastructure.
* Lead cross-functional engineering efforts involving network architecture, backbone, Internet, optical, capacity, deployment, operations, data center teams, and suppliers.
* Develop technical standards, design patterns, acceptance criteria, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, and engineering best practices that can be applied globally.
* Identify systemic gaps in network acquisition and delivery and lead technical improvements that increase quality, predictability, and operational readiness.
* Influence supplier capabilities, technical roadmaps, testing methodologies, and service offerings based on OCI requirements.
* Lead or contribute to technical evaluation of new carriers, services, hardware, optical technologies, and connectivity solutions.
* Define requirements for automation and tooling that improve network delivery, validation, monitoring, inventory accuracy, and troubleshooting.
* Partner with software and automation teams to ensure engineering requirements are translated into scalable tools and workflows.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution development while maintaining engineering rigor.
* Provide technical coaching and mentorship to NDEs, Program Managers, and partner teams.
* Raise the technical bar for NAT and serve as a trusted technical advisor across the organization.

**Critical Focus Areas**
========================

* Global carrier and service provider networking
* Optical transport, DWDM, dark fiber, lit fiber, and wavelengths
* Internet transit, peering, and inter-domain networking
* Backbone and metro connectivity
* Network architecture and resiliency
* Circuit and fiber acceptance
* Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting
