Title: Logistics Operations Officer
Description:
### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

#### 1. Shipment & Logistics Coordination

\* Coordinate daily import and export shipments from origin to final delivery.

\* Arrange and monitor \*\*FCL, LCL, air freight, and land transportation\*\*.

\* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, airlines, transporters, customs brokers, and clearing agents.

\* Obtain freight quotations and negotiate competitive rates and service terms.

\* Ensure timely booking of containers, vessels, flights, and trucks.

\* Monitor shipment schedules, ETD/ETA, transshipment, delays, and delivery status.

\* Maintain an updated shipment tracker for all active shipments.

#### 2. Import & Export Operations

\* Handle complete import/export logistics documentation.

\* Coordinate \*\*Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Health Certificate, COO and other relevant documents\*\*.

\* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure documents are received accurately and on time.

\* Liaise with customs and relevant government authorities for shipment clearance.

\* Ensure compliance with UAE import regulations and GCC requirements.

\* Coordinate inspection, approval, sampling, and release of shipments where required.

#### 3. Perishable & Food Cargo

\* Manage logistics for \*\*fresh fruits, vegetables, rice, wheat flour, sugar, edible oils and other food products\*\*.

\* Coordinate temperature-controlled transportation and reefer containers where required.

\* Monitor cold-chain requirements and ensure cargo is handled within the required temperature range.

\* Coordinate urgent action in case of cargo delays, port issues, customs holds, or quality concerns.

\* Ensure perishable shipments are prioritized for clearance and delivery.

#### 4. Port, Airport & Customs Coordination

\* Coordinate with \*\*Jebel Ali, Khorfakkan, Fujairah and UAE airports\*\* as required.

\* Follow up on container discharge, D/O, customs clearance, inspections, port releases and gate-in/gate-out activities.

\* Coordinate trucking arrangements for container pickup and delivery.

\* Resolve operational issues involving shipping lines, terminals, ports, airlines, customs, and transport companies.

\* Monitor demurrage, detention, storage, port and other logistics-related charges.

#### 5. Transportation & Delivery

\* Arrange local and GCC transportation according to shipment requirements.

\* Coordinate container trucks, refrigerated trucks and delivery vehicles.

\* Ensure timely collection from ports/airports and delivery to warehouses or customers.

\* Obtain PODs and maintain proper delivery records.

\* Monitor vehicle movement and coordinate with drivers and transport companies.

#### 6. Supplier & Freight Forwarder Management

\* Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, transporters and clearing agents.

\* Request and compare quotations before confirming logistics arrangements.

\* Evaluate service quality, transit time, pricing and reliability of logistics providers.

\* Escalate repeated operational failures and negotiate corrective actions.

\* Develop a reliable network of logistics service providers across key trade lanes.

#### 7. Cost Control

\* Review freight quotations and logistics invoices.

\* Negotiate freight, trucking, clearance, handling, storage and other operational charges.

\* Monitor and minimize \*\*demurrage, detention, storage, waiting time and unnecessary additional costs\*\*.

\* Verify logistics invoices against agreed quotations and shipment records.

\* Maintain shipment-wise logistics cost records.

#### 8. Documentation & Reporting

\* Maintain complete and organized shipment files.

\* Prepare daily/weekly shipment status reports.

\* Maintain records of:

\* Shipment status

\* ETA/ETD

\* Container numbers

\* BL/AWB details

\* Customs status

\* Clearance status

\* Delivery status

\* Logistics costs

\* Outstanding documents

\* Provide management with regular updates on delayed, urgent, or high-value shipments.

### MANAGER-LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES

For the \*\*Logistics Operations Manager\*\* position, additional responsibilities include:

\* Lead and supervise the logistics operations team.

\* Develop logistics SOPs and operational procedures.

\* Establish and manage freight-forwarder and transporter contracts.

\* Negotiate annual/monthly freight rates and credit facilities.

\* Develop strategic relationships with shipping lines, airlines and logistics providers.

\* Monitor overall logistics performance and operational KPIs.

\* Optimize shipping routes, freight costs and delivery schedules.

\* Plan logistics capacity based on projected purchasing and sales volumes.

\* Identify operational risks and develop contingency plans.

\* Manage major shipment escalations and resolve operational disputes.

\* Train and supervise logistics staff.

\* Report logistics performance, costs and issues directly to senior management.

### KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

\* On-time shipment booking

\* On-time customs clearance

\* On-time delivery

\* Freight cost savings

\* Reduction in demurrage and detention

\* Documentation accuracy

\* Shipment visibility and tracking

\* Supplier/forwarder response time

\* Reduction in shipment delays

\* Successful handling of perishable cargo

\* Logistics cost per shipment/container

\* Customer delivery performance

### REQUIREMENTS

\*\*Education:\*\*

\* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.

\*\*Experience:\*\*

\* Officer: \*\*2–4 years\*\* relevant logistics/import-export experience.

\* Manager: \*\*5+ years\*\* relevant logistics/supply chain experience.

\* UAE logistics experience is highly preferred.

\* Experience with \*\*foodstuff, FMCG, agricultural products, perishables, or trading companies\*\* will be an advantage.

### REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE

\* UAE import/export procedures

\* Customs clearance

\* Shipping and freight forwarding

\* FCL/LCL operations

\* Air freight operations

\* Reefer and temperature-controlled cargo

\* Port and terminal procedures

\* Transportation and trucking

\* Import/export documentation

\* Demurrage and detention

\* GCC logistics

\* Incoterms

\* Basic logistics cost analysis

### SKILLS

\* Strong negotiation and communication skills

\* Excellent coordination and follow-up abilities

\* Strong problem-solving skills

\* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel and Microsoft Office

\* Strong documentation and organizational skills

\* Ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously

\* Strong commercial awareness

\* Ability to communicate effectively with suppliers, forwarders, transporters and government authorities

\* Fluent English required; \*\*Hindi/Arabic\*\* would be an advantage.

### PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

\* Proactive and responsible

\* Highly organized and detail-oriented

\* Strong sense of urgency

\* Commercially minded

\* Reliable and accountable

\* Good team player

\* Capable of independently handling operational issues

\* Willing to work beyond standard hours when urgent shipments require attention

### WORKING ENVIRONMENT

The role requires frequent communication and coordination with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, customs brokers, transport companies, warehouses, customers and internal departments.

The candidate must be prepared to handle urgent shipment requirements, delays, port/airport issues and time-sensitive perishable cargo operations.

### AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY

The Logistics Operations Officer / Manager will be accountable for ensuring that shipments are:

\*\*Booked → Shipped → Cleared → Collected → Delivered\*\*

efficiently, cost-effectively, safely, and within the required timelines.

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Want to help deliver one of the TTC's most important strategic initiatives? Join the Renewable Energy Programs (REP) team as a Project Controls Coordinator, where you will play a critical role in supporting the delivery of a multi-billion-dollar portfolio of electrification, renewable energy, and infrastructure projects that will help power TTC's transition to a zero-emission fleet.

  

This role goes beyond traditional project coordination and administration. You will serve as a strategic integrator, working closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, Project Coordinators, Finance, and stakeholders across the organization to ensure projects remain aligned with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and governance requirements.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Head of Renewable Energy Programs, you will provide project controls leadership and coordination across a large and complex portfolio of renewable energy, fleet electrification, charging infrastructure, energy storage, solar generation, and facility modernization projects that support TTC's transition to a net-zero fleet.

  

As one of only two Project Controls Coordinators supporting the portfolio, you will serve as a key interface between project teams, finance, project management, and TTC stakeholders, ensuring project controls processes are consistently applied and project performance is effectively monitored throughout the project lifecycle.

  

You will work closely with Senior Project Managers, Program Managers, Project Coordinators, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to coordinate planning and scheduling activities, maintain cost controls, manage budgets and forecasts, monitor project performance, and support governance and reporting requirements. Through ongoing analysis and engagement with project delivery teams, you will ensure decision-makers have accurate and timely information regarding project health, risks, costs, schedules, and forecast outcomes.

  

A significant component of the role involves maintaining financial controls within SAP, including budget monitoring, forecasting, internal order management, cost transfers, settlements, accruals, cash flow monitoring, and variance analysis. You will help ensure financial information remains accurate and aligned with approved capital plans, project baselines, and funding commitments.

  

You will coordinate the development, review, and validation of project controls deliverables, including schedules, cost estimates, forecasts, cash flow projections, stage-gate documentation, performance metrics, and management reports. By reviewing project data and performance trends, you will identify budget and schedule variances, investigate root causes, recommend corrective actions, and support recovery planning to maintain project objectives.

  

The successful incumbent will prepare management dashboards, status reports, key performance indicators, and executive reporting materials that provide meaningful insights into project performance and support informed decision-making. You will transform complex project information into actionable recommendations for project teams and leadership.

  

You will also support compliance with rigorous internal governance processes and external funding requirements associated with provincial, federal, and municipal funding programs. This includes coordinating reporting requirements, maintaining data integrity across project controls systems, supporting audits and governance reviews, and helping ensure compliance with funding agreements and reporting obligations.

  

Given the strategic nature of TTC's electrification and renewable energy initiatives, your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of charging infrastructure, power upgrades, energy storage systems, solar projects, and facility electrification projects that support TTC's long-term climate commitments and fleet modernization objectives.

  

Promotes a respectful work and service environment that supports diversity, inclusion, and is free from harassment and discrimination. The Salesforce Marketing Cloud Architect will provide support to the Digital Impact Manager on both technical architecture review and hands-on technical delivery for UNICEF's global Supporter Engagement Strategy (SES) platform ensuring solutions align with UNICEF enterprise architecture principles, security requirements, integration standards and global operating model. The role is responsible for designing, building and continuously improving Marketing Cloud capabilities that support fundraising, supporter engagement and digital marketing operations across UNICEF markets.

### **About the Region**

The UNOPS Global Portfolios Office (GPO) brings together diverse expertise to help partners deliver impact worldwide. With hubs in New York, Geneva, and Vienna, and expert teams operating globally, GPO leads multi-regional initiatives that advance sustainable development, climate action, and peacebuilding - including in some of the world’s most challenging environments. By leveraging our collective expertise and global networks, GPO supports UNOPS’ strategic priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals across more than 130 countries. We work closely with major global partners - including governments, international financial institutions, and UN agencies - to deliver a wide range of services, such as project management, fund management, hosting services, and HR support.

### **About the Country/Multi-Country Office**

From Geneva, UNOPS facilitates the achievement of the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), working with governments, other United Nations (UN) agencies and partners by providing quality servces, integrated solutions and management support through strategic, cost-effective and results-oriented approches. This includes supporting platforms and hosting high-profile, flagship initiatives and funds focusing on health, nutrition, water and sanitation, sustainable cities, environment, energy, climate and trade. UNOPS is a recognized resource for the UN system in Geneva – from fund management and oversight and advisory services, to providing hosting solutions to a range of global initiatives, as well as operational support to partner organizations.

### **Job Specific Context**

UNOPS Geneva Office is providing support to a wide range of portfolios, including UNEP, UNICEF, UNHCR, and other partners.

  
  

UNICEF works in some of the world’s toughest places, to reach the world’s most disadvantaged children. To save their lives. To defend their rights. To help them fulfill their potential.

  
  

This position is a Partner Personnel role. UNOPS is supporting UNICEF-DI as a UN partner and is acting on its behalf to provide recruitment and administrative support for this position. The selected candidate will be recruited through UNOPS in accordance with UNOPS recruitment rules, and will be engaged as UNICEF-DI personnel. The incumbent will work under the effective management and supervision of UNICEF-DI, not UNOPS.

  
  

**About UNICEF Digital Impact Division (DID)**

  
  

Digital Impact Division (DID) is at the heart of reshaping how UNICEF delivers lasting results for children. We are committed to harnessing the full potential of emerging digital technologies

to advance UNICEF’s mission.

  
  

DID works in close collaboration with regional Digital Impact teams and colleagues across headquarters divisions, regions, and country offices to leverage technologies and capabilities that accelerate progress on UNICEF’s goals, strengthen community resilience, and expand access to essential digital services and information.

  
  

Our mission is to enhance UNICEF’s global digital impact by promoting equitable access to information and services, empowering communities to create lasting, positive change for children, and foster a more inclusive, interconnected, and sustainable world for every child, everywhere.

  
  

UNICEF's Supporter Engagement Strategy (SES) is a global digital transformation programme delivering a unified fundraising, supporter engagement and digital marketing ecosystem across multiple UNICEF markets. The platform leverages Salesforce technologies including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, integrations, data platforms and analytics capabilities to support global fundraising operations and supporter journeys. The SES platform continues to expand across countries with increasing emphasis on standardization, scalability, automation, data-driven engagement and adoption of emerging capabilities such as Data Cloud, advanced analytics and AI

  
  

The position sit under the Digital Impact Division, Technology Foundation for Business, and report to Digital Impact Manager (CRM Solutions).

### **Role Purpose**

Working within the CRM Solutions team and reporting to the Digital Impact Manager, CRM Solutions, the incumbent will support in defining solution architecture, managing complex implementations, support global rollouts and ensure Marketing Cloud solutions are secure, scalable, reusable and aligned with UNICEF enterprise architecture standards and the broader SES ecosystem, including Salesforce CRM, integrations, analytics and emerging platform capabilities. The role will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, CRM Architects, Data & Integration teams, solution engineers, and external implementation partners.

**Solution Architecture and Technical Oversight**
-------------------------------------------------

  

* Define and maintain the SES Marketing Cloud Reference Architecture.
  
* Contribute to establishing reusable architecture patterns and implementation standards for all UNICEF markets.
  
* Coordinate architecture design sessions and technical solution reviews.
  
* Produce and maintain high-level and detailed solution architecture documentation.
  
* Ensure alignment with UNICEF enterprise architecture principles, including API-first, reuse-before-build, secure-by-design and decoupled integrations.
  
* Review and define architecture artefacts produced by implementation partners.
  
* Partner with Salesforce and other strategic vendors to evaluate new platform capabilities and roadmap opportunities.
  

  

**Hands-on Solution Delivery**

  

* Manage the implementation of complex Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions.
  
* Design and build advanced supporter journeys using Journey Builder.
  
* Configure Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Mobile Studio and Cloud Pages.
  
* Develop and troubleshoot advanced AMPscript, SQL, Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) and Marketing Cloud automation processes.
  
* Build proof-of-concepts and pilot solutions for emerging platform capabilities.
  
* Participate directly in sprint planning, design workshops and technical delivery activities.
  
* Support solution deployment, release management and production go-live activities.
  
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex platform incidents.
  
* Support country implementation teams during onboarding and rollout phases.
  
* Work alongside developers and solution engineers to resolve technical challenges and delivery blockers.
  
* Participate in code reviews and technical quality assurance activities.
  
* Contribute to DevOps practices, release planning and solution optimisation initiatives.
  

  

**Marketing Cloud Platform Strategy**

  

* Support the manager in Defining the strategic roadmap for Marketing Cloud capabilities within SES.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve supporter engagement through automation, personalization and digital innovation.
  
* Provide technical input on Marketing Cloud Next, Data Cloud, Agentforce, AI-driven engagement and emerging Salesforce capabilities.
  
* Develop reusable global assets and frameworks to improve rollout efficiency.
  
* Drive platform simplification and reduction of technical debt.

**Supporter Journey and Engagement Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

  

* Design scalable multi-channel supporter journeys.
  
* Establish standards for campaign management, personalization, testing and optimization.
  
* Develop audience segmentation frameworks and supporter communication strategies.
  
* Enable data-driven fundraising and engagement initiatives through marketing automation

**Governance, Security and Operational Excellence**
---------------------------------------------------

  

* Ensure compliance with UNICEF security, privacy and governance standards.
  
* Help the manager Leading platform health reviews and architecture assessments.
  
* Contribute to monitoring, resilience, and recovery strategies.
  
* Review solution security and data protection controls.
  
* Support audit and compliance activities.
  
* Coordinate with Salesforce on major incidents, platform improvements and technical escalations.

**Capacity Building and Knowledge Transfer**
--------------------------------------------

  

* Mentor internal UNICEF staff, consultants and implementation partners.
  
* Support Leading architecture walkthroughs and technical training sessions.
  
* Develop implementation standards, best practices and technical playbooks.
  
* Promote adoption of reusable components and proven delivery approaches.
  
* Support technical community building across the SES ecosystem.

**Deliverables**
================

============================================

  

* Marketing Cloud Reference Architecture.
  
* Solution Architecture Documents.
  
* Technical Design Standards.
  
* Integration Architecture Specifications.
  
* Security and Compliance Review Artefacts.

Reporting to the NOC Chief Watch Officer, the Network Administrator II provides technical guidance and mentorship to junior Network Administrators, coordinates operational activities across supported sites, and serves as a primary escalation point for network outages, incidents, and anomalies. BMO Capital Markets is hiring a Director to lead Equity Derivatives Risk Engineering within Global Markets Engineering. The role owns the firm’s in-house calculation and risk-view platforms — the pricing/calc server estate and the risk and order-management views used daily by the equity derivatives trading desks.

  

This is a build role as much as a run role. The platform works, is well tested and supports a growing franchise, but it is not fast enough, does not orchestrate risk work across the compute grid well, and carries a heavy daily support burden. The successful candidate will stabilize and professionalize current operations, then partner with their team, the quant group and the desks to define and deliver the next generation of the risk platform: faster, more resilient, better instrumented and materially more extensible.

  

The team is 5–10 engineers today, with an opportunity to grow the team as the vision is defined.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Platform ownership —** Own the existing C#/.NET risk and calculation platform end to end, and scale it to meet the growing needs of the equity derivatives and QIS businesses.

* **Target-state vision —** Work with the team, quants and trading to define and sell a credible architecture for the next-generation risk system, then sequence and deliver it without disrupting the desks.

* **Risk orchestration and performance —** Deliver fast/slow calculation cycles for intraday exotics risk, sub-10-second risk for flow books, on-demand ad-hoc scenario analysis, and substantially improved grid orchestration and component responsibility boundaries.

* **Quant partnership —** Define the system–model interaction contract with the quant team and collaborate on faster Monte Carlo valuation and risk.

* **Market data consistency —** Drive consistent, reproducible market data across pricing, risk and scenario workflows.

* **Engineering discipline —** Own release, test and DevOps for the platform; raise instrumentation, observability and resilience so that support load falls and change velocity rises.

* **Desk engagement —** Act as the senior engineering point of contact for traders and risk managers, translating desk pressure into a prioritized, defensible roadmap.

* **Leadership —** Manage and coach the team; set standards for agile delivery and test-driven development; raise the bar for engineering and design

* **Control and governance —** Maintain a strong control posture across change management, production stability and audit readiness.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* First 6 months: support burden measurably reduced, release cadence predictable, and a costed target-state architecture agreed with stakeholders.

12–24 months: material latency improvements on flow and exotics risk, credible ad-hoc scenario capability in production, and a team scaled and structured to sustain the roadmap.  

  

**Candidate Profile**

  

**Essential**

  

* 10+ years in engineering, including significant experience leading derivatives trading risk development at a mid-size or large financial institution.

* Demonstrable transformation track record: taking an established, business-critical platform and re-architecting it for performance, resilience and extensibility while keeping the lights on.

* Strong hands-on background in distributed and grid compute, container orchestration (Kubernetes) and in-memory data technologies.

* Strong derivatives risk knowledge — sufficient to challenge and partner with quants and earn the confidence of a trading desk. Engineering depth is weighted more heavily than quantitative depth.

* A genuine leader in agile delivery and test-driven development, with a record of building high-performing engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder skills; comfortable and credible on the trading floor.  

  

**Preferred**

  

* .NET/C# experience. This is preferred rather than a hard requirement — strong platform leaders from other stacks will be considered, and introducing new technologies where they are the right answer is expected.

* Experience with high-performance numerical computing, Monte Carlo valuation or comparable low-latency analytics workloads.

Experience building observability and instrumentation into a production risk platform.  

  

**Why This Role**

  

This is an unusually direct mandate: a well-defined, business-critical estate, an engaged trading client base, a supportive reporting line. The person who takes it will set the technical direction for equity derivatives risk at BMO for the next several years.

  

**Salary**

  

Please note the base salary for this role is $175,000 CAD.

Preventing sick days, reducing short- and long-term disability incidence and duration, lowering workplace injury, and returning employees to work quickly — whether the health challenge is personal or work-related — are all bought by the same person: an employer's HR and benefits leadership, or an insurer's group-benefits team, trying to reduce the human and financial cost of employee ill health. Today they buy these as fragmented point solutions. The opportunity is to assemble Bayshore's existing services and products into one coherent, outcome-based proposition for that buyer.

### **Plant Reliability & Maintenance**

* Manage preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for all plant assets.
* Drive reliability-centered maintenance practices to maximize equipment availability and lifecycle performance.
* Analyze operational trends, equipment failures, and plant performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate major maintenance outages, equipment upgrades, and capital projects.
* Ensure effective management of CMMS programs and maintenance documentation.

### **Cogeneration Facility Management**

* Lead the operation and maintenance of a cogeneration facility, ensuring optimal plant efficiency, reliability, and environmental performance.
* Monitor and optimize electrical generation, thermal recovery, fuel consumption, and plant output.
* Develop operating strategies to maximize plant performance while meeting client and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure effective coordination between power generation and facility utility demands.

* Maintain a strong understanding of **Independent Electricity System Operator (IESO)** market rules, dispatch requirements, compliance obligations, and settlement processes.

* Understand and oversee all technical operating requirements necessary to maintain compliance with IESO standards and market obligations.
* Coordinate with regulatory agencies, market participants, and stakeholders as required.
* Monitor regulatory changes and implement operational adjustments to maintain compliance and optimize plant performance.

* Develop and manage operating and capital budgets.
* Monitor financial performance and identify cost reduction opportunities without compromising safety or reliability.
* Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, and contractor performance.
* Support annual business planning and capital investment initiatives.

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between CBRE and client stakeholders.
* Provide regular operational reports, performance updates, and strategic recommendations.

* Participate in client meetings, audits, and operational reviews.

**Job Title**

VP, Head of PMO- Commerce Hub & MCGS

The Vice President, Head of PMO for Commerce Hub & MCGS leads the end-to-end program management office for **Fiserv’s flagship global commerce platform — Commerce Hub (CH) — and its Mastercard Gateway Services (MCGS) integration.** This leader is accountable for orchestrating a complex, multi-region, multi-workstream program that unifies gateway, switch, and settlement capabilities into a single global platform, delivering a faster and differentiated client experience across NAMR, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.

Reporting to the SVP, Global Product Strategy, the Vice President owns the program governance model, the drop-based delivery roadmap, triple-constraint management (scope, schedule, and cost), and the executive reporting rhythm. The role drives disciplined execution through the Product Development Life

Cycle (PDLC) and the Product-Tech Alignment Council (PTAC), partnering across Product, Technology, Regional, Sales, Finance, Legal & Compliance, and network partners (including Mastercard) to deliver on-time global outcomes with velocity, quality, and control.

**Program leadership is fundamentally about driving communication for timely decisions —** keeping one global team aligned on goals, dependencies, risks, and milestones across regions and functions.

**What you will do:**

**Program Leadership & Governance**

* Own the program governance model for Commerce Hub & MCGS, establishing and running Global and Regional Steering Committees (SteerCos) with clear decision rights, escalation paths, and cadence.
* Lead the program operating rhythm — Regional Executive SteerCo (bi-weekly) and Regional Execution SteerCo (weekly) reporting — using standardized templates across all regions for consistent visibility.
* Drive PTAC (Product-Tech Alignment Council) governance for cross-team dependency and duplication review, roadmap sign-off, and stage-gating from Ready-for-Tech into build.
* Embed PDLC discipline across the program, ensuring each initiative moves through intake, prioritization, alignment, build, and launch stages with clear gates and accountability.
* Serve as the single source of truth for program status, decisions, owners, and follow-through across the global team.

**Delivery, Milestones & Triple-Constraint Management**

* Own the drop-based delivery roadmap (e.g., Drop 0 MVP through subsequent global drops), managing milestone plans, release planning, and go-live readiness across regions.
* Manage the triple constraints — scope, schedule, and cost — effectively, controlling scope movement between drops, protecting delivery commitments, and resolving trade-offs transparently.
* Drive integrated program planning across horizontal work streams (Commerce Hub core, payments & adapters, checkouts, SDKs, settlement, VAS, CCC, Marketplace/boarding) and regional work streams.
* Maintain program-level visibility into critical path, dependencies, gaps, and delivery risk; drive mitigation and compensatory actions to keep the program on track.
* Oversee resourcing and hiring status across Product and Technology, partnering with leadership and HR to close staffing gaps that affect delivery.

**MCGS & Network Partner Integration**

* Lead program delivery for Mastercard Gateway Services (MCGS) integration with Commerce Hub, coordinating the joint Fiserv–Mastercard workstreams, milestones, and dependencies.
* Manage the network-partner cadence (e.g., Mastercard monthly/MC reviews and preparatory sessions), ensuring alignment on scope, commitments, and issue resolution.
* Ensure network rules, compliance, and certification requirements are reflected in program plans and delivery gates.

**Executive Communications & Stakeholder Management**

* Prepare and deliver executive-level program communications — SteerCo decks, monthly business reviews, milestone reports, and status narratives — tailored for senior leadership and sponsors.
* Bring strong executive presence, distilling complex, multi-region program status into clear decisions, risks, and asks for executives and network partners.
* Drive communication for timely decisions across a large, distributed stakeholder group, keeping product, technology, regional, and partner leaders aligned.
* Facilitate cross-functional workshops, kick-offs, and planning events (e.g., drop kick-offs and backend/architecture workshops) that mobilize the program.

**Financials, Business Case & Controls**

* Partner with Finance to maintain the program business case, financial targets, and investment controls, tracking spend against plan across regions and work streams.
* Establish program KPIs, RAG status, and operating-health metrics; report against milestones, velocity, and delivery commitments.

**Risk, Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Own the program-level RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) log, driving proactive risk management and timely resolution.
* Strengthen governance and steering mechanisms where scope, testing, or delivery uncertainty creates risk.
* Apply process-excellence and continuous-improvement discipline (e.g., Six Sigma / Lean) to standardize templates, streamline governance, and improve delivery predictability.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled program-management and reporting practices to increase transparency and speed.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build and lead a high-performing global PMO spanning program management, governance, regional delivery, and reporting & controls.
* Operate as “one global team” — aligning Product, Technology, Regional, and partner stakeholders around shared goals and outcomes.
* Develop talent and future program leaders through coaching, mentoring, and career development.
* Influence senior executives and stakeholders without direct authority to achieve enterprise outcomes.

**What you need to have**:

* 14+ years of experience in program/project management, product delivery, or transformation within payments, fintech, financial services, or technology.
* 8+ years of progressive leadership experience running large, complex, multi-region programs and global teams.
* Strong fintech and payments industry knowledge — acquiring, gateways, switch/processing, settlement, VAS, and network ecosystems (Mastercard/Visa).
* Demonstrated mastery of triple-constraint management (scope, schedule, cost) on enterprise-scale programs.
* Deep experience with PDLC and PTAC-style governance, stage-gating, and program operating rhythms (SteerCos, MBRs, milestone reviews).
* Hands-on expertise with program tooling — Clarity, Jira, and Confluence — for portfolio, delivery, and requirements management.
* PMP certification (or equivalent) and Six Sigma / Lean process-excellence credentials.
* Proven program-leadership communications and executive presence, with the ability to drive timely decisions across distributed stakeholders.
* Strong background in Product Strategy, Product Portfolio, and Roadmap Planning, connecting program execution to product outcomes.
* Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills; Bachelor’s degree required.

**What is nice to have**:

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Direct experience delivering global commerce, gateway, or acquiring-platform programs (e.g., Commerce Hub-type initiatives).
* Experience managing network-partner integrations (e.g., Mastercard/Visa) within a program context.
* Experience preparing Board, Investor Relations, or executive-level program materials.
* Knowledge of AI-driven program management, modern delivery practices, and agile-at-scale frameworks.

* Project Management – Deep interest in project delivery with business clients and strong intuition for how companies make decisions.
* Client Management – Inspires client confidence through timely, reliable execution; develops stakeholder management plans to align priorities and address support or resistance.
* Communication & Presence – Crafts clear, complete deliverables and communicates effectively—verbally and in writing—across complex scenarios up to senior management levels.
* Teamwork – Motivates medium-sized teams or key workstreams on regional engagements to produce superior deliverables while fostering open collaboration and a “will-to-win” attitude.
* Commercial Orientation – Identifies opportunities to leverage internal capabilities, including cross-sell opportunities beyond direct project work; partners with broader Services teams on contracting and solution design.
* Leadership – Instills a sense of urgency, ownership, empowerment, and thoughtful risk-taking in leaders at all levels; structures work to align with team members’ goals and motivators.
* Integrity – Models Mastercard’s values of honesty and integrity; follows through on commitments and holds others accountable to do the same.
* Diverse Perspective – Brings unique skills or approaches to every client engagement and internal activity.

* Undergraduate or master’s degree and significant post-graduate work experience in payments and consulting.
* Deep understanding of the KSA , including regulatory frameworks, competitive dynamics, and cultural nuances that influence financial services and payments adoption
* Strong knowledge of Mastercard’s products, data assets, and ecosystem partnerships, and how these capabilities create competitive advantage and drive client value in KSA
* Experience in coaching and leading teams across large, strategic consulting engagements that involve structured problem solving and stakeholder management
* Deep knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills; proven ability to guide project teams to structure and resolve ambiguous client challenges.
* Demonstrated success in owning and developing relationships with mid- to executive-level client contacts, inspiring confidence in Mastercard as a trusted partner.
* Strong ability to communicate complex ideas effectively—both verbally and in writing—in English and local market language(s).
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, balancing thought with action while maximizing limited resources.
* Advanced proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

JOB DESCRIPTIONCHARTERING MANAGER – OIL & ENERGY TRADING

**Company:** NAFT Energies FZCO

**Designation:** Chartering Manager / Senior Chartering Manager  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Head of Trading  
**Experience Required:** 10–15+ years in oil tanker chartering, shipping and/or energy trading

1. Job Purpose

The Chartering Manager will be responsible for managing the company's complete vessel chartering activities in support of its international oil trading business.

The successful candidate must have extensive experience in the global oil and shipping industry, with a strong understanding of crude oil and petroleum product markets, international tanker movements, freight rates, vessel availability and shipping routes.

The individual will be responsible for identifying suitable vessels, negotiating chartering agreements, managing relationships with international shipowners and shipbrokers, monitoring freight market movements and ensuring that all shipping arrangements are commercially competitive and operationally efficient.

The candidate must bring substantial industry knowledge, established market relationships and the ability to independently handle complex chartering negotiations and transactions.

2. Detailed Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Oil Tanker Chartering and Vessel Booking**

* Manage the chartering of vessels for transporting crude oil, refined petroleum products and other energy commodities.
* Identify, evaluate and secure suitable vessels based on cargo volume, type of product, loading and discharge ports, delivery schedules and trading requirements.
* Source vessels through direct relationships with shipowners, ship operators and international shipbrokers.
* Handle spot chartering, voyage chartering and time chartering arrangements.
* Negotiate vessel availability, freight rates, laycan dates, loading windows and other commercial terms.
* Review vessel specifications, including carrying capacity, vessel age, technical suitability and cargo-handling capabilities.
* Coordinate vessel nominations and ensure that vessels are secured within the required trading schedules.
* Maintain a reliable database of available vessels, owners, brokers and shipping contacts.

**B. International Oil and Freight Market Knowledge**

* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the international oil shipping and tanker markets.
* Monitor global freight rate movements and identify changes in vessel demand and availability.
* Understand major oil-producing regions, oil-exporting countries, importing markets and international shipping routes.
* Monitor developments in major trading and shipping hubs, including the Middle East, Asia, Europe, Africa and other key markets.
* Analyse the impact of geopolitical developments, sanctions, port restrictions, supply disruptions and changes in global oil demand on shipping costs and vessel availability.
* Keep management informed about freight market trends, shipping opportunities and potential risks.
* Provide recommendations on the most commercially beneficial shipping routes and chartering arrangements.

**C. Commercial Negotiations and Freight Cost Management**

* Negotiate competitive freight rates with shipowners, vessel operators and brokers.
* Review and negotiate charter party agreements and contractual shipping terms.
* Evaluate voyage costs, freight expenses, bunker costs, port charges and other associated shipping costs.
* Analyse voyage economics to determine the financial viability of different shipping arrangements.
* Negotiate demurrage rates, laytime provisions, cancellation terms and other commercial conditions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce freight costs and improve overall trading margins.
* Ensure that chartering decisions support the company's purchasing, sales and profitability objectives.
* Review freight quotations and provide commercial recommendations to management before finalizing fixtures.

**D. Shipowner, Shipbroker and Industry Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with international shipowners, shipbrokers, charterers and shipping companies.
* Establish direct connections with reputable tanker owners and operators across major international shipping markets.
* Build a strong network of reliable shipping partners to secure competitive vessel availability.
* Maintain relationships with key industry contacts to obtain market information, freight indications and vessel availability updates.
* Attend relevant oil, energy, shipping and commodity trading industry events.
* Identify new business contacts and develop strategic partnerships that support the company's international trading activities.
* Leverage existing industry relationships to obtain competitive commercial terms and timely vessel fixtures.

**E. Charter Party Agreements and Contract Management**

* Prepare, review, negotiate and administer charter party agreements.
* Understand different chartering structures, including Voyage Charter, Time Charter and, where relevant, Consecutive Voyage Charter arrangements.
* Review contractual provisions relating to freight payment, demurrage, dispatch, laytime, cargo handling, cancellation and vessel performance.
* Ensure that agreed commercial terms are properly reflected in the charter party documentation.
* Coordinate with the legal and commercial teams on contractual matters and disputes.
* Monitor contractual obligations and ensure compliance with agreed chartering conditions.
* Manage contractual issues arising from vessel delays, loading or discharge disruptions and other shipping-related disputes.

**F. Vessel Vetting, Due Diligence and Risk Management**

* Evaluate the suitability and reliability of vessels before confirming chartering arrangements.
* Review vessel particulars, ownership details, classification certificates, insurance and technical records.
* Ensure that vessels meet the required safety, technical and operational standards.
* Coordinate vessel vetting and approval processes with relevant parties.
* Conduct appropriate due diligence on shipowners, vessel operators and other counterparties.
* Ensure compliance with applicable international maritime regulations, sanctions, trade restrictions and company policies.
* Identify potential shipping, commercial, operational and counterparty risks.
* Avoid engaging vessels or counterparties that may expose the company to sanctions, compliance or reputational risks.

**G. Voyage Planning and Shipping Operations**

* Coordinate with the trading, operations and documentation teams to understand cargo requirements and shipment schedules.
* Ensure appropriate vessel arrangements are made for loading and discharging cargo.
* Monitor vessel movements from the loading port to the discharge port.
* Coordinate with shipowners, agents, terminals and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor loading and discharge schedules and address operational delays.
* Review Statements of Facts, Notice of Readiness and other relevant shipping documents.
* Monitor laytime calculations and manage demurrage or dispatch claims.
* Resolve shipping-related issues in coordination with the relevant departments.
* Ensure that shipments are completed within the agreed contractual and commercial timelines.

**H. Strategic Planning and Business Development**

* Develop and implement chartering strategies aligned with the company's oil trading activities.
* Identify opportunities in international tanker markets and new shipping routes.
* Evaluate opportunities for long-term vessel arrangements and strategic shipping partnerships.
* Advise management on market conditions, freight trends and chartering opportunities.
* Support the expansion of the company's crude oil and petroleum product trading activities.
* Provide market intelligence to support purchasing, selling and trading decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the company's shipping network, commercial efficiency and market competitiveness.

3. Required Industry Experience

The candidate must demonstrate:

* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience in the international oil, tanker chartering or shipping industry.
* Extensive practical experience in crude oil and/or petroleum product tanker chartering.
* Strong understanding of the international oil and freight markets.
* Proven experience in negotiating and concluding vessel chartering transactions.
* Direct exposure to international shipowners, shipbrokers and vessel operators.
* Strong knowledge of global tanker availability, freight rate movements and shipping routes.
* Experience handling charter party agreements and commercial shipping negotiations.
* Experience working with oil trading companies, energy companies, tanker operators or international shipping firms.

**Preferred industry exposure:**

* Crude Oil Tankers
* Petroleum Product Tankers
* Clean Petroleum Products (CPP)
* Dirty Petroleum Products (DPP)
* International Oil Trading
* Marine Transportation
* Tanker Chartering and Shipping

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Shipping Management, Logistics, International Trade, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional qualifications in shipping, chartering or maritime operations will be an advantage.
* Strong commercial and technical understanding of the international tanker industry is essential.

5. Technical Knowledge Required

The candidate should have a strong working knowledge of:

* International tanker chartering practices.
* Crude oil and petroleum product transportation.
* Voyage Charter and Time Charter arrangements.
* Charter Party Agreements.
* Freight calculations and voyage economics.
* Laytime, Demurrage and Dispatch.
* Vessel specifications and tanker classifications.
* Global shipping routes and major oil trading hubs.
* International maritime regulations and vessel vetting.
* Shipping documentation and cargo transportation procedures.
* Freight market analysis and industry pricing benchmarks.

6. Essential Skills and Competencies

* Exceptional commercial negotiation and deal-making abilities.
* Strong understanding of global oil and tanker markets.
* Established international industry network and business relationships.
* Excellent market intelligence and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to independently identify and secure suitable vessels.
* Strong commercial judgement and cost-control capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple chartering transactions simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-moving oil trading environment.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed based on:

* Competitive freight rates achieved through successful negotiations.
* Number and quality of successfully concluded vessel fixtures.
* Reduction in avoidable freight expenses and demurrage costs.
* Timely vessel availability and cargo transportation.
* Quality and strength of international shipowner and broker relationships.
* Accuracy of freight market analysis and commercial recommendations.
* Effective management of chartering contracts and operational risks.
* Identification of new shipping opportunities and strategic partnerships.
* Compliance with vessel vetting and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Contribution to the company's overall oil trading profitability.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a highly experienced oil and shipping industry professional who has spent a substantial part of their career in tanker chartering and international oil transportation.

The ideal candidate should have a strong reputation in the market, extensive knowledge of international freight movements, established relationships with major shipowners and brokers, and a proven ability to negotiate and execute commercially beneficial chartering transactions.

The individual must be commercially driven, well-connected within the oil industry and capable of bringing valuable market intelligence, business relationships and chartering expertise to the company.

**The position is intended for an established industry professional who can independently manage the company's chartering function and contribute directly to its international oil trading business.**

* Ensuring side duties are completed without taking attention away from guests.

The Head Chef owns everything that leaves the El Ta'koy kitchen in Doha: taste, consistency, speed, presentation, food safety and food cost. The Head Chef leads the brigade, runs ordering and stock, and keeps the kitchen inspection-ready to Qatar Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) standards at all times. Kitchen and bar run under one management structure, so the role works closely with the Bar Manager on shared prep, storage and service flow.  
  
Key responsibilities

**Pre-opening (first 8-10 weeks)**
----------------------------------

* Work with Chef Luis Pous and the TGP pre-opening team to localise the menu for Doha: halal-certified proteins, pork and alcohol substitutions (for example kalua-style chicken or beef, mirin-free glazes) and local produce swaps.
* Build and sign off market lists, preferred brands and smallware requirements; open supplier accounts with procurement.
* Check kitchen equipment against the layout and flag gaps, including pastry oven capacity.
* Write and test standard recipe cards, plating guides and prep sheets for every menu item; lead the pre-opening tasting.
* Recruit (with HR), onboard and train the brigade on recipes, station set-up and food safety.
* Agree the menu approval process with the landlord and follow the food hall menu and pricing guidelines.

**Daily kitchen operations**
----------------------------

* Run opening and closing using brand checklists; set prep pars from sales forecasts.
* Deliver every dish to brand specification: standard recipes, portion sizes, methods and presentation.
* Hold ticket times at food hall pace during peaks and run the pass personally at peak service.
* Manage raw fish service safely: approved suppliers, receiving temperatures, freezing and parasite-control records, sushi rice acidification and time controls.
* Coordinate with the Bar Manager on shared fridge space, garnish prep and service flow.

**Purchasing, stock and cost control**
--------------------------------------

* Order fresh and dry stock through the requisition system; check quality and temperatures at receiving.
* Store all products correctly with FIFO, labelling and date control.
* Run weekly stock counts and the monthly full inventory, and explain variances.
* Hit the target food cost %; control waste with daily waste logs and use-first lists.
* Manage kitchen labour to the rota budget and approve overtime.

**Food safety, hygiene and maintenance**
----------------------------------------

* Keep the kitchen MoPH-compliant and inspection-ready; maintain HACCP records and temperature logs.
* Enforce personal hygiene, uniform and allergen controls; keep an up-to-date allergen matrix for every dish.
* Report pest and maintenance issues immediately and follow up until closed.
* Respond to every QA, brand or third-party audit with a written action plan within 7 days.

**People leadership**
---------------------

* Set the rota, run daily briefings and coach the team on station skills.
* Develop the Sous Chef as deputy and cover.
* Complete probation reviews and appraisals; handle discipline in line with HR policy.

--------------------

* Propose specials and seasonal items to the Outlet Manager and Brand Executive Chef, fully costed.
* Never change recipes, specifications or suppliers without written approval from the Brand Executive Chef and Operations.

**About Us**
Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer-centric financial super-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in the region and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA and Amazon, as well as small and medium businesses.
  
  
Tamara is Saudi Arabia’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others. **Your role**
We're seeking a Team Leader for our Customer Experience Team. As Team Leader, you will be crucial in overseeing and assessing the activities of customer service representatives, as well as providing frequent performance feedback.
  
  
Drawing on your proficiency in leading, providing coaching, feedback, and development opportunities to help them reach their full potential, you will be responsible for developing and monitoring the everyday activities of customer service operations, assisting customer service representatives with duties as needed to create unique experiences only Tamara can provide.

You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges.
  
  
You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Overseeing and assessing customer service staff activities, and providing them with regular performance-related feedback.
* Strategizing and monitoring the daily activities of customer service operations.
* Assisting customer service staff with duties where required.
* Training staff in areas of customer service and company policies.
* Monitoring and authenticating returns, exchanges, and voids.
* Investigating and solving customer service complaints.
* Assisting with the development and implementation of service policies, and explaining these to staff and customers.
* Maintaining documentation pertaining to customer service department activitie

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management studies, or in a related discipline.

* Communication Skills: They are well versed in effectively interacting with clients to identify and process their requirements.
* Customer Service Skills: They are able to courteously interact with clients to ensure positive customer experience

Title: Manager – AI Transformation
Description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters' CIO Strategy & Operations team brings together CIO Strategy, AI Transformation, and the Project Management Office to align priorities, govern execution, and provide the platforms and insights that enable the CIO organization to deliver outcomes at scale. As the organization's technology transformation agenda accelerates — spanning AI adoption, platform modernization, and enterprise-scale change — the team is expanding to add senior practitioners who can own complex outcomes from strategy through to delivery. As a Manager / Senior Manager – AI Transformation, you will personally own delivery of high-visibility programs spanning multiple business domains and technologies, moving fluidly between problem structuring, business analysis, program leadership, and senior stakeholder management. This role suits a consultant from a Big 4, strategy, or technology consulting background who wants to see their thinking through to results — shaping the approach and then delivering it, staying close to the work rather than handing it off.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Structure ambiguous problems: take a loosely defined business or technology challenge and break it into a clear, actionable plan covering hypotheses, workstreams, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Translate business strategy into actionable program plans, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and benefits realization, ensuring alignment with enterprise goals and measurable outcomes.
* Analyze data to drive decisions: build business cases, cost/value models, and performance dashboards, working directly in the data rather than waiting on a BI team.
* Lead programs end-to-end, personally owning delivery of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from conception through completion, balancing scope, risk, budget, and timeline.
* Maintain governance structures, operating rhythms, PMO standards, tooling, and methodologies to ensure consistency and rigor across the portfolio.
* Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies that could impact program delivery, providing thought leadership to navigate complexity.
* Flex across the portfolio, moving between programs and responsibilities as priorities shift, and, where scope requires, lead and develop a team of project managers.
* Manage senior stakeholders: run steering committees, influence VP-level decision-making, and manage competing priorities across business and technology leaders.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for senior stakeholders, providing clear, timely status reporting and maintaining strong communication throughout the program lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications**

* Four to eight years of experience in management consulting (Big 4, strategy, or technology consulting) or equivalent in-house transformation roles, typically developed to Senior Consultant or Manager level and ready to step into full end-to-end ownership.
* A demonstrated blended skill set delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business domains and technologies — equally comfortable translating data into insights, partnering with SMEs on strategy and requirements, and owning end-to-end program delivery.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior leadership, navigate ambiguity, and manage competing priorities.
* A track record of leading ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from scoping through delivery, with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to produce executive-ready materials.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A strong bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity over process-heavy environments.
* Exposure to AI or data transformation programs, with the ability to engage credibly on AI adoption, platform modernization, or automation-driven change initiatives.

About Toronto Community Housing Corporation
  
  
Toronto Community Housing Corporation (“TCHC”) is the largest social housing provider in Canada and the second largest in North America. We are wholly owned by the City of Toronto and operate in a non-profit manner. TCHC provides homes to over 41,000 low and moderate-income households in 88 of Toronto's neighbourhoods, with 93,000 tenants from many different backgrounds with a diversity in age, education, language, mental and physical ability, religion, ethnicity and race. What we offer
  
In addition to competitive compensation and a rewarding career where you can truly make a difference, we offer a comprehensive package that meets the various needs of our diverse employees, including:
  

* Ability to participate in inclusive employee-led networks to educate, inspire, amplify voices, build relationships and provide development opportunities;
* Defined benefit pension plan with OMERS, includes 100-per-cent employer matching;
* Employee and family assistance program;
* Maternity and parental leave top up (93% of base salary);

Make a difference
  
  
Reporting to the Assistant General Manager (AGM), the District Manager provides leadership to the service delivery of day-to-day building services related to demand maintenance and cleaning activities within the East Region.
  
  
The role is primarily responsible for providing leadership to the District Supervisors and approximately up to 80 staff and is focused on operational service delivery in alignment with the organization’s strategic plan including management of an operating budget (approx. $12M), corporate compliance with building operation legislation, vendor management, and performance management of union and non-union staff.
  
  
In this role you will contribute to the development and management of strategic plans at the regional level, including the management of standards, service delivery tied to accompanying budgets, work break down structures and performance management plans in a manner that supports TCHC’s tenant focused culture.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Manage a team of approx. 80 union and 2 non-union staff to meet and uphold the maintenance standards of our units and buildings.
* Provide leadership to the delivery of building maintenance services for the region.
* Monitor and manage the region’s delivery of building maintenance services including demand maintenance repairs, preventative maintenance checks, life safety system checks and capital repair identification.
* Manage through established strategic plans and metrics, as identified in the Operations Agreement, and developed by the General Manager/Chief Operating Officer, for in suite, exterior, interior and common space maintenance of the buildings and align standards with work breakdown structure and hours to complete task to ensure optimal staffing levels to keep buildings in a state of good repair.
* Collaborate with other managers, supervisors, and staff across the different service pillars to provide seamless and consistent services.
* Handle repair backlogs and prioritize maintenance based on risk and safety.
* Manage the district’s building maintenance services budget and ensure service delivery meets the standard tied to the budget.
* In collaboration with the AGM, participate in the development of and lead the review of performance indicators, identifying those that are below the pre-determined standard and implementing management plans to address deficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable by-laws, standards and legislative requirements including Municipal Licensing standards (MLS) and various other regulated building component authorities (i.e. ESA, TSSA, ULC, etc).
* Overseeing the management of MLS orders and TFS violations
* Managing escalations from various stakeholder’s groups related to cleaning and maintenance.
* Pro-actively manage emerging building maintenance service-related issues and resolve escalations from tenants, staff, vendors, and other stakeholders that impact TCHC properties and/or the broader region.
* Manage building audit, maintenance, and inspection routines.
* Lead process improvement initiatives and demonstrate a value for improving the quality, cost, and tenant experience of maintenance services through audit of service delivery (staff and vendor); identify areas for change.
* In collaboration with Human Resources, contribute to the resolution of labour relations matters including discipline, grievances, and union partner relationship management.
* Review and approve costs at a defined threshold; escalates cost approvals to AGM as required.
* Coordinate the timely payment of vendor invoices related to demand maintenance repair (including confirmation of work completion)
* Comply with corporate purchasing policies and related operational business process standards.
* Develop business cases for any critical building maintenance service-related issues that have been identified.
* Use sound judgment to effectively prioritize demand maintenance investment to extend asset life, ensure life safety and mitigate organizational risk.
* Lead special programs including centrally managed maintenance initiatives or projects.
* Participates in cross-functional project teams in the planning and implementation of strategic initiatives deployed into operations; occasionally taking ownership of project deliverables.
* Monitor actual cost performance for variance from budget and develop responsive management actions plans on a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Develop performance plans for the team members to drive service delivery of maintenance activities, measuring achievement to metrics and standards within a process of continuous performance management.
* Foster an environment of organizational development among Supervisors and frontline building maintenance services staff; monitoring any succession plans; participating in coaching and mentoring activities.
* Build and nurture a culture of tenant centric performance excellence through communication, coaching and fair/equitable treatment of staff, promoting a safe, respectful, diverse, and inclusive workplace.
* Adhere to established People & Culture policies and procedures.
* Intervene as required to investigate vendor performance issues; liaise with suppliers to resolve issues/disputes and escalate as required.
* Participate in RFP evaluations pertaining to building maintenance related services.
* Coordinate local building condition audits (on demand).
* Liaise directly with tenants through community meetings, service escalations and complaints to listen to issues and ideas; responding accordingly and acting where required.
* Appear at the Landlord and Tenant Board in support of legal steps being taken with respect to specific tenant cases.

What you’ll need
  
  

* Post-secondary education or experience in fields such as property management, operations, asset management or in a relevant discipline.
* Certified Property / Facility Management designation is an asset.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience (7 preferred) providing service delivery of day-to-day building maintenance/property management activities within a multi-residential property management provider, serving marginalized communities.
* Minimum of 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role. This includes, but is not limited to experience in motivating, coaching and developing a team providing service delivery of day-to-day building maintenance activities in large residential buildings.
* Demonstrated business operations experience involving managing large budgets, developing metrics and standards, and aligning standards to work breakdown structures
* Strong attention to detail to maintenance issues (ex: falling ceiling tiles, chips in a wall, dents in a door, baseboards damaged, etc.) and sense of urgency to fix issues before the problems worsen
* Ability to understand and differentiate when a repair can be done by a Super or CMP1 and when to call a vendor to for semi-skilled repair.
* Strong knowledge of maintenance repairs, including knowing the right people to call to do the work and the number of hours it will be taken to get the repairs done.
* Proficient in strategic planning, development of business plans, creation of needs analyses, implementation of process improvements to improve maintenance of our units/buildings and to deliver superior tenant service.
* Commitment to providing high quality tenant/customer service.
* Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse tenant population in difficult situations and resolve sensitive issues.
* Ability to understand complex tenancies and the issues that affect those with social and economic vulnerability, diverse in age, race, sexual orientation, culture, and ability.
* Strong listening, verbal communication, writing, conflict resolution and presentation skills.
* Knowledge of applicable legislation including Residential Tenancies Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Human Rights Code, Ontario Building Code, Fire Code, Labour Relations Act, Social Housing Reform Act, etc.
* G-License and own vehicle is an asset to travel to various buildings.
* Ability to communicate in a second language is an asset.
